units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|name|16|0
units.english: Transport Heliarch Agents
units.italian: Trasportare agenti degli Heliarchs

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|description|17|0
units.english: Bring <bunks> Heliarch agents to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta <bunks> agenti degli Heliarchs a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|A few minutes into browsing the local shops, you hear the strong sound of Saryd hooves approaching, and turn to see a trio of Heliarch agents hurrying toward you. They briefly salute you before stating their business.|29|0
units.english: A few minutes into browsing the local shops, you hear the strong sound of Saryd hooves approaching, and turn to see a trio of Heliarch agents hurrying toward you. They briefly salute you before stating their business.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto passato a curiosare tra i negozi del posto, senti il rumore pesante degli zoccoli Saryd avvicinarsi, e ti volti a vedere tre agenti degli Heliarchs che ti vengono incontro in fretta. Ti salutano brevemente prima di esporre il loro motivo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|	"Looking for work, the human visitor is?" the Saryd asks.|30|0
units.english: "Looking for work, the human visitor is?" the Saryd asks.
units.italian: "In cerca di lavoro, il visitatore umano è?" chiede il Saryd.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|	"To the <destination>, a means of transport we need," the Kimek follows.|31|0
units.english: "To the <destination>, a means of transport we need," the Kimek follows.
units.italian: "Fino a <destination>, un mezzo di trasporto ci serve," segue il Kimek.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|	"<payment>, we can offer. And, perhaps, some more interesting work after our destination, we reach," the Arach finishes.|32|0
units.english: "<payment>, we can offer. And, perhaps, some more interesting work after our destination, we reach," the Arach finishes.
units.italian: "<payment>, possiamo offrire. E, forse, un lavoro più interessante dopo che la nostra destinazione avremo raggiunto," conclude l'Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|	"Of course, I'll show you to my ship."|34|0
units.english: "Of course, I'll show you to my ship."
units.italian: "Certo, vi accompagno alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|	"Sorry, I'm not looking for any work currently."|35|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not looking for any work currently."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, al momento non cerco lavoro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|	They thank you for agreeing to deliver them to the <planet>, and introduce themselves; the Saryd is called Iplora, the Kimek is Kirrie, and the Arach is known as Tugroob. You help them settle in their bunks, wondering why they seemed so rushed.|37|0
units.english: They thank you for agreeing to deliver them to the <planet>, and introduce themselves; the Saryd is called Iplora, the Kimek is Kirrie, and the Arach is known as Tugroob. You help them settle in their bunks, wondering why they seemed so rushed.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano per aver accettato di portarli su <planet> e si presentano: il Saryd si chiama Iplora, il Kimek Kirrie, e l'Arach è noto come Tugroob. Li aiuti a sistemarsi nelle cuccette, chiedendoti perché sembrassero così di fretta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 1|The three Heliarchs disembark and head immediately toward the spaceport, but not before Iplora hands you <payment>. "Speak with our superior, we must. Need your services again, we likely will, so if interested in further work, you are, look for us in the spaceport, you should." She bows her head lightly, and follows her colleagues into one of the Heliarch-only sections of the ring.|48|0
units.english: The three Heliarchs disembark and head immediately toward the spaceport, but not before Iplora hands you <payment>. "Speak with our superior, we must. Need your services again, we likely will, so if interested in further work, you are, look for us in the spaceport, you should." She bows her head lightly, and follows her colleagues into one of the Heliarch-only sections of the ring.
units.italian: I tre Heliarchs sbarcano e si dirigono subito verso lo spazioporto, ma non prima che Iplora ti consegni <payment>. "Parlare con il nostro superiore, noi dobbiamo. Bisogno dei tuoi servizi di nuovo, probabilmente avremo, quindi se interessato a ulteriore lavoro, tu sei, cercarci nello spazioporto, tu dovresti." China leggermente la testa e segue i colleghi in una delle sezioni dell'anello riservate agli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|name|51|0
units.english: Heliarch Investigation
units.italian: Indagine degli Heliarchs

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|description|52|0
units.english: Take the Heliarch agents to the marked planets so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.
units.italian: Porta gli agenti degli Heliarchs sui pianeti indicati, così che possano indagare su segni di attività criminale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|You find the trio of Heliarch agents, Iplora, Kirrie and Tugroob, waiting for you in the spaceport. They greet you, and Iplora speaks for the trio. "Accompany us now, could you? A job in mind for you, our superior has."|69|0
units.english: You find the trio of Heliarch agents, Iplora, Kirrie and Tugroob, waiting for you in the spaceport. They greet you, and Iplora speaks for the trio. "Accompany us now, could you? A job in mind for you, our superior has."
units.italian: Trovi il trio di agenti degli Heliarchs, Iplora, Kirrie e Tugroob, che ti aspetta nello spazioporto. Ti salutano, e Iplora parla a nome del trio. "Accompagnarci ora, potresti? Un lavoro in mente per te, il nostro superiore ha."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"I don't see why not. Lead the way."|71|0
units.english: "I don't see why not. Lead the way."
units.italian: "Non vedo perché no. Fai strada."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Sorry, but I'm not interested in helping any more."|72|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not interested in helping any more."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono più interessato ad aiutare."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	The three of them escort you through a number of restricted passageways dotted with armed, statue-like guards at every door and hallway you pass through. Eventually you reach a meeting room of sorts, with about a dozen other Heliarchs seated at the central table. One of them motions for you to join them.|74|0
units.english: The three of them escort you through a number of restricted passageways dotted with armed, statue-like guards at every door and hallway you pass through. Eventually you reach a meeting room of sorts, with about a dozen other Heliarchs seated at the central table. One of them motions for you to join them.
units.italian: I tre ti scortano attraverso una serie di passaggi riservati, punteggiati di guardie armate e immobili come statue a ogni porta e corridoio. Alla fine arrivi a una specie di sala riunioni, con una dozzina circa di altri Heliarchs seduti al tavolo centrale. Uno di loro ti fa cenno di unirti a loro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	As you take a seat, one of the Kimek speaks. "The honorable Captain, we salute. Make you feel welcome, I, Consul Iekie of the Heliarch council, hope we will."|75|0
units.english: As you take a seat, one of the Kimek speaks. "The honorable Captain, we salute. Make you feel welcome, I, Consul Iekie of the Heliarch council, hope we will."
units.italian: Mentre prendi posto, uno dei Kimek parla. "L'onorevole Capitano, noi salutiamo. Sentirti il benvenuto, io, console Iekie del consiglio degli Heliarchs, spero che noi ti faremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Thank you. The honor's all mine."|77|0
units.english: "Thank you. The honor's all mine."
units.italian: "Grazie. L'onore è tutto mio."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Are you the one that has a job for me?"|78|0
units.english: "Are you the one that has a job for me?"
units.italian: "Sei tu che hai un lavoro per me?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Stable and safe, our great Coalition is. Sadly, there are some who ideas of revolt and rebellion spread," she says. "To combat these thoughts of disunion, we swore. Correct such behavior, we must," she says as she points to the three agents beside you. "Dedicated to that, our agents are, but oftentimes slow and predictable, their tactics are. A different approach might be due, so an outsider's help, and their way of thinking, we'd like to ask for."|79|0
units.english: "Stable and safe, our great Coalition is. Sadly, there are some who ideas of revolt and rebellion spread," she says. "To combat these thoughts of disunion, we swore. Correct such behavior, we must," she says as she points to the three agents beside you. "Dedicated to that, our agents are, but oftentimes slow and predictable, their tactics are. A different approach might be due, so an outsider's help, and their way of thinking, we'd like to ask for."
units.italian: "Stabile e sicura, la nostra grande Coalizione è. Purtroppo, ci sono alcuni che idee di rivolta e ribellione diffondono," dice. "Combattere questi pensieri di disunione, noi abbiamo giurato. Correggere tali comportamenti, noi dobbiamo," dice indicando i tre agenti accanto a te. "Dediti a questo, i nostri agenti sono, ma spesso lente e prevedibili, le loro tattiche sono. Un approccio diverso forse ci vorrebbe, quindi l'aiuto di un esterno, e il suo modo di pensare, vorremmo chiedere."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"What exactly would I have to do?"|81|0
units.english: "What exactly would I have to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dovrei fare esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Revolt? Rebellion? What are you talking about?"|83|0
units.english: "Revolt? Rebellion? What are you talking about?"
units.italian: "Rivolta? Ribellione? Di che cosa stai parlando?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"In that case, I'm not interested. I thought this was some simple job, not a political matter."|84|0
units.english: "In that case, I'm not interested. I thought this was some simple job, not a political matter."
units.italian: "In tal caso non sono interessato. Pensavo fosse un lavoro semplice, non una faccenda politica."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Though to guard our Coalition from the Quarg and all who would see it harmed, steadfast and ever-ready we for millennia have remained, not as disciplined and understanding of the situation, our civilians are," Iekie explains. "For a few centuries now, plagued our Coalition with increasing violence and threats to our people, bands of thieves and terrorist groups have. Stealing Heliarch equipment, promoting rebellious propaganda, attacking Heliarch officials and sites, disrupting our peace with bombings and attacks, intensified all their activities as of late, they have."|86|0
units.english: "Though to guard our Coalition from the Quarg and all who would see it harmed, steadfast and ever-ready we for millennia have remained, not as disciplined and understanding of the situation, our civilians are," Iekie explains. "For a few centuries now, plagued our Coalition with increasing violence and threats to our people, bands of thieves and terrorist groups have. Stealing Heliarch equipment, promoting rebellious propaganda, attacking Heliarch officials and sites, disrupting our peace with bombings and attacks, intensified all their activities as of late, they have."
units.italian: "Anche se a proteggere la nostra Coalizione dai Quarg e da tutti coloro che vorrebbero vederla colpita, saldi e sempre pronti noi per millenni siamo rimasti, non altrettanto disciplinati e consapevoli della situazione, i nostri civili sono," spiega Iekie. "Da qualche secolo ormai, dilaniato la nostra Coalizione con violenza crescente e minacce alla nostra gente, bande di ladri e gruppi terroristici lo hanno. Rubare attrezzature degli Heliarchs, diffondere propaganda ribelle, attaccare funzionari e siti degli Heliarchs, turbare la nostra pace con bombardamenti e attacchi: intensificato tutte le loro attività ultimamente, essi le hanno."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Well, what do you think I can do to help?"|88|0
units.english: "Well, what do you think I can do to help?"
units.italian: "Beh, che cosa pensi che possa fare per aiutare?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Why are they doing all that?"|90|0
units.english: "Why are they doing all that?"
units.italian: "Perché fanno tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Uncertain to us, that still remains. Those that arrested and interrogated, we have, no more than simple pawns in the outlaw organizations appear to be." she considers her words for a few seconds. "Warning our civilians about the thugs' actions, we have been, and asking them for support with any information of suspicious activity. Investigate reports of such activity, what you can help us with is."|91|0
units.english: "Uncertain to us, that still remains. Those that arrested and interrogated, we have, no more than simple pawns in the outlaw organizations appear to be." she considers her words for a few seconds. "Warning our civilians about the thugs' actions, we have been, and asking them for support with any information of suspicious activity. Investigate reports of such activity, what you can help us with is."
units.italian: "Incerto per noi, questo resta ancora. Quelli che abbiamo arrestato e interrogato, non più che semplici pedine nelle organizzazioni fuorilegge sembrano essere." Pesa le parole per qualche secondo. "Avvertire i nostri civili delle azioni dei teppisti, noi lo stiamo facendo, e chiedere loro sostegno con qualsiasi informazione su attività sospette. Indagare sulle segnalazioni di tali attività, ciò in cui tu puoi aiutarci è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Six worlds, we have marked. Each, we'd like you to 'visit.' Those three tourists, you will be transporting," an Arach says as they point to Iplora, Kirrie and Tugroob.|93|0
units.english: "Six worlds, we have marked. Each, we'd like you to 'visit.' Those three tourists, you will be transporting," an Arach says as they point to Iplora, Kirrie and Tugroob.
units.italian: "Sei mondi, noi abbiamo indicato. Ognuno, vorremmo che tu lo 'visitassi'. Quei tre turisti, tu trasporterai," dice un Arach indicando Iplora, Kirrie e Tugroob.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Sounds easy enough. Where should I start?"|95|0
units.english: "Sounds easy enough. Where should I start?"
units.italian: "Sembra abbastanza facile. Da dove dovrei cominciare?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Whether they go undercover or not, this seems a bit risky for me. Sorry, you'll have to find someone else."|96|0
units.english: "Whether they go undercover or not, this seems a bit risky for me. Sorry, you'll have to find someone else."
units.italian: "Che vadano sotto copertura o no, questo mi sembra un po' rischioso. Mi dispiace, dovrete trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Decide the order of your visits, you will, Captain," Iekie responds. "Shameful to admit this, it is, but known to these outlaws, many of our methods are. Failed in similar operations before, we have, so fear I do, that easily predicted, our own ordering would be."|98|0
units.english: "Decide the order of your visits, you will, Captain," Iekie responds. "Shameful to admit this, it is, but known to these outlaws, many of our methods are. Failed in similar operations before, we have, so fear I do, that easily predicted, our own ordering would be."
units.italian: "Decidere l'ordine delle tue visite, tu lo farai, Capitano," risponde Iekie. "Vergognoso ammetterlo, è, ma noti a questi fuorilegge, molti dei nostri metodi sono. Fallito in operazioni simili prima, noi abbiamo, quindi temere io temo che facilmente prevedibile, il nostro ordine sarebbe."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	Some of the others brief you on the worlds where suspicious activity has been reported: Shifting Sand in Saryd space, Into White, Fourth Shadow and Remote Blue in Kimek space, and Mebla's Portion and Stronghold of Flugbu in Arach space.|99|0
units.english: Some of the others brief you on the worlds where suspicious activity has been reported: Shifting Sand in Saryd space, Into White, Fourth Shadow and Remote Blue in Kimek space, and Mebla's Portion and Stronghold of Flugbu in Arach space.
units.italian: Alcuni degli altri ti informano sui mondi dove sono state segnalate attività sospette: Shifting Sand nello spazio Saryd, Into White, Fourth Shadow e Remote Blue nello spazio Kimek, e Mebla's Portion e Stronghold of Flugbu nello spazio Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	They wish the four of you good luck, and have you escorted back to the spaceport. The Heliarch trio arrives at your ship a few minutes later, out of uniform and with heavy luggage. You show the <bunks> 'tourists' to their bunks, and head to your cockpit to decide which of the six worlds you'll head to first.|100|0
units.english: They wish the four of you good luck, and have you escorted back to the spaceport. The Heliarch trio arrives at your ship a few minutes later, out of uniform and with heavy luggage. You show the <bunks> 'tourists' to their bunks, and head to your cockpit to decide which of the six worlds you'll head to first.
units.italian: Augurano buona fortuna a voi quattro e ti fanno scortare allo spazioporto. Il trio degli Heliarchs arriva alla tua nave qualche minuto dopo, senza uniforme e con bagagli pesanti. Mostri ai <bunks> 'turisti' le cuccette e vai in cabina di pilotaggio a decidere a quale dei sei mondi andrai per primo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|log|109|0
units.english: Assisted the Heliarch in investigating several worlds around Coalition space, bringing their agents to each world to look for any signs of criminal activity.
units.italian: Hai assistito gli Heliarchs nell'indagare su diversi mondi intorno allo spazio della Coalizione, portando i loro agenti su ogni mondo a cercare segni di attività criminale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|When you and the agents leave your ship, you're greeted by about a dozen Heliarch guards, who urge you to follow them into the restricted portions of the ring. You're once again guided through the halls, until you're met by Consul Iekie and her delegation. She approaches you first, handing you <payment>. "Welcome back, Captain <last>. Glad, we all are, that made it back safely, you all have. Trust, I do, that fruitful in learning more of these criminals, your efforts have been?" She looks to the agents you transported.|112|0
units.english: When you and the agents leave your ship, you're greeted by about a dozen Heliarch guards, who urge you to follow them into the restricted portions of the ring. You're once again guided through the halls, until you're met by Consul Iekie and her delegation. She approaches you first, handing you <payment>. "Welcome back, Captain <last>. Glad, we all are, that made it back safely, you all have. Trust, I do, that fruitful in learning more of these criminals, your efforts have been?" She looks to the agents you transported.
units.italian: Quando tu e gli agenti lasciate la nave, vi accolgono una dozzina circa di guardie degli Heliarchs, che vi esortano a seguirle nelle porzioni riservate dell'anello. Venite di nuovo guidati attraverso i corridoi, finché non incontrate il console Iekie e la sua delegazione. Si avvicina a te per prima, consegnandoti <payment>. "Bentornato, Capitano <last>. Lieti, noi tutti siamo, che tornati sani e salvi, voi tutti siate. Fiduciosa, io sono, che fruttuosi nell'apprendere di più su questi criminali, i vostri sforzi siano stati?" Guarda gli agenti che hai trasportato.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	"Unearthed some useful information, we have," Tugroob tells her as he delivers the agents' reports. "Essential to the mission's success, Captain <last>'s cooperativeness was."|113|0
units.english: "Unearthed some useful information, we have," Tugroob tells her as he delivers the agents' reports. "Essential to the mission's success, Captain <last>'s cooperativeness was."
units.italian: "Portato alla luce alcune informazioni utili, noi abbiamo," le dice Tugroob consegnando i rapporti degli agenti. "Essenziale al successo della missione, la collaborazione del Capitano <last> è stata."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	She nods, as she hands the data to one of the Heliarchs behind her, who immediately move to start analyzing the findings. "Eager to read on the progress made, I am."|114|0
units.english: She nods, as she hands the data to one of the Heliarchs behind her, who immediately move to start analyzing the findings. "Eager to read on the progress made, I am."
units.italian: Annuisce e consegna i dati a uno degli Heliarchs dietro di lei, che subito si mettono ad analizzare i risultati. "Impaziente di leggere i progressi fatti, io sono."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|label|121|0
units.english: final thanks
units.italian: final thanks

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	Iekie thanks you for your efforts in the operation, and goes to analyze the findings with her team. Iplora, Kirrie and Tugroob remain there with them, and you're escorted back to your ship by the guards.|122|0
units.english: Iekie thanks you for your efforts in the operation, and goes to analyze the findings with her team. Iplora, Kirrie and Tugroob remain there with them, and you're escorted back to your ship by the guards.
units.italian: Iekie ti ringrazia per i tuoi sforzi nell'operazione e va ad analizzare i risultati con la sua squadra. Iplora, Kirrie e Tugroob restano lì con loro, e le guardie ti riaccompagnano alla nave.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	The agents then get closer to her, and Kirrie whispers something to the consul, handing her another report. Iekie turns to you once more, saying, "Quite a find, this is. Done well, you have, Captain."|125|0
units.english: The agents then get closer to her, and Kirrie whispers something to the consul, handing her another report. Iekie turns to you once more, saying, "Quite a find, this is. Done well, you have, Captain."
units.italian: Gli agenti poi le si avvicinano, e Kirrie sussurra qualcosa al console, consegnandole un altro rapporto. Iekie si volta di nuovo verso di te, dicendo: "Una bella scoperta, questa è. Fatto bene, tu hai, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	The agents then get closer to her, and Kirrie whispers something to the consul, handing her two more reports. Iekie turns to you once more, saying, "Most useful to our investigation, these findings will prove. Excellent work, Captain."|128|0
units.english: The agents then get closer to her, and Kirrie whispers something to the consul, handing her two more reports. Iekie turns to you once more, saying, "Most useful to our investigation, these findings will prove. Excellent work, Captain."
units.italian: Gli agenti poi le si avvicinano, e Kirrie sussurra qualcosa al console, consegnandole altri due rapporti. Iekie si volta di nuovo verso di te, dicendo: "Molto utili alla nostra indagine, questi risultati si riveleranno. Lavoro eccellente, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2|	The agents then get closer to her, and Kirrie whispers something to the consul, handing her three more reports. Iekie turns to you once more, saying, "Enviable, your prowess at investigation is, <last>. Outstanding work, Captain."|131|0
units.english: The agents then get closer to her, and Kirrie whispers something to the consul, handing her three more reports. Iekie turns to you once more, saying, "Enviable, your prowess at investigation is, <last>. Outstanding work, Captain."
units.italian: Gli agenti poi le si avvicinano, e Kirrie sussurra qualcosa al console, consegnandole altri tre rapporti. Iekie si volta di nuovo verso di te, dicendo: "Invidiabile, la tua abilità nell'indagine è, <last>. Lavoro eccezionale, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Bonus 1|You receive a message from the Heliarch Consul Iekie as you go in for a landing. "Captain <last>! Analyzed your findings, we have. Brought light to some stolen equipment, your aid has, and for that, grateful we are. Sending a monetary bonus as thanks, I am."|146|0
units.english: You receive a message from the Heliarch Consul Iekie as you go in for a landing. "Captain <last>! Analyzed your findings, we have. Brought light to some stolen equipment, your aid has, and for that, grateful we are. Sending a monetary bonus as thanks, I am."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dal console degli Heliarchs Iekie mentre ti avvicini per atterrare. "Capitano <last>! Analizzato i tuoi risultati, noi abbiamo. Fatto luce su alcune attrezzature rubate, il tuo aiuto ha, e per questo, grati noi siamo. Inviandoti un bonus in denaro come ringraziamento, io sto."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Bonus 1|	When she finishes, <payment> are transferred to your account.|147|0
units.english: When she finishes, <payment> are transferred to your account.
units.italian: Quando ha finito, <payment> vengono trasferiti sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Bonus 2|You receive a message from the Heliarch consul Iekie as you go in for a landing. "Captain <last>! Analyzed your findings, we have. A great boon, your assistance was; located two stashes of our stolen equipment, we have. Investigating who was involved in such operations, my teams are. Very grateful for your help, we are, so sending a monetary bonus as thanks, I am."|162|0
units.english: You receive a message from the Heliarch consul Iekie as you go in for a landing. "Captain <last>! Analyzed your findings, we have. A great boon, your assistance was; located two stashes of our stolen equipment, we have. Investigating who was involved in such operations, my teams are. Very grateful for your help, we are, so sending a monetary bonus as thanks, I am."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dal console degli Heliarchs Iekie mentre ti avvicini per atterrare. "Capitano <last>! Analizzato i tuoi risultati, noi abbiamo. Un grande aiuto, la tua assistenza è stata: individuato due depositi delle nostre attrezzature rubate, noi abbiamo. Indagare su chi fosse coinvolto in tali operazioni, le mie squadre stanno. Molto grati del tuo aiuto, noi siamo, quindi inviandoti un bonus in denaro come ringraziamento, io sto."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Bonus 2|	When she finishes, <payment> are transferred to your account.|163|0
units.english: When she finishes, <payment> are transferred to your account.
units.italian: Quando ha finito, <payment> vengono trasferiti sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Bonus 3|You receive a message from the Heliarch Consul Iekie as you go in for a landing. "Captain <last>! Analyzed your findings, we have. Worry me greatly, all these stashes of stolen equipment do. Indebted to you, we are, as without your help, found all these operations, we would not have. A monetary bonus, as thanks, I am sending. Deserve it, you do, Captain."|178|0
units.english: You receive a message from the Heliarch Consul Iekie as you go in for a landing. "Captain <last>! Analyzed your findings, we have. Worry me greatly, all these stashes of stolen equipment do. Indebted to you, we are, as without your help, found all these operations, we would not have. A monetary bonus, as thanks, I am sending. Deserve it, you do, Captain."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dal console degli Heliarchs Iekie mentre ti avvicini per atterrare. "Capitano <last>! Analizzato i tuoi risultati, noi abbiamo. Preoccuparmi molto, tutti questi depositi di attrezzature rubate lo fanno. In debito con te, noi siamo, perché senza il tuo aiuto, trovate tutte queste operazioni, non le avremmo. Un bonus in denaro, come ringraziamento, sto inviando. Meriti, tu lo meriti, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Bonus 3|	When she finishes, <payment> are transferred to your account.|179|0
units.english: When she finishes, <payment> are transferred to your account.
units.italian: Quando ha finito, <payment> vengono trasferiti sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|name|183|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indagare su <planet>

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|description|184|0
units.english: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.
units.italian: Trasporta il trio degli Heliarchs a <destination> così che possano indagare su segni di attività criminale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|You arrive to a thunderstorm, as is often the norm for <planet>, and the agents go over their plans on how to best investigate the planet.|198|0
units.english: You arrive to a thunderstorm, as is often the norm for <planet>, and the agents go over their plans on how to best investigate the planet.
units.italian: Arrivi sotto un temporale, come spesso accade su <planet>, e gli agenti passano in rassegna i loro piani su come indagare al meglio il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Tugroob suggests that he pose as an Arach writer looking to find housing on the planet and scurries off to what must be a real estate office. Iplora continues with the original idea of pretending to be a tourist, saying that she will ask the young local Arachi about rumors while walking around the city, hoping to find something of use.|199|0
units.english: Tugroob suggests that he pose as an Arach writer looking to find housing on the planet and scurries off to what must be a real estate office. Iplora continues with the original idea of pretending to be a tourist, saying that she will ask the young local Arachi about rumors while walking around the city, hoping to find something of use.
units.italian: Tugroob propone di fingersi uno scrittore Arach in cerca di un alloggio sul pianeta e se ne va di corsa verso quello che deve essere un ufficio immobiliare. Iplora continua con l'idea originale di fingersi una turista, dicendo che chiederà agli Arachi del posto, i più giovani, delle voci mentre gira per la città, sperando di trovare qualcosa di utile.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	The two of them leave, and you are left with Kirrie, who has been mostly silent as his friends left your ship.|200|0
units.english: The two of them leave, and you are left with Kirrie, who has been mostly silent as his friends left your ship.
units.italian: I due se ne vanno, e tu resti con Kirrie, che è rimasto quasi in silenzio mentre i suoi amici lasciavano la nave.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	"Are you not going to follow their lead?"|202|0
units.english: "Are you not going to follow their lead?"
units.italian: "Non hai intenzione di seguire il loro esempio?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	"Have you not decided how to investigate the planet?"|203|0
units.english: "Have you not decided how to investigate the planet?"
units.italian: "Non hai ancora deciso come indagare sul pianeta?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	"Captain <last>. An edge, your human approach to these missions would give us, the consul said. Except underused, your foreign ideas are, if only the order at which we land on these planets, they are used for."|204|0
units.english: "Captain <last>. An edge, your human approach to these missions would give us, the consul said. Except underused, your foreign ideas are, if only the order at which we land on these planets, they are used for."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>. Un vantaggio, il tuo approccio umano a queste missioni ci darebbe, ha detto il console. Solo che sottoutilizzate, le tue idee straniere sono, se usate soltanto per l'ordine in cui atterriamo su questi pianeti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	He looks out to the rainy spaceport through your hatch, still open from his friends' exits. "Lead the way, would you? The warehouses, I wish to inspect, but your assistance I could use."|205|0
units.english: He looks out to the rainy spaceport through your hatch, still open from his friends' exits. "Lead the way, would you? The warehouses, I wish to inspect, but your assistance I could use."
units.italian: Guarda fuori verso lo spazioporto piovoso attraverso il tuo portello, ancora aperto dopo l'uscita dei suoi amici. "Fai strada, vuoi? I magazzini, desidero ispezionarli, ma il tuo aiuto mi servirebbe."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	"Of course, I'll get my rain coat."|207|0
units.english: "Of course, I'll get my rain coat."
units.italian: "Certo, prendo il mio impermeabile."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	"I'd rather not go out there with that rain."|208|0
units.english: "I'd rather not go out there with that rain."
units.italian: "Preferirei non uscire con questa pioggia."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You walk in a straight line for about an hour, occasionally being hit by splintering rain drops despite the cover provided by buildings and local structures. Kirrie takes you to the very edge of the town where you would be able to see the hills and mountains in the distance, were it not for the colossal rain clouds and constant downpour. One or two warehouses have a fair bit of rust on their doors, and just once you spot one with a damaged roof. You can also make out the shapes of small trees and bushes not too far out.|210|0
units.english: You walk in a straight line for about an hour, occasionally being hit by splintering rain drops despite the cover provided by buildings and local structures. Kirrie takes you to the very edge of the town where you would be able to see the hills and mountains in the distance, were it not for the colossal rain clouds and constant downpour. One or two warehouses have a fair bit of rust on their doors, and just once you spot one with a damaged roof. You can also make out the shapes of small trees and bushes not too far out.
units.italian: Camminate in linea retta per circa un'ora, colpiti ogni tanto da gocce di pioggia schizzanti nonostante la copertura degli edifici e delle strutture locali. Kirrie ti porta al margine estremo della città, dove potresti vedere le colline e le montagne in lontananza, se non fosse per le enormi nuvole di pioggia e il rovescio costante. Uno o due magazzini hanno le porte piuttosto arrugginite, e una sola volta ne scorgi uno con il tetto danneggiato. Riesci anche a distinguere le forme di piccoli alberi e cespugli poco più in là.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	"Now, Captain, start looking for something suspicious, where would you?"|211|0
units.english: "Now, Captain, start looking for something suspicious, where would you?"
units.italian: "Ora, Capitano, cominciare a cercare qualcosa di sospetto, da dove lo faresti?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Check the warehouses with the rusty doors.)|213|0
units.english: (Check the warehouses with the rusty doors.)
units.italian: (Controlla i magazzini con le porte arrugginite.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Check the warehouse with the leaking roof.)|214|0
units.english: (Check the warehouse with the leaking roof.)
units.italian: (Controlla il magazzino con il tetto che perde.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Go further out and check the trees and bushes.)|216|0
units.english: (Go further out and check the trees and bushes.)
units.italian: (Vai più in là e controlla alberi e cespugli.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Kirrie approaches the door, and it opens without him so much as touching it. Unfortunately the warehouse turns out to contain nothing of any significance. It's storage for what Kirrie says are toy parts: just mountains of plastic stacked together. You check a few more warehouses like this, but none turn out to have anything. The rain is starting to get heavier.|218|0
units.english: Kirrie approaches the door, and it opens without him so much as touching it. Unfortunately the warehouse turns out to contain nothing of any significance. It's storage for what Kirrie says are toy parts: just mountains of plastic stacked together. You check a few more warehouses like this, but none turn out to have anything. The rain is starting to get heavier.
units.italian: Kirrie si avvicina alla porta, e questa si apre senza che lui la tocchi. Purtroppo il magazzino non contiene nulla di significativo. È un deposito di quelli che Kirrie dice essere pezzi di giocattoli: solo montagne di plastica impilata. Controlli altri magazzini simili, ma nessuno contiene niente. La pioggia comincia a farsi più pesante.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Check the warehouse with the leaky roof now.)|220|0
units.english: (Check the warehouse with the leaky roof now.)
units.italian: (Controlla ora il magazzino con il tetto che perde.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Go further out and check the trees and bushes.)|222|0
units.english: (Go further out and check the trees and bushes.)
units.italian: (Vai più in là e controlla alberi e cespugli.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Leave the rest of this to Kirrie.)|224|0
units.english: (Leave the rest of this to Kirrie.)
units.italian: (Lascia il resto a Kirrie.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You apologize and tell Kirrie that you don't know what to do next. While he does agree to do it himself, he never stops asking for your opinion on his choices.|225|0
units.english: You apologize and tell Kirrie that you don't know what to do next. While he does agree to do it himself, he never stops asking for your opinion on his choices.
units.italian: Ti scusi e dici a Kirrie che non sai che cosa fare dopo. Anche se accetta di occuparsene lui, non smette mai di chiederti un parere sulle sue scelte.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You spend a few more hours looking around until the rain and the wind get too dangerous for you to be moving from warehouse to warehouse. You both take shelter in one of them until the weather settles. Once it does, it is nearly nightfall, and Kirrie is notified by Iplora that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship. You two decide to head back as well.|226|0
units.english: You spend a few more hours looking around until the rain and the wind get too dangerous for you to be moving from warehouse to warehouse. You both take shelter in one of them until the weather settles. Once it does, it is nearly nightfall, and Kirrie is notified by Iplora that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship. You two decide to head back as well.
units.italian: Passi altre ore a guardarti intorno, finché la pioggia e il vento diventano troppo pericolosi perché tu possa spostarti da un magazzino all'altro. Vi rifugiate in uno di essi finché il tempo non si calma. Quando succede è quasi notte, e Iplora avvisa Kirrie che lei e Tugroob sono già tornati alla nave. Decidete di tornare anche voi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. Exhausted, the Heliarchs get back in their bunks, asking you to depart the planet.|227|0
units.english: It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. Exhausted, the Heliarchs get back in their bunks, asking you to depart the planet.
units.italian: Sembra che Tugroob abbia trovato qualche prova di armi di contrabbando passate di qui, ma niente di rilevante. Esausti, gli Heliarchs tornano nelle cuccette e ti chiedono di lasciare il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Kirrie approaches the door and waits for a few seconds, as if expecting it to open. When it doesn't, he picks his headpiece off and fiddles with it briefly. He puts it on again and waits some more, again to no avail. "To all of these warehouses I should have access. Damaged, the door's electronics don't seem to be," he comments. He then asks you for help, looking for any manner of tools nearby so that you can force the door, while he tries to tinker with the lock. You find something akin to a crowbar, or perhaps a shovel, and bring it to him, and with some effort you two manage to angle it and pull it to pop the door open.|232|0
units.english: Kirrie approaches the door and waits for a few seconds, as if expecting it to open. When it doesn't, he picks his headpiece off and fiddles with it briefly. He puts it on again and waits some more, again to no avail. "To all of these warehouses I should have access. Damaged, the door's electronics don't seem to be," he comments. He then asks you for help, looking for any manner of tools nearby so that you can force the door, while he tries to tinker with the lock. You find something akin to a crowbar, or perhaps a shovel, and bring it to him, and with some effort you two manage to angle it and pull it to pop the door open.
units.italian: Kirrie si avvicina alla porta e aspetta qualche secondo, come se si aspettasse che si apra. Quando non succede, si toglie l'apparecchio auricolare e ci armeggia un momento. Se lo rimette e aspetta ancora, di nuovo senza risultato. "A tutti questi magazzini dovrei avere accesso. Danneggiata, l'elettronica della porta non sembra essere," commenta. Poi ti chiede aiuto, cercando qualsiasi tipo di attrezzo nei paraggi per forzare la porta, mentre lui prova a giocare con la serratura. Trovi qualcosa di simile a un piede di porco, o forse a una pala, e glielo porti: con un po' di sforzo riuscite ad angolarlo e a tirare per far scattare la porta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	At first glance there is nothing inside, but after he thoroughly crawls all over the place, he puts his head to a large metal panel on the opposite end of the room. You approach him, and again you two use the tool to bust the lock open, finding a hidden staircase leading underground.|233|0
units.english: At first glance there is nothing inside, but after he thoroughly crawls all over the place, he puts his head to a large metal panel on the opposite end of the room. You approach him, and again you two use the tool to bust the lock open, finding a hidden staircase leading underground.
units.italian: A prima vista non c'è nulla, ma dopo che ha gattonato per tutto il posto, appoggia la testa su un grande pannello metallico all'estremità opposta della stanza. Ti avvicini, e di nuovo usate l'attrezzo per forzare la serratura, trovando una scala nascosta che scende sottoterra.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	On your way down, Kirrie yells for you to take cover, and you barely escape a barrage of shots as you head back up. Kirrie isn't as lucky, as a shot hit one of his back legs just before he gets to the stairs. You go to help him up before any more shots come, but he seems to make do with five good legs well enough.|234|0
units.english: On your way down, Kirrie yells for you to take cover, and you barely escape a barrage of shots as you head back up. Kirrie isn't as lucky, as a shot hit one of his back legs just before he gets to the stairs. You go to help him up before any more shots come, but he seems to make do with five good legs well enough.
units.italian: Mentre scendete, Kirrie ti urla di metterti al riparo, e riesci a malapena a sfuggire a una raffica di colpi mentre risali. Kirrie non è altrettanto fortunato: un colpo lo colpisce a una zampa posteriore appena prima che raggiunga le scale. Ti avvicini per aiutarlo a salire prima che arrivino altri colpi, ma sembra cavarsela abbastanza bene con cinque zampe sane.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You two rush back up. Kirrie tells you to be alert and watch the staircase, as he reaches for a small radio-like device to call for support. A few minutes later, a pair of Heliarch Punishers land nearby. Dozens of armed agents enter the warehouse, while you head to one of the ships with Kirrie and wait as his wound is treated.|235|0
units.english: You two rush back up. Kirrie tells you to be alert and watch the staircase, as he reaches for a small radio-like device to call for support. A few minutes later, a pair of Heliarch Punishers land nearby. Dozens of armed agents enter the warehouse, while you head to one of the ships with Kirrie and wait as his wound is treated.
units.italian: Risalite di corsa. Kirrie ti dice di stare all'erta e di sorvegliare la scala, mentre cerca un piccolo dispositivo simile a una radio per chiamare rinforzi. Qualche minuto dopo, un paio di Punishers degli Heliarchs atterrano lì vicino. Dozzine di agenti armati entrano nel magazzino, mentre tu ti dirigi a una delle navi con Kirrie e aspetti che gli medicano la ferita.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	The agents return hours later, reporting they shot down the turrets and found the place deserted. "Many automated production lines, we found," one of them tells Kirrie. "Powering them, one of our Reactor Modules is."|236|0
units.english: The agents return hours later, reporting they shot down the turrets and found the place deserted. "Many automated production lines, we found," one of them tells Kirrie. "Powering them, one of our Reactor Modules is."
units.italian: Gli agenti tornano ore dopo, riferendo di aver abbattuto le torrette e di aver trovato il posto deserto. "Molte linee di produzione automatizzate, noi abbiamo trovato," dice uno di loro a Kirrie. "Ad alimentarle, uno dei nostri moduli reattore è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Once the local Heliarchs have the situation under control, they have a Breacher come in to pick you two up. It drops you and Kirrie closer to the <ship>, where you find Iplora and Tugroob already waiting. Kirrie suggests you depart once you all head inside, as his colleagues follow him to his bunk to hear what happened.|237|0
units.english: Once the local Heliarchs have the situation under control, they have a Breacher come in to pick you two up. It drops you and Kirrie closer to the <ship>, where you find Iplora and Tugroob already waiting. Kirrie suggests you depart once you all head inside, as his colleagues follow him to his bunk to hear what happened.
units.italian: Una volta che gli Heliarchs locali hanno la situazione sotto controllo, fanno venire un Breacher a prendervi. Vi lascia tu e Kirrie vicino alla <ship>, dove trovi Iplora e Tugroob che aspettano già. Kirrie suggerisce di partire appena siete tutti dentro, e i suoi colleghi lo seguono alla cuccetta per sentire che cosa è successo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You suggest looking for something unusual near the plant life you spotted while the rain is still fairly tame, and he follows you. You spend a few minutes looking around the trees but find nothing suspicious.|240|0
units.english: You suggest looking for something unusual near the plant life you spotted while the rain is still fairly tame, and he follows you. You spend a few minutes looking around the trees but find nothing suspicious.
units.italian: Suggerisci di cercare qualcosa di insolito vicino alla vegetazione che hai notato, finché la pioggia è ancora abbastanza clemente, e lui ti segue. Passate qualche minuto a guardare tra gli alberi ma non trovate nulla di sospetto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	While passing by another set of bushes, Kirrie notices that some of them are awkwardly tilted. Upon further inspection, he tells you that they appear to have been removed and then hastily replanted, noting the odd wavy patterns of the small rocks around the roots. The rain has gotten heavier.|241|0
units.english: While passing by another set of bushes, Kirrie notices that some of them are awkwardly tilted. Upon further inspection, he tells you that they appear to have been removed and then hastily replanted, noting the odd wavy patterns of the small rocks around the roots. The rain has gotten heavier.
units.italian: Passando accanto a un altro gruppo di cespugli, Kirrie nota che alcuni sono inclinati in modo strano. A un esame più attento, ti dice che sembrano essere stati rimossi e poi ripiantati in fretta, notando gli strani motivi ondulati dei sassolini intorno alle radici. La pioggia si è fatta più pesante.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Dig out the bushes.)|243|0
units.english: (Dig out the bushes.)
units.italian: (Tira fuori i cespugli dal terreno.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Head back to the warehouses and look around there.)|244|0
units.english: (Head back to the warehouses and look around there.)
units.italian: (Torna ai magazzini e guarda da quelle parti.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|label|246|0
units.english: bush ending
units.italian: bush ending

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You help him unearth the bushes and dig a bit more to see if there's anything under them, but you never find anything. You find some other suspicious sets of bushes, but none have anything underneath. The rain and wind become too intense to stay outside, so you head inside a warehouse and take shelter there.|247|0
units.english: You help him unearth the bushes and dig a bit more to see if there's anything under them, but you never find anything. You find some other suspicious sets of bushes, but none have anything underneath. The rain and wind become too intense to stay outside, so you head inside a warehouse and take shelter there.
units.italian: Lo aiuti a dissotterrare i cespugli e a scavare un po' di più per vedere se c'è qualcosa sotto, ma non trovate nulla. Trovate altri gruppi di cespugli sospetti, ma nessuno ha niente sotto. Pioggia e vento diventano troppo intensi per restare fuori, così entrate in un magazzino e vi rifugiate lì.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Once the weather settles near nightfall, Iplora notifies him that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship, so you two decide to return as well.|248|0
units.english: Once the weather settles near nightfall, Iplora notifies him that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship, so you two decide to return as well.
units.italian: Quando il tempo si calma verso sera, Iplora lo avvisa che lei e Tugroob sono già tornati alla nave, così decidete di tornare anche voi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. They get back in their bunks, allowing you to depart.|249|0
units.english: It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. They get back in their bunks, allowing you to depart.
units.italian: Sembra che Tugroob abbia trovato qualche prova di armi di contrabbando passate di qui, ma niente di rilevante. Tornano nelle cuccette, permettendoti di partire.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Though he wanted to try digging them out, you convince Kirrie to leave the bushes alone, and you two head back to the empty streets surrounded by the warehouses. You can barely differentiate the warehouses from earlier as the rain gets even heavier.|252|0
units.english: Though he wanted to try digging them out, you convince Kirrie to leave the bushes alone, and you two head back to the empty streets surrounded by the warehouses. You can barely differentiate the warehouses from earlier as the rain gets even heavier.
units.italian: Anche se voleva provare a dissotterrarli, convincete Kirrie a lasciare stare i cespugli, e tornate nelle strade vuote circondate dai magazzini. Riesci a malapena a distinguere i magazzini di prima, perché la pioggia si fa ancora più pesante.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Check the warehouses with the rusty doors.)|254|0
units.english: (Check the warehouses with the rusty doors.)
units.italian: (Controlla i magazzini con le porte arrugginite.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Check the warehouse with the leaky roof.)|255|0
units.english: (Check the warehouse with the leaky roof.)
units.italian: (Controlla il magazzino dal tetto gocciolante.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Kirrie approaches the door, and it opens without him as much as touching it. Unfortunately the warehouse turns out to contain nothing of any significance. It's storage for what Kirrie says are toy parts: just mountains of plastic stacked together. You check a few more like this but none turn out to have anything, and as the rain and wind become too much to walk through, you take shelter in one of the warehouses.|257|0
units.english: Kirrie approaches the door, and it opens without him as much as touching it. Unfortunately the warehouse turns out to contain nothing of any significance. It's storage for what Kirrie says are toy parts: just mountains of plastic stacked together. You check a few more like this but none turn out to have anything, and as the rain and wind become too much to walk through, you take shelter in one of the warehouses.
units.italian: Kirrie si avvicina alla porta, e questa si apre senza che lui la tocchi. Purtroppo il magazzino non contiene nulla di significativo. È un deposito di quelli che Kirrie dice essere pezzi di giocattoli: solo montagne di plastica impilata. Ne controllate altri simili ma nessuno contiene niente, e quando pioggia e vento diventano troppo forti per camminare, vi rifugiate in uno dei magazzini.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Once the weather settles near nightfall, Iplora notifies him that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship, so you two decide to return as well.|258|0
units.english: Once the weather settles near nightfall, Iplora notifies him that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship, so you two decide to return as well.
units.italian: Quando il tempo si calma verso sera, Iplora lo avvisa che lei e Tugroob sono già tornati alla nave, così decidete di tornare anche voi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. They get back in their bunks, allowing you to depart.|259|0
units.english: It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. They get back in their bunks, allowing you to depart.
units.italian: Sembra che Tugroob abbia trovato qualche prova di armi di contrabbando passate di qui, ma niente di rilevante. Tornano nelle cuccette, permettendoti di partire.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You suggest looking for something unusual near the plant life you spotted while the rain is still fairly tame, and he follows you. You spend a few minutes looking around the trees but find nothing suspicious.|262|0
units.english: You suggest looking for something unusual near the plant life you spotted while the rain is still fairly tame, and he follows you. You spend a few minutes looking around the trees but find nothing suspicious.
units.italian: Suggerisci di cercare qualcosa di insolito vicino alla vegetazione che hai notato, finché la pioggia è ancora abbastanza clemente, e lui ti segue. Passate qualche minuto a guardare tra gli alberi ma non trovate nulla di sospetto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	While passing by another set of bushes, Kirrie notices that some of them are awkwardly tilted. Upon further inspection, he tells you that they appear to have been removed and then hastily replanted, noting the odd wavy patterns of the small rocks around the roots. The rain has gotten heavier.|263|0
units.english: While passing by another set of bushes, Kirrie notices that some of them are awkwardly tilted. Upon further inspection, he tells you that they appear to have been removed and then hastily replanted, noting the odd wavy patterns of the small rocks around the roots. The rain has gotten heavier.
units.italian: Passando accanto a un altro gruppo di cespugli, Kirrie nota che alcuni sono inclinati in modo strano. A un esame più attento, ti dice che sembrano essere stati rimossi e poi ripiantati in fretta, notando gli strani motivi ondulati dei sassolini intorno alle radici. La pioggia si è fatta più pesante.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Dig out the bushes.)|265|0
units.english: (Dig out the bushes.)
units.italian: (Tira fuori i cespugli dal terreno.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	(Head back to the open warehouses and take shelter there.)|267|0
units.english: (Head back to the open warehouses and take shelter there.)
units.italian: (Torna ai magazzini aperti e riparati lì.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Though you can barely hear each other in the rain, Kirrie insists on staying there and digging through the ground for a while to see if he can find anything.|268|0
units.english: Though you can barely hear each other in the rain, Kirrie insists on staying there and digging through the ground for a while to see if he can find anything.
units.italian: Anche se riuscite a malapena a sentirvi sotto la pioggia, Kirrie insiste per restare lì e scavare nel terreno per un po', per vedere se trova qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	You walk back to the empty streets, taking care to not slip on the damp soil. You enter one of the warehouses Kirrie had previously opened and are soon joined by him. He informs you that he dug out the suspicious bushes but couldn't find anything under them.|269|0
units.english: You walk back to the empty streets, taking care to not slip on the damp soil. You enter one of the warehouses Kirrie had previously opened and are soon joined by him. He informs you that he dug out the suspicious bushes but couldn't find anything under them.
units.italian: Torni nelle strade vuote, attento a non scivolare sul terreno bagnato. Entri in uno dei magazzini che Kirrie aveva già aperto e poco dopo ti raggiunge. Ti informa che ha dissotterrato i cespugli sospetti ma non ha trovato nulla sotto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Once the weather settles near nightfall, Iplora notifies him that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship, so you two decide to return as well.|270|0
units.english: Once the weather settles near nightfall, Iplora notifies him that she and Tugroob are already back at the ship, so you two decide to return as well.
units.italian: Quando il tempo si calma verso sera, Iplora lo avvisa che lei e Tugroob sono già tornati alla nave, così decidete di tornare anche voi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. They get back in their bunks, allowing you to depart.|271|0
units.english: It seems Tugroob found some evidence of some smuggled weapons passing through here, but nothing major. They get back in their bunks, allowing you to depart.
units.italian: Sembra che Tugroob abbia trovato qualche prova di armi di contrabbando passate di qui, ma niente di rilevante. Tornano nelle cuccette, permettendoti di partire.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	Kirrie leaves you behind and you sit there on your own for a number of hours. Eventually, the trio returns, revealing that only Tugroob had found evidence of illegal activity - smuggled weapons passing through the planet.|274|0
units.english: Kirrie leaves you behind and you sit there on your own for a number of hours. Eventually, the trio returns, revealing that only Tugroob had found evidence of illegal activity - smuggled weapons passing through the planet.
units.italian: Kirrie ti lascia indietro e tu resti seduto lì per diverse ore. Alla fine il trio torna, rivelando che solo Tugroob aveva trovato prove di attività illegale: armi di contrabbando passate per il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Portion|	The three agents get back in their bunks and suggest that you depart as soon as possible.|275|0
units.english: The three agents get back in their bunks and suggest that you depart as soon as possible.
units.italian: I tre agenti tornano nelle cuccette e suggeriscono di partire il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Stronghold of Flugbu|name|278|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indagare su <planet>

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Stronghold of Flugbu|description|279|0
units.english: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.
units.italian: Trasporta il trio degli Heliarchs a <destination> così che possano indagare su segni di attività criminale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Stronghold of Flugbu|While you doubt anyone opposing the Heliarchs would find much success operating in this massive compound, it seems the strategic location held by the planet, the volume of resources invested, the fortifications available, and the sheer number of ships stationed here had it marked for investigation anyway.|293|0
units.english: While you doubt anyone opposing the Heliarchs would find much success operating in this massive compound, it seems the strategic location held by the planet, the volume of resources invested, the fortifications available, and the sheer number of ships stationed here had it marked for investigation anyway.
units.italian: Anche se dubiti che chiunque si opponga agli Heliarchs possa trovare molto successo a operare in questo enorme complesso, sembra che la posizione strategica del pianeta, il volume di risorse investite, le fortificazioni disponibili e il numero enorme di navi di stanza qui lo abbiano comunque fatto segnare per un'indagine.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Stronghold of Flugbu|	The three agents inform you that you're not allowed to enter most parts of the compound they will be headed to, so you stay inside your ship. They return right at sunset, telling you they found nothing worthwhile. "As expected," Kirrie comments with a sigh. They tell you they're ready to leave, and head to their bunks.|294|0
units.english: The three agents inform you that you're not allowed to enter most parts of the compound they will be headed to, so you stay inside your ship. They return right at sunset, telling you they found nothing worthwhile. "As expected," Kirrie comments with a sigh. They tell you they're ready to leave, and head to their bunks.
units.italian: I tre agenti ti informano che non ti è permesso entrare nella maggior parte del complesso dove si dirigeranno, così resti dentro la tua nave. Tornano al tramonto, dicendoti di non aver trovato nulla di utile. "Come previsto," commenta Kirrie con un sospiro. Ti dicono che sono pronti a partire e si dirigono alle cuccette.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|name|297|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indagare su <planet>

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|description|298|0
units.english: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.
units.italian: Trasporta il trio degli Heliarchs a <destination> così che possano indagare su segni di attività criminale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|Iplora leaves the ship immediately, disappearing into the spaceport. Tugroob and Kirrie say that she is heading to a nearby oasis.|312|0
units.english: Iplora leaves the ship immediately, disappearing into the spaceport. Tugroob and Kirrie say that she is heading to a nearby oasis.
units.italian: Iplora lascia subito la nave e sparisce nello spazioporto. Tugroob e Kirrie dicono che si sta dirigendo verso un'oasi lì vicino.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Like to connect with nature, the Saryds do. Hoping to hear rumors from the others there, she is," Kirrie explains as he also prepares to leave, claiming to know a few Heliarchs stationed here who could help him look into some reports of a local smuggler's base.|313|0
units.english: "Like to connect with nature, the Saryds do. Hoping to hear rumors from the others there, she is," Kirrie explains as he also prepares to leave, claiming to know a few Heliarchs stationed here who could help him look into some reports of a local smuggler's base.
units.italian: "Entrare in contatto con la natura, ai Saryd piace. Sperare di sentire voci dagli altri laggiù, lei sta," spiega Kirrie mentre si prepara anche lui a uscire, dicendo di conoscere alcuni Heliarchs di stanza qui che potrebbero aiutarlo a controllare alcune segnalazioni sulla base di un contrabbandiere locale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Being the last Heliarch agent in your ship, Tugroob turns to you and asks, "Assist me in my search, would you, Captain?"|314|0
units.english: Being the last Heliarch agent in your ship, Tugroob turns to you and asks, "Assist me in my search, would you, Captain?"
units.italian: Essendo l'ultimo agente degli Heliarchs nella tua nave, Tugroob si volta verso di te e chiede: "Aiutarmi nella mia ricerca, tu lo faresti, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Of course. Where are we headed?"|316|0
units.english: "Of course. Where are we headed?"
units.italian: "Certo che vengo. Dove dobbiamo andare?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Sorry, I'll have to refuse this time."|317|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'll have to refuse this time."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, questa volta devo rifiutare."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"An abandoned mining operation, our target is. Received we have reports of suspicious activity near the complex - recently headed there some ships were, even though shut down for years the mine has been," he explains. You input the coordinates he gives you into your navigator.|319|0
units.english: "An abandoned mining operation, our target is. Received we have reports of suspicious activity near the complex - recently headed there some ships were, even though shut down for years the mine has been," he explains. You input the coordinates he gives you into your navigator.
units.italian: "Un'operazione mineraria abbandonata, il nostro obiettivo è. Ricevuto abbiamo segnalazioni di attività sospette vicino al complesso: di recente dirette là alcune navi sono, anche se chiusa da anni la miniera è," spiega. Inserisci le coordinate che ti dà nel navigatore.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You come to the remains of a gargantuan mining operation, an enormous hole torn into the planet's crust, spiralling down to what must be nearly a kilometer below the otherwise relatively untouched surface. Near the edge, you spot a medium-sized building, made up of a few interconnected blocks and dirtied up by the planet's sand. Tugroob tells you it must have been the base for the mine workers and managing team when the mine was active.|320|0
units.english: You come to the remains of a gargantuan mining operation, an enormous hole torn into the planet's crust, spiralling down to what must be nearly a kilometer below the otherwise relatively untouched surface. Near the edge, you spot a medium-sized building, made up of a few interconnected blocks and dirtied up by the planet's sand. Tugroob tells you it must have been the base for the mine workers and managing team when the mine was active.
units.italian: Arrivi ai resti di un'operazione mineraria gigantesca, un enorme buco strappato nella crosta del pianeta, che scende a spirale fino a quasi un chilometro sotto una superficie per il resto relativamente intatta. Vicino al bordo scorgi un edificio di medie dimensioni, fatto di alcuni blocchi interconnessi e sporcato dalla sabbia del pianeta. Tugroob dice che doveva essere la base dei minatori e della squadra di gestione quando la miniera era attiva.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Close to the building, farther out from the digging hole, you see a few landing pads of large enough size for even the bulkiest of freighters, likely once used by spacecraft that would ship the raw ore off to smelting facilities. You land on one of them, and you and Tugroob leave your ship. As you step off the landing pad, Tugroob calls your attention to a desert storm brewing in the distance, and says you two should get started before it reaches here.|321|0
units.english: Close to the building, farther out from the digging hole, you see a few landing pads of large enough size for even the bulkiest of freighters, likely once used by spacecraft that would ship the raw ore off to smelting facilities. You land on one of them, and you and Tugroob leave your ship. As you step off the landing pad, Tugroob calls your attention to a desert storm brewing in the distance, and says you two should get started before it reaches here.
units.italian: Vicino all'edificio, più lontano dalla fossa di scavo, vedi alcune piazzole di atterraggio abbastanza grandi anche per i più massicci trasporti, usate probabilmente un tempo da navi che portavano il minerale grezzo agli impianti di fusione. Atterri su una di esse, e tu e Tugroob uscite dalla nave. Appena scendi dalla piazzola, Tugroob attira la tua attenzione su una tempesta di sabbia che si addensa in lontananza, e dice che dovreste cominciare prima che arrivi qui.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Let's check out the building."|323|0
units.english: "Let's check out the building."
units.italian: "Diamo un'occhiata all'edificio."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Maybe we should try heading down the mining hole."|324|0
units.english: "Maybe we should try heading down the mining hole."
units.italian: "Forse dovremmo provare a scendere nella fossa della miniera."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Having been left alone for years, the base for the mining operation no longer has any power. Tugroob has to force the door, gripping the walls and pulling hard with his front legs until it slides open.|326|0
units.english: Having been left alone for years, the base for the mining operation no longer has any power. Tugroob has to force the door, gripping the walls and pulling hard with his front legs until it slides open.
units.italian: Lasciata sola per anni, la base dell'operazione mineraria non ha più corrente. Tugroob deve forzare la porta, aggrappandosi alle pareti e tirando con forza con le zampe anteriori finché non si apre.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	The place is surprisingly tidy, if dusty near the door with what sand has been let in. Despite the relative cleanliness, it's evident that the previous owners didn't bother cleaning out before packing up and leaving. Various cabinets, archives and work stations dominate the initial room, and you can see it connects to a collective bedroom, filled with bunks and a storage area.|327|0
units.english: The place is surprisingly tidy, if dusty near the door with what sand has been let in. Despite the relative cleanliness, it's evident that the previous owners didn't bother cleaning out before packing up and leaving. Various cabinets, archives and work stations dominate the initial room, and you can see it connects to a collective bedroom, filled with bunks and a storage area.
units.italian: Il posto è sorprendentemente ordinato, anche se polveroso vicino alla porta per la sabbia entrata. Nonostante la relativa pulizia, è evidente che i precedenti proprietari non si sono presi la briga di svuotare tutto prima di fare i bagagli e andarsene. Vari armadi, archivi e postazioni di lavoro dominano la prima stanza, e si vede che comunica con una camerata comune, piena di cuccette, e con un'area di deposito.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"No other entrances there seem to be. If hiding anything here, others were, force their way in they had to, just like us," Tugroob says.|328|0
units.english: "No other entrances there seem to be. If hiding anything here, others were, force their way in they had to, just like us," Tugroob says.
units.italian: "Nessun altro ingresso qui sembra esserci. Se nascondere qualcosa qui, altri lo stavano facendo, forzare l'ingresso hanno dovuto, proprio come noi," dice Tugroob.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Doesn't look like anyone's been in here in a while. Let's check the mining hole."|330|0
units.english: "Doesn't look like anyone's been in here in a while. Let's check the mining hole."
units.italian: "Non sembra che qualcuno sia entrato qui da un pezzo. Controlliamo la fossa della miniera."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"There might be something hidden here. Let's look around."|332|0
units.english: "There might be something hidden here. Let's look around."
units.italian: "Potrebbe esserci qualcosa di nascosto qui. Guardiamoci intorno."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You two go about checking every drawer, archive and boxes of all sizes in the first room, but only end up finding a few scattered documents related to the mine, and some old doodles made by what must have been very bored workers. Tugroob tries to get the computers on, but no manner of tinkering brings any electricity to them. The building really is completely out of power.|333|0
units.english: You two go about checking every drawer, archive and boxes of all sizes in the first room, but only end up finding a few scattered documents related to the mine, and some old doodles made by what must have been very bored workers. Tugroob tries to get the computers on, but no manner of tinkering brings any electricity to them. The building really is completely out of power.
units.italian: Frugate ogni cassetto, archivio e scatola di ogni dimensione nella prima stanza, ma finita trovate solo qualche documento sparso relativo alla miniera e alcuni vecchi scarabocchi fatti da quelli che dovevano essere operai molto annoiati. Tugroob prova ad accendere i computer, ma nessun armeggiare gli restituisce corrente. L'edificio è davvero completamente senza energia.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Find nothing here we will, Captain," Tugroob says, looking out the door at the approaching sandstorm.|334|0
units.english: "Find nothing here we will, Captain," Tugroob says, looking out the door at the approaching sandstorm.
units.italian: "Non trovare nulla qui, noi lo faremo, Capitano," dice Tugroob, guardando fuori dalla porta la tempesta di sabbia che avanza.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Sorry, let's go outside and check that hole while we can."|336|0
units.english: "Sorry, let's go outside and check that hole while we can."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, usciamo e controlliamo quella fossa finché possiamo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Hold on. Let's try the other rooms."|338|0
units.english: "Hold on. Let's try the other rooms."
units.italian: "Aspetta. Proviamo le altre stanze."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You head to the dormitories while Tugroob quickly works his way through what remains in the storage. You check under and over all the beds, looking for anything that might be out of the ordinary, but find nothing. The bedroom leads to two larger modules of the building: one for the restrooms, and the other for a dining area, but after searching these areas you again emerge empty-handed.|339|0
units.english: You head to the dormitories while Tugroob quickly works his way through what remains in the storage. You check under and over all the beds, looking for anything that might be out of the ordinary, but find nothing. The bedroom leads to two larger modules of the building: one for the restrooms, and the other for a dining area, but after searching these areas you again emerge empty-handed.
units.italian: Ti dirigi verso i dormitori mentre Tugroob setaccia rapidamente ciò che resta nel deposito. Controlli sotto e sopra tutti i letti, cercando qualcosa di fuori dall'ordinario, ma non trovi nulla. La camerata porta a due moduli più grandi dell'edificio: uno per i bagni e l'altro per una zona pranzo, ma dopo aver perquisito anche queste aree esci di nuovo a mani vuote.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Tugroob comes to meet you, having finished with the storage, and reporting that he too found nothing of note. You two try to leave, but the storm has finally arrived, and so you decide to wait it out inside.|340|0
units.english: Tugroob comes to meet you, having finished with the storage, and reporting that he too found nothing of note. You two try to leave, but the storm has finally arrived, and so you decide to wait it out inside.
units.italian: Tugroob ti viene incontro, finito con il deposito, e riferisce che anche lui non ha trovato nulla di rilevante. Provate a uscire, ma la tempesta è finalmente arrivata, così decidete di aspettare dentro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You two begin your descent down the mine, but with a step outside it's clear the storm's caught up to you. You still attempt to move to the hole, but the raging sand makes it too difficult to even find a way to start heading down safely. You two head back inside to wait for better visibility.|343|0
units.english: You two begin your descent down the mine, but with a step outside it's clear the storm's caught up to you. You still attempt to move to the hole, but the raging sand makes it too difficult to even find a way to start heading down safely. You two head back inside to wait for better visibility.
units.italian: Cominciate la discesa nella miniera, ma appena fuori è chiaro che la tempesta vi ha raggiunti. Provate comunque a raggiungere la fossa, ma la sabbia scatenata rende troppo difficile persino trovare un modo per scendere in sicurezza. Rientrate per aspettare una visibilità migliore.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You two approach the hole, and finding one of the many ramps leading down the spiral, carefully make your way down. You pass by some large mining vehicles, akin to very large trucks with thick tracks instead of wheels, and many bores and drills at the front. Tugroob explains they are used to open up tunnels that extend outwards from the main dig hole, to reach lesser mineral deposits without needing to excavate needlessly.|346|0
units.english: You two approach the hole, and finding one of the many ramps leading down the spiral, carefully make your way down.
