You pass by some large mining vehicles, akin to very large trucks with thick tracks instead of wheels, and many bores and drills at the front. Tugroob explains they are used to open up tunnels that extend outwards from the main dig hole, to reach lesser mineral deposits without needing to excavate needlessly.
units.italian: Vi avvicinate alla fossa e, trovata una delle molte rampe che scendono a spirale, scendete con cautela. Passate accanto ad alcuni grandi veicoli minerari, simili a camion molto grandi con cingoli spessi al posto delle ruote e molti trivellatori e punte davanti. Tugroob spiega che servono ad aprire gallerie che si estendono verso l'esterno dalla fossa principale, per raggiungere i depositi minerali minori senza dover scavare inutilmente.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Continuing on your way down, he points to some of the holes made by the machines, and to many more vehicles near the bottom.|347|0
units.english: Continuing on your way down, he points to some of the holes made by the machines, and to many more vehicles near the bottom.
units.italian: Continuando a scendere, ti indica alcuni dei buchi fatti dalle macchine e molti altri veicoli vicino al fondo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	(Keep going down.)|349|0
units.english: (Keep going down.)
units.italian: (Continua a scendere.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	(Investigate the nearby vehicles and tunnels.)|350|0
units.english: (Investigate the nearby vehicles and tunnels.)
units.italian: (Ispeziona i veicoli e le gallerie vicine.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You two speed up as you continue plunging down the mine, and as you're about a quarter of the way down you can see the bottom more clearly. Over the years, it seems the local storms have been filling it up with sand, and with the operation inactive, nobody's bothered clearing it out. The sand's not enough to have reached the larger mining machines, but you suspect even they'll be covered completely in the coming years.|352|0
units.english: You two speed up as you continue plunging down the mine, and as you're about a quarter of the way down you can see the bottom more clearly. Over the years, it seems the local storms have been filling it up with sand, and with the operation inactive, nobody's bothered clearing it out. The sand's not enough to have reached the larger mining machines, but you suspect even they'll be covered completely in the coming years.
units.italian: Accelerate mentre continuate a scendere nella miniera, e quando siete circa a un quarto della discesa riuscite a vedere meglio il fondo. Nel corso degli anni, sembra che le tempeste locali lo abbiano riempito di sabbia, e con l'operazione ferma nessuno si è preso la briga di svuotarlo. La sabbia non è abbastanza da aver raggiunto le grandi macchine minerarie, ma sospetti che anche loro verranno coperte del tutto nei prossimi anni.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Tugroob stops you at one point, taking your attention to the top of the hole. The clear sky is growing darker, and you can see the wind picking up and launching some smaller rocks down. "Much time we have not, Captain. Search we cannot amidst a sandstorm, and reach in time the bottom we will not."|353|0
units.english: Tugroob stops you at one point, taking your attention to the top of the hole. The clear sky is growing darker, and you can see the wind picking up and launching some smaller rocks down. "Much time we have not, Captain. Search we cannot amidst a sandstorm, and reach in time the bottom we will not."
units.italian: Tugroob ti ferma a un certo punto, attirando la tua attenzione verso la cima della fossa. Il cielo limpido si sta facendo più scuro, e vedi il vento alzarsi e lanciare giù alcuni sassolini. "Molto tempo noi non abbiamo, Capitano. Cercare non possiamo in mezzo a una tempesta di sabbia, e raggiungere in tempo il fondo noi non riusciremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	(Try and investigate the vehicles and tunnels to the sides instead.)|355|0
units.english: (Try and investigate the vehicles and tunnels to the sides instead.)
units.italian: (Prova invece a ispezionare i veicoli e le gallerie ai lati.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	(Head back up and investigate the building.)|357|0
units.english: (Head back up and investigate the building.)
units.italian: (Torna su e ispeziona l'edificio.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You two rush back up. Tugroob helps you save some time by climbing one of the walls straight up as you cling to him, rather than following the spiraling ramps. You reach the building a few minutes before the storm engulfs it and covers the dig hole completely. As it has no power, Tugroob has to force the door open, gripping to the walls and pulling hard with his front legs until it slides open.|358|0
units.english: You two rush back up. Tugroob helps you save some time by climbing one of the walls straight up as you cling to him, rather than following the spiraling ramps. You reach the building a few minutes before the storm engulfs it and covers the dig hole completely. As it has no power, Tugroob has to force the door open, gripping to the walls and pulling hard with his front legs until it slides open.
units.italian: Risalite di corsa. Tugroob ti fa risparmiare tempo arrampicandosi dritto su una delle pareti mentre tu ti aggrappi a lui, invece di seguire le rampe a spirale. Raggiungete l'edificio pochi minuti prima che la tempesta lo inghiotta e copra del tutto la fossa di scavo. Non avendo corrente, Tugroob deve forzare la porta, aggrappandosi alle pareti e tirando con forza con le zampe anteriori finché non si apre.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	The place is surprisingly tidy, if dusty near the door with what sand has been let in. Despite the relative cleanliness, it's evident that the previous owners didn't bother cleaning out before packing up and leaving. Various cabinets, archives and work stations dominate the initial room, and you can see it connects to a collective bedroom, filled with bunks and a storage area.|359|0
units.english: The place is surprisingly tidy, if dusty near the door with what sand has been let in. Despite the relative cleanliness, it's evident that the previous owners didn't bother cleaning out before packing up and leaving. Various cabinets, archives and work stations dominate the initial room, and you can see it connects to a collective bedroom, filled with bunks and a storage area.
units.italian: Il posto è sorprendentemente ordinato, anche se polveroso vicino alla porta per la sabbia entrata. Nonostante la relativa pulizia, è evidente che i precedenti proprietari non si sono presi la briga di svuotare tutto prima di fare i bagagli e andarsene. Vari armadi, archivi e postazioni di lavoro dominano la prima stanza, e si vede che comunica con una camerata comune, piena di cuccette, e con un'area di deposito.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"No other entrances there seem to be. If hiding anything here, others were, force their way in they had to, just like us," Tugroob says.|360|0
units.english: "No other entrances there seem to be. If hiding anything here, others were, force their way in they had to, just like us," Tugroob says.
units.italian: "Nessun altro ingresso qui sembra esserci. Se nascondere qualcosa qui, altri lo stavano facendo, forzare l'ingresso hanno dovuto, proprio come noi," dice Tugroob.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Given the storm's trapped you in, you two turn over every drawer, archive and box, look over everything in the storage area, try and get the computers to work, and even check the bedroom and its connecting dining area and restrooms, all to no avail. Your search doesn't bear fruit, and so you're left waiting inside as the storm rages around the building.|361|0
units.english: Given the storm's trapped you in, you two turn over every drawer, archive and box, look over everything in the storage area, try and get the computers to work, and even check the bedroom and its connecting dining area and restrooms, all to no avail. Your search doesn't bear fruit, and so you're left waiting inside as the storm rages around the building.
units.italian: Visto che la tempesta vi ha intrappolati, rovistate ogni cassetto, archivio e scatola, controllate tutto nell'area di deposito, provate a far funzionare i computer e ispezionate persino la camerata con la zona pranzo e i bagni collegati, tutto inutilmente. La ricerca non dà frutti, e restate ad aspettare dentro mentre la tempesta infuria intorno all'edificio.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	As Tugroob is more familiar with the vehicles than you are, he checks them before joining you in exploring the tunnels dug into the sides of the mining hole. The holes mostly head in straight lines down, forming straightforward paths to where the lesser ore veins were.|366|0
units.english: As Tugroob is more familiar with the vehicles than you are, he checks them before joining you in exploring the tunnels dug into the sides of the mining hole. The holes mostly head in straight lines down, forming straightforward paths to where the lesser ore veins were.
units.italian: Dato che Tugroob conosce i veicoli meglio di te, li controlla prima di unirsi a te nell'esplorare le gallerie scavate nei fianchi della fossa mineraria. I buchi scendono per lo più in linea retta, formando percorsi semplici verso dove si trovavano i filoni minerali minori.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	The sand continues to pile up into the mine hole when you two come to a vehicle that wasn't driven back fully, and is still blocking the entrance to its tunnel. Tugroob climbs up to see if there's any way to crawl inside, but he is surprised upon checking the driving controls: it's still operational. He drives it back, opening up the hole, and you two go in.|367|0
units.english: The sand continues to pile up into the mine hole when you two come to a vehicle that wasn't driven back fully, and is still blocking the entrance to its tunnel. Tugroob climbs up to see if there's any way to crawl inside, but he is surprised upon checking the driving controls: it's still operational. He drives it back, opening up the hole, and you two go in.
units.italian: La sabbia continua ad accumularsi nella fossa quando arrivate a un veicolo che non è stato riportato del tutto indietro e blocca ancora l'ingresso della sua galleria. Tugroob si arrampica per vedere se c'è un modo di infilarsi dentro, ma resta sorpreso quando controlla i comandi di guida: è ancora funzionante. Lo guida indietro, aprendo il buco, e voi due entrate.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Lighting the way ahead with your flashlight, you're surprised to see this tunnel is dug slightly upwards, and brings you not to a large, dug out ore vein spot, but to a rustic mineshaft. A few lights on the walls flicker on as you approach them, lighting up the wooden beams supporting the long hallway. Before you go further inside, you're stopped by Tugroob, who crawls around the floor, walls and ceiling just before the first lamp, looping several times without ever going further in. He only stops to slowly reach one leg inside, then right back out after apparently touching something.|368|0
units.english: Lighting the way ahead with your flashlight, you're surprised to see this tunnel is dug slightly upwards, and brings you not to a large, dug out ore vein spot, but to a rustic mineshaft. A few lights on the walls flicker on as you approach them, lighting up the wooden beams supporting the long hallway. Before you go further inside, you're stopped by Tugroob, who crawls around the floor, walls and ceiling just before the first lamp, looping several times without ever going further in. He only stops to slowly reach one leg inside, then right back out after apparently touching something.
units.italian: Illuminando la strada davanti con la torcia, resti sorpreso nel vedere che questa galleria scava leggermente verso l'alto e non ti porta a un grande punto di estrazione del minerale, ma a un rustico pozzo di miniera. Alcune luci sulle pareti si accendono tremolando quando vi avvicinate, illuminando le travi di legno che sostengono il lungo corridoio. Prima di andare oltre, Tugroob ti ferma: gattona intorno al pavimento, alle pareti e al soffitto appena prima della prima lampada, facendo diversi giri senza mai andare più a fondo. Si ferma solo per allungare lentamente una zampa dentro, e ritirarla subito dopo aver toccato qualcosa, a quanto pare.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"Request support equipment to get through safely, we must," he says, and using a communication device, he calls for assistance from Heliarch agents, warning them about the sandstorm. You head back up to the building to wait for them.|369|0
units.english: "Request support equipment to get through safely, we must," he says, and using a communication device, he calls for assistance from Heliarch agents, warning them about the sandstorm. You head back up to the building to wait for them.
units.italian: "Richiedere attrezzatura di supporto per passare in sicurezza, noi dobbiamo," dice, e usando un dispositivo di comunicazione chiama assistenza dagli agenti degli Heliarchs, avvertendoli della tempesta di sabbia. Tornate su all'edificio ad aspettarli.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Shortly after, several dozen Heliarch agents arrive. Most of them work to keep the sand out, while a few follow you two down and inside the peculiar tunnel, bringing some form of cutting tool and several pieces of sensor equipment. After checking with the sensors for a few minutes, they use the tool to surgically remove what Tugroob was slowly examining before: several extremely thin wires, connected to some type of machinery hidden within the wooden beams.|370|0
units.english: Shortly after, several dozen Heliarch agents arrive. Most of them work to keep the sand out, while a few follow you two down and inside the peculiar tunnel, bringing some form of cutting tool and several pieces of sensor equipment. After checking with the sensors for a few minutes, they use the tool to surgically remove what Tugroob was slowly examining before: several extremely thin wires, connected to some type of machinery hidden within the wooden beams.
units.italian: Poco dopo arrivano diverse dozzine di agenti degli Heliarchs. Molti lavorano per tenere fuori la sabbia, mentre alcuni seguono voi due giù dentro la strana galleria, portando una specie di strumento da taglio e diversi apparecchi di rilevamento. Dopo aver controllato con i sensori per qualche minuto, usano lo strumento per rimuovere con precisione chirurgica ciò che Tugroob stava esaminando piano: diversi fili estremamente sottili, collegati a un qualche tipo di macchinario nascosto dentro le travi di legno.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	After they're done, the agents storm the place but find nobody. What they do find are dozens upon dozens of crates filled to the brim with Heliarch staves, blaster guns, riot gear, and other weaponry.|371|0
units.english: After they're done, the agents storm the place but find nobody. What they do find are dozens upon dozens of crates filled to the brim with Heliarch staves, blaster guns, riot gear, and other weaponry.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito, gli agenti irrompono nel posto ma non trovano nessuno. Quello che trovano sono dozzine e dozzine di casse piene zeppe di bastoni degli Heliarchs, pistole blaster, equipaggiamento antisommossa e altre armi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	They escort you and Tugroob back outside as the agents prepare to bring the smuggled weapons to their own ships. Though the storm is still raging on, you can make out the shape of a few Heliarch Interdictors parked near your own ship right before you take off. You regroup with Iplora and Kirrie, and they ask Tugroob for more details on the ordeal before they head to their own bunks.|372|0
units.english: They escort you and Tugroob back outside as the agents prepare to bring the smuggled weapons to their own ships. Though the storm is still raging on, you can make out the shape of a few Heliarch Interdictors parked near your own ship right before you take off. You regroup with Iplora and Kirrie, and they ask Tugroob for more details on the ordeal before they head to their own bunks.
units.italian: Ti scortano fuori insieme a Tugroob mentre gli agenti si preparano a portare le armi di contrabbando sulle loro navi. Anche se la tempesta infuria ancora, riesci a distinguere la sagoma di alcuni Interdictors degli Heliarchs parcheggiati vicino alla tua nave subito prima di decollare. Vi riunite a Iplora e Kirrie, che chiedono a Tugroob più dettagli sul calvario prima di andare alle loro cuccette.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You two exit the building and approach the hole, find one of the many ramps leading down the spiral, and carefully make your way down. You pass by some large mining vehicles, akin to very large trucks with thick tracks instead of wheels, and many bores and drills at the front. Tugroob explains they are used to open up tunnels that extend outwards from the main dig hole, to reach lesser mineral deposits without needing to excavate needlessly.|375|0
units.english: You two exit the building and approach the hole, find one of the many ramps leading down the spiral, and carefully make your way down. You pass by some large mining vehicles, akin to very large trucks with thick tracks instead of wheels, and many bores and drills at the front. Tugroob explains they are used to open up tunnels that extend outwards from the main dig hole, to reach lesser mineral deposits without needing to excavate needlessly.
units.italian: Uscite dall'edificio e vi avvicinate alla fossa; trovata una delle molte rampe che scendono a spirale, scendete con cautela. Passate accanto ad alcuni grandi veicoli minerari, simili a camion molto grandi con cingoli spessi al posto delle ruote e molti trivellatori e punte davanti. Tugroob spiega che servono ad aprire gallerie che si estendono verso l'esterno dalla fossa principale, per raggiungere i depositi minerali minori senza dover scavare inutilmente.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Continuing on your way down, he points to some of the holes made by the machines, and to many more vehicles deep down near the bottom.|376|0
units.english: Continuing on your way down, he points to some of the holes made by the machines, and to many more vehicles deep down near the bottom.
units.italian: Continuando a scendere, ti indica alcuni dei buchi fatti dalle macchine e molti altri veicoli in fondo, più giù.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	(Keep going down.)|378|0
units.english: (Keep going down.)
units.italian: (Continua a scendere.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	(Investigate the nearby vehicles and tunnels.)|379|0
units.english: (Investigate the nearby vehicles and tunnels.)
units.italian: (Ispeziona i veicoli e le gallerie vicine.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	You two speed up as you continue plunging down the mine, and as you're about a quarter of the way down you can see the bottom clearer. Over the years, it seems the local storms have been filling it up with sand, and with the operation inactive, nobody's bothered clearing it out. The sand's not enough to have reached the larger mining machines, but you suspect even they'll be covered completely in the coming years.|381|0
units.english: You two speed up as you continue plunging down the mine, and as you're about a quarter of the way down you can see the bottom clearer. Over the years, it seems the local storms have been filling it up with sand, and with the operation inactive, nobody's bothered clearing it out. The sand's not enough to have reached the larger mining machines, but you suspect even they'll be covered completely in the coming years.
units.italian: Accelerate mentre continuate a scendere nella miniera, e quando siete circa a un quarto della discesa riuscite a vedere il fondo con più chiarezza. Nel corso degli anni, sembra che le tempeste locali lo abbiano riempito di sabbia, e con l'operazione ferma nessuno si è preso la briga di svuotarlo. La sabbia non è abbastanza da aver raggiunto le grandi macchine minerarie, ma sospetti che anche loro verranno coperte del tutto nei prossimi anni.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Tugroob stops you at one point, taking your attention to the top of the hole. The clear sky has grown much darker, with the storm clouds covering most of it, and you can see the wind's picked up and is launching many smaller rocks down. All the while more and more sand seeps into the hole. "Leave we must, Captain. Search we cannot amidst a sandstorm, and reach in time the bottom we will not."|382|0
units.english: Tugroob stops you at one point, taking your attention to the top of the hole. The clear sky has grown much darker, with the storm clouds covering most of it, and you can see the wind's picked up and is launching many smaller rocks down. All the while more and more sand seeps into the hole. "Leave we must, Captain. Search we cannot amidst a sandstorm, and reach in time the bottom we will not."
units.italian: Tugroob ti ferma a un certo punto, attirando la tua attenzione verso la cima della fossa. Il cielo limpido si è fatto molto più scuro, con le nuvole della tempesta che ne coprono la maggior parte, e vedi che il vento si è alzato e sta lanciando giù molti sassolini. Intanto sempre più sabbia filtra nella fossa. "Andare noi dobbiamo, Capitano. Cercare non possiamo in mezzo a una tempesta di sabbia, e raggiungere in tempo il fondo noi non riusciremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	To save time and avoid the long spiraling ramps, you cling to Tugroob as he cuts his way up the hole, climbing its walls while carefully avoiding the rocks and falling sand. You barely reach the building before the storm fully engulfs the mine, and decide to wait there. While you wait, you and Tugroob search around more but ultimately find nothing.|383|0
units.english: To save time and avoid the long spiraling ramps, you cling to Tugroob as he cuts his way up the hole, climbing its walls while carefully avoiding the rocks and falling sand. You barely reach the building before the storm fully engulfs the mine, and decide to wait there. While you wait, you and Tugroob search around more but ultimately find nothing.
units.italian: Per risparmiare tempo ed evitare le lunghe rampe a spirale, ti aggrappi a Tugroob mentre si apre la strada risalendo la fossa, arrampicandosi sulle pareti ed evitando con cura i sassi e la sabbia che cade. Raggiungete a malapena l'edificio prima che la tempesta inghiotta del tutto la miniera, e decidete di aspettare lì. Mentre aspettate, tu e Tugroob perquisite ancora un po' ma alla fine non trovate nulla.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Night falls with no sign of the storm dying down, and after receiving a notification from Iplora, Tugroob informs you that you should both head back to the ship and pick her and Kirrie up. As soon as the storm lets up slightly, he helps you out of the building and through the raging winds, until you reach your ship. You two meet up with the rest of the group, and the agents head to their bunks.|385|0
units.english: Night falls with no sign of the storm dying down, and after receiving a notification from Iplora, Tugroob informs you that you should both head back to the ship and pick her and Kirrie up. As soon as the storm lets up slightly, he helps you out of the building and through the raging winds, until you reach your ship. You two meet up with the rest of the group, and the agents head to their bunks.
units.italian: Scende la notte senza segno che la tempesta si plachi, e dopo una notifica di Iplora Tugroob ti informa che dovreste tornare alla nave a prendere lei e Kirrie. Appena la tempesta si attenua un poco, ti aiuta a uscire dall'edificio e ad attraversare i venti scatenati, finché non raggiungete la nave. Vi riunite al resto del gruppo, e gli agenti si dirigono alle cuccette.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	"I see," he says. He gives you the coordinates he needs to go to and you drop him off before returning to the hangars.|388|0
units.english: "I see," he says. He gives you the coordinates he needs to go to and you drop him off before returning to the hangars.
units.italian: "Capisco," dice. Ti dà le coordinate dove deve andare e lo lasci lì prima di tornare agli hangar.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand|	Kirrie and Iplora come back hours later and contact Tugroob, who says you can pick him up where you left him. Once he's back in your ship, he tells you he found nothing worthwhile.|389|0
units.english: Kirrie and Iplora come back hours later and contact Tugroob, who says you can pick him up where you left him. Once he's back in your ship, he tells you he found nothing worthwhile.
units.italian: Kirrie e Iplora tornano ore dopo e contattano Tugroob, che dice che puoi prenderlo dove l'hai lasciato. Una volta tornato nella tua nave, ti dice che non ha trovato nulla di utile.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow|name|392|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indagare su <planet>

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow|description|393|0
units.english: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.
units.italian: Trasporta il trio degli Heliarchs a <destination> così che possano indagare su segni di attività criminale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow|For this planet, the trio informs you that they cannot spend too much time in one place considering how densely populated it is. Instead, they hand you the coordinates of dozens of factories, with instructions to take them to each factory in whichever order you'd prefer.|407|0
units.english: For this planet, the trio informs you that they cannot spend too much time in one place considering how densely populated it is. Instead, they hand you the coordinates of dozens of factories, with instructions to take them to each factory in whichever order you'd prefer.
units.italian: Per questo pianeta, il trio ti informa che non possono passare troppo tempo in un solo posto, vista la densità di popolazione. Ti consegnano invece le coordinate di dozzine di fabbriche, con l'istruzione di portarli in ciascuna nell'ordine che preferisci.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow|	"Surprise inspections, we shall perform," Kirrie says as the three prepare their equipment and weapons. You spend hours flying around the planet dropping one agent off in a factory, flying off to another, then another, then picking up the first of the three in a seemingly endless cycle.|408|0
units.english: "Surprise inspections, we shall perform," Kirrie says as the three prepare their equipment and weapons. You spend hours flying around the planet dropping one agent off in a factory, flying off to another, then another, then picking up the first of the three in a seemingly endless cycle.
units.italian: "Ispezioni a sorpresa, noi faremo," dice Kirrie mentre i tre preparano attrezzature e armi. Passi ore a volare intorno al pianeta lasciando un agente in una fabbrica, volando a un'altra, poi a un'altra, poi riprendendo il primo dei tre in un ciclo apparentemente infinito.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow|	After picking up Tugroob from the last factory, they all analyze their findings one last time. They do this by going over each individual factory, mechanically running down a long list of "possible abnormalities" for each, leaving a mark on the side, and briefly writing a description if any such "abnormality" was noted in a factory.|409|0
units.english: After picking up Tugroob from the last factory, they all analyze their findings one last time. They do this by going over each individual factory, mechanically running down a long list of "possible abnormalities" for each, leaving a mark on the side, and briefly writing a description if any such "abnormality" was noted in a factory.
units.italian: Dopo aver ripreso Tugroob dall'ultima fabbrica, analizzano un'ultima volta i loro risultati. Lo fanno passando in rassegna ogni singola fabbrica, scorrendo meccanicamente una lunga lista di "possibili anomalie" per ciascuna, mettendo un segno a lato e scrivendo brevemente una descrizione se qualche tale "anomalia" è stata notata in una fabbrica.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow|	"Unauthorized power surges to some replicators, we found. Missing as well, some records of storage transport were," Iplora says. You land on a Heliarch base, and they hand a copy of their findings to the Heliarchs stationed there before returning to your ship. As they head to their bunks, you see several Heliarch ships fly off in the direction of some of the factories.|410|0
units.english: "Unauthorized power surges to some replicators, we found. Missing as well, some records of storage transport were," Iplora says. You land on a Heliarch base, and they hand a copy of their findings to the Heliarchs stationed there before returning to your ship. As they head to their bunks, you see several Heliarch ships fly off in the direction of some of the factories.
units.italian: "Picchi di corrente non autorizzati su alcuni replicatori, noi abbiamo trovato. Mancanti anche, alcuni registri dei trasporti di deposito erano," dice Iplora. Atterrate su una base degli Heliarchs, e consegnano una copia dei loro risultati agli Heliarchs di stanza lì prima di tornare alla tua nave. Mentre si dirigono alle cuccette, vedi diverse navi degli Heliarchs partire in direzione di alcune delle fabbriche.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|name|413|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indagare su <planet>

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|description|414|0
units.english: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.
units.italian: Trasporta il trio degli Heliarchs a <destination> così che possano indagare su segni di attività criminale.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|Kirrie, already donning his winter coat, instructs you to land near the equator. He says him and Tugroob will conduct some subtle interrogations, stating that it's 'all they can do' in this climate.|428|0
units.english: Kirrie, already donning his winter coat, instructs you to land near the equator. He says him and Tugroob will conduct some subtle interrogations, stating that it's 'all they can do' in this climate.
units.italian: Kirrie, già con addosso il cappotto invernale, ti ordina di atterrare vicino all'equatore. Dice che lui e Tugroob condurranno qualche interrogatorio discreto, affermando che è 'tutto quello che possono fare' con questo clima.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You drop them off in one of the larger settlements there. After they leave, Iplora asks that you bring her close to the southern pole of the planet.|429|0
units.english: You drop them off in one of the larger settlements there. After they leave, Iplora asks that you bring her close to the southern pole of the planet.
units.italian: Li lasci in uno degli insediamenti più grandi della zona. Dopo che sono usciti, Iplora ti chiede di portarla vicino al polo sud del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Suspiciously similar, independent reports on that area have been. Tasked with investigating it, I was."|430|0
units.english: "Suspiciously similar, independent reports on that area have been. Tasked with investigating it, I was."
units.italian: "Sospettosamente simili, segnalazioni indipendenti su quella zona sono state. Incaricata di indagare, io sono stata."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	As you land on an isolated icy patch, just out of reach of a growing snowstorm nearby, Iplora finishes her preparations. You find her carrying a bag with some equipment and wearing what is - at least when compared to what her colleagues were wearing - fairly light clothing. Although she is a Saryd, you still worry that she might be frostbitten in this extreme weather, but she reassures you that she will be fine.|431|0
units.english: As you land on an isolated icy patch, just out of reach of a growing snowstorm nearby, Iplora finishes her preparations. You find her carrying a bag with some equipment and wearing what is - at least when compared to what her colleagues were wearing - fairly light clothing. Although she is a Saryd, you still worry that she might be frostbitten in this extreme weather, but she reassures you that she will be fine.
units.italian: Mentre atterri su una placca ghiacciata isolata, appena fuori dalla portata di una tempesta di neve in crescita nelle vicinanze, Iplora finisce i suoi preparativi. La trovi con una borsa piena di attrezzatura e vestiti piuttosto leggeri, almeno rispetto a quelli dei suoi colleghi. Anche se è una Saryd, ti preoccupi comunque che possa prendere congelamenti con questo tempo estremo, ma lei ti assicura che starà bene.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	She tells you she'll be back in a few hours, and waits for you to open the hatch.|432|0
units.english: She tells you she'll be back in a few hours, and waits for you to open the hatch.
units.italian: Ti dice che tornerà tra qualche ora, e aspetta che tu apra il portello.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Good luck. Be careful not to get lost in all this snow."|434|0
units.english: "Good luck. Be careful not to get lost in all this snow."
units.italian: "Buona fortuna. Fai attenzione a non perderti in tutta questa neve."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Hold up, I'll go with you so we can search faster."|436|0
units.english: "Hold up, I'll go with you so we can search faster."
units.italian: "Aspetta, vengo con te così possiamo cercare più in fretta."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	She pauses in thought for a few seconds, looking back at you. "Certain of that, are you, Captain? Treacherous, these storms can be."|437|0
units.english: She pauses in thought for a few seconds, looking back at you. "Certain of that, are you, Captain? Treacherous, these storms can be."
units.italian: Si ferma a riflettere per qualche secondo, guardandoti. "Certo di questo, tu sei, Capitano? Insidiose, queste tempeste possono essere."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Don't worry, I can carry my weight through some snow."|439|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I can carry my weight through some snow."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, posso reggere il passo nella neve."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"On second thought, you're right. Good luck out there."|441|0
units.english: "On second thought, you're right. Good luck out there."
units.italian: "Ripensandoci, hai ragione. Buona fortuna là fuori."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You open the hatch, and she begins her trek. You slouch around your ship for a few hours, waiting for any signal from the Heliarch agents, but nothing comes up on your commlink. Iplora comes back, saying she couldn't find anything, so you leave and pick up Kirrie and Tugroob. They also return empty-handed.|443|0
units.english: You open the hatch, and she begins her trek. You slouch around your ship for a few hours, waiting for any signal from the Heliarch agents, but nothing comes up on your commlink. Iplora comes back, saying she couldn't find anything, so you leave and pick up Kirrie and Tugroob. They also return empty-handed.
units.italian: Apri il portello, e lei comincia la sua marcia. Girelli per la nave per qualche ora, aspettando un segnale dagli agenti degli Heliarchs, ma sul collegamento non arriva nulla. Iplora torna, dicendo di non aver trovato niente, così partite e andate a prendere Kirrie e Tugroob. Anche loro tornano a mani vuote.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	She remains silent, moving away from the hatch and taking a seat to wait. You head to your room and prepare yourself for what's to come with the warmest, best clothing you could find for the snowy grounds. When you're done, you head back to your controls to open the hatch, and the both of you head out into the white fields. Not long after leaving your ship, you can make out small, dark lines nearby. It seems you landed close to a forest. Unfortunately, the trees don't do much to protect you from the increasingly dense snowfall.|446|0
units.english: She remains silent, moving away from the hatch and taking a seat to wait. You head to your room and prepare yourself for what's to come with the warmest, best clothing you could find for the snowy grounds. When you're done, you head back to your controls to open the hatch, and the both of you head out into the white fields. Not long after leaving your ship, you can make out small, dark lines nearby. It seems you landed close to a forest. Unfortunately, the trees don't do much to protect you from the increasingly dense snowfall.
units.italian: Resta in silenzio, si allontana dal portello e si siede ad aspettare. Vai nella tua cabina e ti prepari a quello che verrà con i vestiti più caldi e migliori che riesci a trovare per i terreni innevati. Quando hai finito, torni ai comandi per aprire il portello, e uscite entrambi nei campi bianchi. Non molto dopo aver lasciato la nave, distingui delle piccole linee scure lì vicino. Sembra che tu sia atterrato vicino a una foresta. Purtroppo gli alberi non ti proteggono granché dalla nevicata sempre più fitta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You continue deeper into the lifeless forest for what feels like hours, so long that your feet start feeling slightly numb from the cold. After yet another turn amidst identical trees, Iplora guides you out of the forest to a snowy plain, dotted with a few dozen small, sturdy houses. Iplora explains it was something of a resort, popular with Kimek families when the planet wasn't as cold as nowadays. The storm is not so terrible here, so you can also faintly see cave entrances in a few small mounds at the edges of the resort grounds. Snow-covered boulders litter the entire plain, and Iplora warns you to take care not to trip on them.|447|0
units.english: You continue deeper into the lifeless forest for what feels like hours, so long that your feet start feeling slightly numb from the cold. After yet another turn amidst identical trees, Iplora guides you out of the forest to a snowy plain, dotted with a few dozen small, sturdy houses. Iplora explains it was something of a resort, popular with Kimek families when the planet wasn't as cold as nowadays. The storm is not so terrible here, so you can also faintly see cave entrances in a few small mounds at the edges of the resort grounds. Snow-covered boulders litter the entire plain, and Iplora warns you to take care not to trip on them.
units.italian: Continuate a inoltrarvi nella foresta senza vita per quello che sembra un tempo infinito, così a lungo che i piedi cominciano a intorpidirsi per il freddo. Dopo un'altra curva tra alberi identici, Iplora ti guida fuori dalla foresta verso una pianura innevata, punteggiata di qualche dozzina di casette piccole e robuste. Iplora spiega che era una specie di località di villeggiatura, popolare tra le famiglie Kimek quando il pianeta non era freddo come oggi. La tempesta qui non è così terribile, così riesci a distinguere vagamente anche gli ingressi di alcune caverne in alcuni piccoli tumuli ai margini del terreno della località. Massi coperti di neve sono sparsi per tutta la pianura, e Iplora ti avverte di fare attenzione a non inciamparci.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Check the caverns, we must. More relentless, the storm will soon become," she says.|448|0
units.english: "Check the caverns, we must. More relentless, the storm will soon become," she says.
units.italian: "Controllare le caverne, noi dobbiamo. Più implacabile, la tempesta diventerà presto," dice.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Lead the way."|450|0
units.english: "Lead the way."
units.italian: "Fai strada."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"You go ahead. I'll see if I can find anything in the houses."|452|0
units.english: "You go ahead. I'll see if I can find anything in the houses."
units.italian: "Vai avanti tu. Io vedo se trovo qualcosa nelle case."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	She nods and tells you that the place is shut down, so you can force your way into the houses if needed. As she starts making her way uphill, you head to the closest house and blast the lock after a few failed attempts at opening it normally. You crouch past the entrance of the abandoned home, clearly not intended for any non-Kimek, and begin searching the interior. The furniture is still in surprisingly good shape, if a bit dusty, but you find nothing inside any of the containers, below any of the beds, or hidden under the flooring.|453|0
units.english: She nods and tells you that the place is shut down, so you can force your way into the houses if needed. As she starts making her way uphill, you head to the closest house and blast the lock after a few failed attempts at opening it normally. You crouch past the entrance of the abandoned home, clearly not intended for any non-Kimek, and begin searching the interior. The furniture is still in surprisingly good shape, if a bit dusty, but you find nothing inside any of the containers, below any of the beds, or hidden under the flooring.
units.italian: Annuisce e ti dice che il posto è chiuso, quindi puoi forzare l'ingresso delle case se serve. Mentre lei comincia a salire verso l'alto, ti dirigi alla casa più vicina e fai saltare la serratura dopo qualche tentativo fallito di aprirla normalmente. Ti abbassi oltrepassando l'ingresso della casa abbandonata, chiaramente non pensata per chi non è Kimek, e cominci a perquisire l'interno. I mobili sono ancora in condizioni sorprendentemente buone, anche se un po' polverosi, ma non trovi nulla dentro nessuno dei contenitori, sotto nessuno dei letti, né nascosto sotto il pavimento.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You move on to the next house, and speed up the process as you go along and get used to the standard layout of the resort homes. After you're done with the fifth one, you leave to find the snowfall growing stronger. It might be best to try and look for Iplora and see if she's found anything, before the blizzard sets in fully.|454|0
units.english: You move on to the next house, and speed up the process as you go along and get used to the standard layout of the resort homes. After you're done with the fifth one, you leave to find the snowfall growing stronger. It might be best to try and look for Iplora and see if she's found anything, before the blizzard sets in fully.
units.italian: Passi alla casa successiva, e acceleri man mano che prendi l'abitudine alla disposizione standard delle case della località. Dopo aver finito con la quinta, esci e trovi la nevicata più forte. Forse è meglio cercare Iplora e vedere se ha trovato qualcosa, prima che la bufera si stabilizzi del tutto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Enter the nearest cavern.)|456|0
units.english: (Enter the nearest cavern.)
units.italian: (Entra nella caverna più vicina.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Try and dig through the snowy mounds to find something.)|458|0
units.english: (Try and dig through the snowy mounds to find something.)
units.italian: (Prova a scavare nei tumuli di neve per trovare qualcosa.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You claw away at the snow and hit a hard surface, but it turns out to be just a rock. You try some other mounds to no avail, and right as you finish digging through another pile of snow only to find another rock, Iplora appears behind you.|460|0
units.english: You claw away at the snow and hit a hard surface, but it turns out to be just a rock. You try some other mounds to no avail, and right as you finish digging through another pile of snow only to find another rock, Iplora appears behind you.
units.italian: Gratti via la neve e colpisci una superficie dura, ma si scopre che è solo una roccia. Provi altri tumuli senza risultato, e proprio quando finisci di scavare un altro mucchio di neve trovando solo un'altra roccia, Iplora compare dietro di te.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Counterproductive, cleaning away the snow is," she says. "Found nothing, I have. Back to your ship, we must go."|461|0
units.english: "Counterproductive, cleaning away the snow is," she says. "Found nothing, I have. Back to your ship, we must go."
units.italian: "Controproducente, pulire la neve è," dice. "Trovato nulla, io ho. Alla tua nave, noi dobbiamo tornare."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Go back to the ship.)|463|0
units.english: (Go back to the ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla nave.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Keep digging.)|465|0
units.english: (Keep digging.)
units.italian: (Continua a scavare.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You rush inside the nearest cave, turning on your flashlight as you carefully explore its interior. After a while, you notice another light coming from further inside the cave, and Iplora emerges soon after. "Found anything?" she asks, and you shake your head. Aside from some small campsites, she didn't either. You wait inside a bit more, and when the weather clears and night approaches, you follow her back to the ship.|468|0
units.english: You rush inside the nearest cave, turning on your flashlight as you carefully explore its interior. After a while, you notice another light coming from further inside the cave, and Iplora emerges soon after. "Found anything?" she asks, and you shake your head. Aside from some small campsites, she didn't either. You wait inside a bit more, and when the weather clears and night approaches, you follow her back to the ship.
units.italian: Ti precipiti nella caverna più vicina, accendendo la torcia mentre esplori con cautela l'interno. Dopo un po', noti un'altra luce provenire più in fondo alla caverna, e poco dopo emerge Iplora. "Trovato qualcosa?" chiede, e tu fai cenno di no. A parte alcuni piccoli accampamenti, nemmeno lei. Aspettate dentro ancora un po', e quando il tempo migliora e si avvicina la notte, la segui di nuovo alla nave.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	Once you're there, you leave to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who also come back empty handed. The agents head to their bunks, and you prepare to take off.|469|0
units.english: Once you're there, you leave to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who also come back empty handed. The agents head to their bunks, and you prepare to take off.
units.italian: Una volta lì, partite per andare a prendere Kirrie e Tugroob, che tornano anche loro a mani vuote. Gli agenti si dirigono alle cuccette, e tu ti prepari a decollare.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|label|471|0
units.english: bumpy road
units.italian: bumpy road

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	Following her up the hills proves difficult at first, what with your legs sinking into the snow, but the ground below becomes more and more solid - if a bit bumpy - the further into the resort you go. You try to watch your step around the boulders scattered about, but after stepping on a patch with deeper snow than usual, you trip over one of the mounds. She helps you up, and the two of you eventually arrive at the entrance of one of the caverns.|472|0
units.english: Following her up the hills proves difficult at first, what with your legs sinking into the snow, but the ground below becomes more and more solid - if a bit bumpy - the further into the resort you go. You try to watch your step around the boulders scattered about, but after stepping on a patch with deeper snow than usual, you trip over one of the mounds. She helps you up, and the two of you eventually arrive at the entrance of one of the caverns.
units.italian: Seguirla su per le colline si rivela difficile all'inizio, con le gambe che affondano nella neve, ma il terreno sotto diventa sempre più solido, anche se un po' accidentato, man mano che ti addentri nella località. Cerchi di guardare dove metti i piedi intorno ai massi sparsi, ma dopo aver calpestato un punto con neve più profonda del solito, inciampi su uno dei tumuli. Lei ti aiuta a rialzarti, e alla fine arrivate all'ingresso di una delle caverne.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Go inside with Iplora.)|474|0
units.english: (Go inside with Iplora.)
units.italian: (Entra dentro con Iplora.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Search around the snow field.)|476|0
units.english: (Search around the snow field.)
units.italian: (Perquisisci il campo innevato.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You tell her you'll look around the snow for a while and go inside if the storm gets rough again. Walking around in the developing blizzard, this time minding the bumpy ground below, you try to look for anything off about any of the resort homes, or perhaps spot something in the snow itself. Although the scenery is a great sight, the task quickly becomes dull. Even after walking around the entire resort, your efforts produce no results. The snow starts falling much faster, so you begin making your way back to the caverns.|477|0
units.english: You tell her you'll look around the snow for a while and go inside if the storm gets rough again. Walking around in the developing blizzard, this time minding the bumpy ground below, you try to look for anything off about any of the resort homes, or perhaps spot something in the snow itself. Although the scenery is a great sight, the task quickly becomes dull. Even after walking around the entire resort, your efforts produce no results. The snow starts falling much faster, so you begin making your way back to the caverns.
units.italian: Le dici che ti guarderai intorno nella neve per un po' e che entrerai se la tempesta si fa di nuovo violenta. Camminando nella bufera che avanza, questa volta badando al terreno accidentato, provi a cercare qualcosa di strano in una delle case della località, o magari a notare qualcosa nella neve stessa. Anche se il panorama è uno spettacolo, il compito diventa presto noioso. Persino dopo aver girato per tutta la località, i tuoi sforzi non danno risultati. La neve comincia a cadere molto più in fretta, così ti avvii verso le caverne.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	With your focus on blocking a gust of snow, you end up tripping over another one of the mounds on your way, and realize you don't remember which cave Iplora entered. Considering the weather, though, taking shelter in any of them would be a good choice.|478|0
units.english: With your focus on blocking a gust of snow, you end up tripping over another one of the mounds on your way, and realize you don't remember which cave Iplora entered. Considering the weather, though, taking shelter in any of them would be a good choice.
units.italian: Concentrato a ripararti da una raffica di neve, finisci per inciampare in un altro dei tumuli lungo la strada, e ti rendi conto di non ricordare in quale caverna sia entrata Iplora. Visto il tempo, però, ripararsi in una qualsiasi sarebbe una buona scelta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Enter the nearest cavern.)|480|0
units.english: (Enter the nearest cavern.)
units.italian: (Entra nella caverna più vicina.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Try and dig through the snowy mounds to find something.)|482|0
units.english: (Try and dig through the snowy mounds to find something.)
units.italian: (Prova a scavare nei tumuli di neve per trovare qualcosa.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You and Iplora bring out your flashlights as you two explore the caverns. After some twists and turns, she notices some large rocks that evidently broke free from the walls, but still hug them closely. She puts down her flashlight and starts pushing the rocks, revealing a passage to a small campsite containing some makeshift beds, knocked over equipment boxes, and a worn down campfire in the middle.|485|0
units.english: You and Iplora bring out your flashlights as you two explore the caverns. After some twists and turns, she notices some large rocks that evidently broke free from the walls, but still hug them closely. She puts down her flashlight and starts pushing the rocks, revealing a passage to a small campsite containing some makeshift beds, knocked over equipment boxes, and a worn down campfire in the middle.
units.italian: Tu e Iplora tirate fuori le torce mentre esplorate le caverne. Dopo qualche curva, lei nota alcune grandi rocce che evidentemente si sono staccate dalle pareti, ma restano appoggiate ad esse. Posate le torce, comincia a spingere le rocce, rivelando un passaggio verso un piccolo accampamento con alcuni letti improvvisati, casse di attrezzature rovesciate e un fuoco di campo consumato al centro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You search through the boxes as she examines the room looking for some other hidden area, but neither of you find anything. She checks the campfire and concludes that nobody has been here for a few months. You continue exploring the cave and eventually loop back outside, leaving via another cave entrance that, according to Iplora, is this time much further from the forest. Given the blizzard is now strong enough that you've lost sight of the forest from earlier, you wonder how she's even managing to tell where you are, and for how much longer she'll be able to do so.|486|0
units.english: You search through the boxes as she examines the room looking for some other hidden area, but neither of you find anything. She checks the campfire and concludes that nobody has been here for a few months. You continue exploring the cave and eventually loop back outside, leaving via another cave entrance that, according to Iplora, is this time much further from the forest. Given the blizzard is now strong enough that you've lost sight of the forest from earlier, you wonder how she's even managing to tell where you are, and for how much longer she'll be able to do so.
units.italian: Frughi nelle casse mentre lei esamina la stanza in cerca di qualche altra area nascosta, ma nessuno dei due trova nulla. Controlla il fuoco e conclude che nessuno è stato qui da qualche mese. Continuate a esplorare la caverna e alla fine tornate fuori, uscendo da un altro ingresso che, secondo Iplora, questa volta è molto più lontano dalla foresta. Dato che la bufera ora è abbastanza forte da farti perdere di vista la foresta di prima, ti chiedi come faccia persino a capire dove siete, e per quanto ancora riuscirà a farlo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Suggest returning to the ship.)|488|0
units.english: (Suggest returning to the ship.)
units.italian: (Suggerisci di tornare alla nave.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Continue looking around the caves.)|490|0
units.english: (Continue looking around the caves.)
units.italian: (Continua a guardarti intorno nelle caverne.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You head back inside and continue exploring the cave system. You two find a few more of the hidden campsites, but all are as abandoned as the first one. You're alerted by the wind, snow, and ice whenever you're close to another exit.|491|0
units.english: You head back inside and continue exploring the cave system. You two find a few more of the hidden campsites, but all are as abandoned as the first one. You're alerted by the wind, snow, and ice whenever you're close to another exit.
units.italian: Rientri e continui a esplorare il sistema di caverne. Trovate altri accampamenti nascosti, ma tutti abbandonati come il primo. Il vento, la neve e il ghiaccio ti avvertono ogni volta che siete vicini a un'altra uscita.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	After a few hours, the storm finally subsides, and you both return to your ship. You leave to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who also come back empty-handed.|492|0
units.english: After a few hours, the storm finally subsides, and you both return to your ship. You leave to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who also come back empty-handed.
units.italian: Dopo qualche ora la tempesta finalmente si calma, e tornate entrambi alla nave. Partite per andare a prendere Kirrie e Tugroob, che tornano anche loro a mani vuote.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|label|494|0
units.english: bumpy blizzard
units.italian: bumpy blizzard

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	Iplora hesitates for a bit, then explains that you could get sick going through the storm now. She suggests instead that you wait in the caves until it is safe for human passage.|495|0
units.english: Iplora hesitates for a bit, then explains that you could get sick going through the storm now. She suggests instead that you wait in the caves until it is safe for human passage.
units.italian: Iplora esita un momento, poi spiega che ora potresti ammalarti attraversando la tempesta. Suggerisce invece di aspettare nelle caverne finché non sarà sicuro per un umano passare.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You insist, and she reluctantly gives in, telling you to stick close to her. She moves slowly so you have no problem keeping up, but time and again you keep falling over, tripping on the mounds the rocks have created. Another fall, and Iplora reaches her hand out to help you up once again.|496|0
units.english: You insist, and she reluctantly gives in, telling you to stick close to her. She moves slowly so you have no problem keeping up, but time and again you keep falling over, tripping on the mounds the rocks have created. Another fall, and Iplora reaches her hand out to help you up once again.
units.italian: Insisti, e lei cede a malincuore, dicendoti di restarle vicino. Si muove piano perché tu non abbia problemi a seguirla, ma continui a cadere, inciampando nei tumuli creati dalle rocce. Un'altra caduta, e Iplora allunga la mano per aiutarti di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Take her hand.)|498|0
units.english: (Take her hand.)
units.italian: (Prendi la sua mano.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Try and dig through the snow to find something.)|499|0
units.english: (Try and dig through the snow to find something.)
units.italian: (Prova a scavare nella neve per trovare qualcosa.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	She helps you up, and you continue on your way down the hills. You get back to the forest, and she starts finding the trail back to the ship. Halfway through, the storm gets progressively weaker.|502|0
units.english: She helps you up, and you continue on your way down the hills. You get back to the forest, and she starts finding the trail back to the ship. Halfway through, the storm gets progressively weaker.
units.italian: Ti aiuta a rialzarti, e continuate a scendere dalle colline. Tornate alla foresta, e lei comincia a ritrovare la pista per la nave. A metà strada, la tempesta si indebolisce progressivamente.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	When you two return to your ship, you leave to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who also come back empty handed.|503|0
units.english: When you two return to your ship, you leave to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who also come back empty handed.
units.italian: Quando tornate alla nave, partite per andare a prendere Kirrie e Tugroob, che tornano anche loro a mani vuote.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|label|505|0
units.english: snow dig
units.italian: snow dig

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You start clawing your way down the snow as Iplora asks you to stop and continue moving toward the ship. You continue, your hands getting colder as the snow steals the heat even through your gloves. You hit a hard surface and start clearing from there, only to see it was, in fact, just a boulder.|506|0
units.english: You start clawing your way down the snow as Iplora asks you to stop and continue moving toward the ship. You continue, your hands getting colder as the snow steals the heat even through your gloves. You hit a hard surface and start clearing from there, only to see it was, in fact, just a boulder.
units.italian: Cominci a scavare nella neve mentre Iplora ti chiede di fermarti e di continuare verso la nave. Prosegui, e le mani ti si raffreddano perché la neve ruba il calore anche attraverso i guanti. Colpisci una superficie dura e cominci a liberarla, solo per vedere che era, in effetti, solo un masso.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Satisfied? Return, we must. Come now," You turn to see her offering her hand once again.|507|0
units.english: "Satisfied? Return, we must. Come now," You turn to see her offering her hand once again.
units.italian: "Soddisfatto? Tornare, noi dobbiamo. Vieni ora," Ti volti e la vedi che ti offre di nuovo la mano.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Take her hand.)|509|0
units.english: (Take her hand.)
units.italian: (Prendi la sua mano.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Head to another mound and try digging there.)|511|0
units.english: (Head to another mound and try digging there.)
units.italian: (Vai a un altro tumulo e prova a scavare lì.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|label|512|0
units.english: keep dig
units.italian: keep dig

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You stand up and run to another spot where you fell over. Iplora follows you, and even with the snow muffling the sounds around you, you can hear her exasperated sigh. She tries to pull you away, but you hit a hard surface yet again, this time creating a faint metallic echo. She takes her hands off of you and lays down, now helping you dig out whatever is there. Once the object is visible, she stands up. Though much of it is still buried, you can tell it's a very large metal container of sorts - the part that's out of the snow looks almost like the larger end of a coffin.|513|0
units.english: You stand up and run to another spot where you fell over. Iplora follows you, and even with the snow muffling the sounds around you, you can hear her exasperated sigh. She tries to pull you away, but you hit a hard surface yet again, this time creating a faint metallic echo. She takes her hands off of you and lays down, now helping you dig out whatever is there. Once the object is visible, she stands up. Though much of it is still buried, you can tell it's a very large metal container of sorts - the part that's out of the snow looks almost like the larger end of a coffin.
units.italian: Ti alzi e corri verso un altro punto dove sei caduto. Iplora ti segue, e anche con la neve che attutisce i suoni intorno a voi, riesci a sentire il suo sospiro esasperato. Prova a tirarti via, ma colpisci di nuovo una superficie dura, questa volta producendo un debole eco metallico. Ti toglie le mani di dosso e si sdraia, ora aiutandoti a scavare quello che c'è. Quando l'oggetto è visibile, si rialza. Anche se gran parte è ancora sepolta, capisci che è una specie di contenitore metallico molto grande: la parte fuori dalla neve sembra quasi l'estremità più larga di una bara.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	After clearing out what snow you could from over the rest of the object, you see it's many times larger than either of you. You try to look for some way to open it while she starts going over her bag, looking for something, but the cold, frost-plagued metal doesn't budge to your efforts. She finally seems to find what she was looking for - some sort of comms device - but before she has a chance to activate it, an energy blast from the far side of the resort rattles the ground nearby. It misses her by only a meter or so, and melts much of the snow it hit to nothing.|514|0
units.english: After clearing out what snow you could from over the rest of the object, you see it's many times larger than either of you. You try to look for some way to open it while she starts going over her bag, looking for something, but the cold, frost-plagued metal doesn't budge to your efforts. She finally seems to find what she was looking for - some sort of comms device - but before she has a chance to activate it, an energy blast from the far side of the resort rattles the ground nearby. It misses her by only a meter or so, and melts much of the snow it hit to nothing.
units.italian: Dopo aver tolto quanta neve puoi dal resto dell'oggetto, vedi che è molte volte più grande di entrambi. Cerchi un modo per aprirlo mentre lei comincia a frugare nella borsa in cerca di qualcosa, ma il metallo freddo e coperto di brina non cede ai tuoi sforzi. Finalmente sembra trovare quello che cercava, una specie di dispositivo di comunicazione, ma prima che abbia la possibilità di attivarlo, un'esplosione di energia dal lato opposto della località fa tremare il terreno vicino. La manca di appena un metro, e scioglie gran parte della neve che ha colpito.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	She yells for you to get down, pulling out a Heliarch blaster weapon from the bag and firing back in the direction the shot came from.|515|0
units.english: She yells for you to get down, pulling out a Heliarch blaster weapon from the bag and firing back in the direction the shot came from.
units.italian: Ti urla di abbatterti, tira fuori dalla borsa un'arma blaster degli Heliarchs e risponde al fuoco nella direzione da cui è arrivato il colpo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Take cover.)|519|0
units.english: (Take cover.)
units.italian: (Mettiti al riparo.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	(Pull out my gun and help her.)|520|0
units.english: (Pull out my gun and help her.)
units.italian: (Tira fuori la mia arma e aiutala.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You rush to the nearest resort house, staying behind it and hoping you'll have enough protection from the blasts. You can still hear Iplora move around, and you occasionally peek your head over to see her shooting and taking cover behind the houses herself, narrowly avoiding incoming blasts as she tries to close in the distance with whoever or whatever is shooting. The shots stop suddenly and you see her come over, saying that it should be safe to get out now.|522|0
units.english: You rush to the nearest resort house, staying behind it and hoping you'll have enough protection from the blasts. You can still hear Iplora move around, and you occasionally peek your head over to see her shooting and taking cover behind the houses herself, narrowly avoiding incoming blasts as she tries to close in the distance with whoever or whatever is shooting. The shots stop suddenly and you see her come over, saying that it should be safe to get out now.
units.italian: Corri verso la casa più vicina della località, restando dietro e sperando di avere abbastanza protezione dalle esplosioni. Senti ancora Iplora muoversi, e ogni tanto sporgi la testa per vederla sparare e ripararsi dietro le case, evitando per un soffio le esplosioni in arrivo mentre cerca di accorciare la distanza con chi o che cosa sta sparando. Gli spari si fermano di colpo e la vedi avvicinarsi, dicendo che ora dovrebbe essere sicuro uscire.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	"Fled, our attacker has," she claims. From the looks of it she wasn't injured. You two get back to the dug out spot, and Iplora grabs her bag. She managed to call for support in between running for cover and shooting back, and you two wait by one of the houses for a few minutes.|523|0
units.english: "Fled, our attacker has," she claims. From the looks of it she wasn't injured. You two get back to the dug out spot, and Iplora grabs her bag. She managed to call for support in between running for cover and shooting back, and you two wait by one of the houses for a few minutes.
units.italian: "Fuggito, il nostro attentatore è," sostiene. A quanto pare non è ferita. Tornate al punto scavato, e Iplora prende la sua borsa. È riuscita a chiamare rinforzi tra una corsa al riparo e una risposta al fuoco, e aspettate vicino a una delle case per qualche minuto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You two start shooting back as you move for cover behind the resort houses. Iplora signals for you to head out to another house, while she takes a different path. Rushing to the next house for cover while shooting in the direction of your attacker, you narrowly avoid the shots that come your way. You lose sight of Iplora herself, now only making out the bright blasts from her weapon as she moves quickly through the resort.|526|0
units.english: You two start shooting back as you move for cover behind the resort houses. Iplora signals for you to head out to another house, while she takes a different path. Rushing to the next house for cover while shooting in the direction of your attacker, you narrowly avoid the shots that come your way. You lose sight of Iplora herself, now only making out the bright blasts from her weapon as she moves quickly through the resort.
units.italian: Cominciate a rispondere al fuoco mentre vi muovete al riparo dietro le case della località. Iplora ti fa cenno di andare verso un'altra casa, mentre lei prende un percorso diverso. Correndo verso la casa successiva per ripararti mentre spari in direzione dell'attentatore, eviti per un soffio i colpi che ti arrivano. Perdi di vista Iplora, e ormai distingui solo le esplosioni luminose della sua arma mentre si muove rapidamente per la località.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	Trying to keep up, you notice the shots grow less frequent as they alternate between you and Iplora. The blizzard is bad enough that you can't even see the attacker despite getting closer and closer, but it seems that goes both ways, as you and Iplora manage to avoid getting hit without too much trouble.|527|0
units.english: Trying to keep up, you notice the shots grow less frequent as they alternate between you and Iplora. The blizzard is bad enough that you can't even see the attacker despite getting closer and closer, but it seems that goes both ways, as you and Iplora manage to avoid getting hit without too much trouble.
units.italian: Cercando di tenere il passo, noti che gli spari si fanno meno frequenti, alternandosi tra te e Iplora. La bufera è abbastanza forte che non riesci a vedere l'attentatore neanche avvicinandoti sempre di più, ma sembra valere in entrambe le direzioni, perché tu e Iplora riuscite a evitare di essere colpiti senza troppa difficoltà.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You've barely gotten past half of the resort when the shots stop altogether. Iplora still takes aim for a bit, firing some shots as she continues on past some houses, but ultimately lowers her weapon and comes toward you. "Fled, our attacker has," she claims. You two head back to the dug out spot, and Iplora grabs her bag. She managed to call for support in between running for cover and shooting back, so you two wait by one of the houses for a few minutes.|528|0
units.english: You've barely gotten past half of the resort when the shots stop altogether. Iplora still takes aim for a bit, firing some shots as she continues on past some houses, but ultimately lowers her weapon and comes toward you. "Fled, our attacker has," she claims. You two head back to the dug out spot, and Iplora grabs her bag. She managed to call for support in between running for cover and shooting back, so you two wait by one of the houses for a few minutes.
units.italian: Avete superato a malapena metà della località quando gli spari cessano del tutto. Iplora mira ancora per un po', sparando qualche colpo mentre prosegue oltre alcune case, ma alla fine abbassa l'arma e viene verso di te. "Fuggito, il nostro attentatore è," sostiene. Tornate al punto scavato, e Iplora prende la sua borsa. È riuscita a chiamare rinforzi tra una corsa al riparo e una risposta al fuoco, così aspettate vicino a una delle case per qualche minuto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|label|529|0
units.english: open crate
units.italian: open crate

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	Several Heliarch Neutralizers arrive just before the blizzard subsides, and you're directed to one of them to dry your clothes and make sure you're not frostbitten. Nearly all of the Heliarch agents making the rounds over the resort are Saryds, and are quick to locate more of the coffin-like containers buried in the snow. They pull them out with equipment they've brought in the ships and carefully melt down the ice and snow layers covering them, finally managing to force their lids open once they've dried out.|530|0
units.english: Several Heliarch Neutralizers arrive just before the blizzard subsides, and you're directed to one of them to dry your clothes and make sure you're not frostbitten. Nearly all of the Heliarch agents making the rounds over the resort are Saryds, and are quick to locate more of the coffin-like containers buried in the snow. They pull them out with equipment they've brought in the ships and carefully melt down the ice and snow layers covering them, finally managing to force their lids open once they've dried out.
units.italian: Diversi Neutralizers degli Heliarchs arrivano poco prima che la bufera si attenui, e ti mandano su uno di essi ad asciugare i vestiti e ad assicurarti di non avere congelamenti. Quasi tutti gli agenti degli Heliarchs che percorrono la località sono Saryd, e individuano in fretta altri contenitori simili a bare sepolti nella neve. Li tirano fuori con l'attrezzatura che hanno portato sulle navi e sciolgono con cura gli strati di ghiaccio e neve che li coprono, riuscendo infine a forzarne i coperchi una volta asciutti.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	Each one houses a Heliarch Finisher Torpedo inside, to the agents' surprise. As they open them up and reveal dozens of the torpedoes, Iplora heads out with a group of agents so that she can show them signs of the shootout with the attacker. She gives her thoughts on where they could be fleeing to, and informs another group on the layout of the local caverns before they head underground. When she's back with you, one of the captains of the Neutralizers tell you that they will handle everything from here, and has one of the ships take you two to where your own ship is parked. He leaves as you prepare to take off.|531|0
units.english: Each one houses a Heliarch Finisher Torpedo inside, to the agents' surprise. As they open them up and reveal dozens of the torpedoes, Iplora heads out with a group of agents so that she can show them signs of the shootout with the attacker. She gives her thoughts on where they could be fleeing to, and informs another group on the layout of the local caverns before they head underground. When she's back with you, one of the captains of the Neutralizers tell you that they will handle everything from here, and has one of the ships take you two to where your own ship is parked. He leaves as you prepare to take off.
units.italian: Ognuno contiene un siluro Finisher degli Heliarchs, con sorpresa degli agenti. Mentre li aprono e rivelano dozzine di quei siluri, Iplora esce con un gruppo di agenti per mostrare loro i segni dello scontro a fuoco con l'attentatore. Dà il suo parere su dove potrebbero essere fuggiti e informa un altro gruppo sulla disposizione delle caverne locali prima che scendano sottoterra. Quando torna da te, uno dei capitani dei Neutralizers ti dice che da qui in poi gestiranno tutto loro, e fa portare voi due da una delle navi dove è parcheggiata la tua. Se ne va mentre vi preparate a decollare.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White|	You head back to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who are excited to hear about what happened. They themselves didn't find anything, but they're content with listening to Iplora as she tells the story.|532|0
units.english: You head back to pick up Kirrie and Tugroob, who are excited to hear about what happened. They themselves didn't find anything, but they're content with listening to Iplora as she tells the story.
units.italian: Torni a prendere Kirrie e Tugroob, che sono ansiosi di sentire che cosa è successo. Loro non hanno trovato nulla, ma si accontentano di ascoltare Iplora mentre racconta la storia.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Remote Blue|name|536|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indagare su <planet>

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Remote Blue|description|537|0
units.english: Transport the Heliarch trio to investigate the isolated <planet>.
units.italian: Trasporta il trio degli Heliarchs a indagare sull'isolato <planet>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Remote Blue|When you land, a couple of other civilian ships land nearby. Some Kimek leave them and wait outside your own. Kirrie is the only one to leave, and after speaking a bit with the other Kimek, they leave for the city, splitting in two groups.|551|0
units.english: When you land, a couple of other civilian ships land nearby. Some Kimek leave them and wait outside your own. Kirrie is the only one to leave, and after speaking a bit with the other Kimek, they leave for the city, splitting in two groups.
units.italian: Quando atterri, un paio di altre navi civili atterrano lì vicino. Alcuni Kimek ne scendono e aspettano fuori dalla tua. Kirrie è l'unico a uscire, e dopo aver parlato un po' con gli altri Kimek, si dirigono verso la città, dividendosi in due gruppi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Remote Blue|	"Not fond of outsiders, the people of this world are," Tugroob explains. "Decided to employ undercover Kimek agents, Consul Iekie has."|552|0
units.english: "Not fond of outsiders, the people of this world are," Tugroob explains. "Decided to employ undercover Kimek agents, Consul Iekie has."
units.italian: "Non amare gli estranei, la gente di questo mondo lo è," spiega Tugroob. "Deciso di impiegare agenti Kimek sotto copertura, il console Iekie ha."
