units.id: mission:Heliarch Investigation 2 - Remote Blue|	You wait around for a couple hours as Iplora and Tugroob tinker with your ship's communication devices, keeping in contact with the two groups. They don't mention if either group finds anything, and as night falls, Kirrie returns to the ship on his own. He doesn't say anything of the operation, instead just heading to his bunk to rest. Iplora and Tugroob follow suit, after telling you to depart whenever you're ready.|553|0
units.english: You wait around for a couple hours as Iplora and Tugroob tinker with your ship's communication devices, keeping in contact with the two groups. They don't mention if either group finds anything, and as night falls, Kirrie returns to the ship on his own. He doesn't say anything of the operation, instead just heading to his bunk to rest. Iplora and Tugroob follow suit, after telling you to depart whenever you're ready.
units.italian: Aspetti per un paio d'ore mentre Iplora e Tugroob armeggiano con i dispositivi di comunicazione della nave, mantenendo i contatti con i due gruppi. Non dicono se uno dei gruppi ha trovato qualcosa, e quando scende la notte Kirrie torna alla nave da solo. Non dice nulla dell'operazione, e si dirige direttamente alla cuccetta per riposare. Iplora e Tugroob fanno lo stesso, dopo averti detto di partire quando vuoi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|name|559|0
units.english: Heliarch Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione degli Heliarchs

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|description|560|0
units.english: Fly to all the Quarg planets and stations the Heliarch asked, land on them, let your modified ship sensors scan their surroundings, and then head back to the <destination>.
units.italian: Vola su tutti i pianeti e le stazioni dei Quarg che gli Heliarchs ti hanno indicato, atterra, lascia che i sensori modificati della tua nave ne scansionino i dintorni, e poi torna a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|Three Heliarch agents are waiting for you when you land. "The human visitor who so much to our society has contributed, we greet," the Saryd says as they all salute you.|583|0
units.english: Three Heliarch agents are waiting for you when you land. "The human visitor who so much to our society has contributed, we greet," the Saryd says as they all salute you.
units.italian: Tre agenti degli Heliarchs ti aspettano quando atterri. "Il visitatore umano che tanto alla nostra società ha contribuito, noi salutiamo," dice il Saryd mentre tutti e tre ti salutano.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Sent by Consul Aulori, we were," the Kimek says proudly, as if you were supposed to know who that is. "An important task for you, he has in mind."|584|0
units.english: "Sent by Consul Aulori, we were," the Kimek says proudly, as if you were supposed to know who that is. "An important task for you, he has in mind."
units.italian: "Mandati dal console Aulori, noi siamo stati," dice con orgoglio il Kimek, come se tu dovessi sapere chi sia. "Un compito importante per te, lui ha in mente."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"How far would the visitor go, if to further help our Coalition, it meant?" the Arach asks.|585|0
units.english: "How far would the visitor go, if to further help our Coalition, it meant?" the Arach asks.
units.italian: "Fino a dove arriverebbe il visitatore, se aiutare ulteriormente la nostra Coalizione significasse?" chiede l'Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"I'd be glad to help. What do you need?"|587|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. What do you need?"
units.italian: "Sarei lieto di aiutare. Di che cosa avete bisogno?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"I'm not sure I understand what you're getting at."|588|0
units.english: "I'm not sure I understand what you're getting at."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro di capire dove vogliate arrivare."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Obviously, I have my limits."|589|0
units.english: "Obviously, I have my limits."
units.italian: "Ovviamente ho i miei limiti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"A jump drive, you possess. Far away, you can travel. Bother you, the harsh cages of the Quarg do not," the Saryd explains as all three walk toward your ship.|590|0
units.english: "A jump drive, you possess. Far away, you can travel. Bother you, the harsh cages of the Quarg do not," the Saryd explains as all three walk toward your ship.
units.italian: "Un motore di salto, tu possiedi. Lontano, tu puoi viaggiare. Disturbarti, le gabbie severe dei Quarg non lo fanno," spiega il Saryd mentre tutti e tre camminano verso la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Few in number, our own jump drives are, and too risky would it be, for one of our own to venture far out," the Kimek adds.|591|0
units.english: "Few in number, our own jump drives are, and too risky would it be, for one of our own to venture far out," the Kimek adds.
units.italian: "Pochi di numero, i nostri motori di salto sono, e troppo rischioso sarebbe, per uno dei nostri avventurarsi così lontano," aggiunge il Kimek.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"If to help us gain knowledge of the oppressors, you wish, lend the Coalition your ship's sensors for a short time, would you?" asks the Arach.|592|0
units.english: "If to help us gain knowledge of the oppressors, you wish, lend the Coalition your ship's sensors for a short time, would you?" asks the Arach.
units.italian: "Se aiutarci a ottenere conoscenza degli oppressori, tu desideri, prestare alla Coalizione i sensori della tua nave per un breve periodo, tu lo faresti?" chiede l'Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Are you asking me to spy on the Quarg?"|594|0
units.english: "Are you asking me to spy on the Quarg?"
units.italian: "Mi state chiedendo di spiare i Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Sorry, I don't want to get involved in your conflict with the Quarg."|595|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to get involved in your conflict with the Quarg."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non voglio essere coinvolto nel vostro conflitto con i Quarg."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"As espionage, a 'malfunction' qualifies not," the Saryd responds.|597|0
units.english: "As espionage, a 'malfunction' qualifies not," the Saryd responds.
units.italian: "Come spionaggio, un 'guasto' non si qualifica," risponde il Saryd.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Merely alter your own ship's sensors, we would. For a time, specially tuned to scan Quarg worlds, they would be," the Kimek clarifies. "No evidence against you, they would have."|598|0
units.english: "Merely alter your own ship's sensors, we would. For a time, specially tuned to scan Quarg worlds, they would be," the Kimek clarifies. "No evidence against you, they would have."
units.italian: "Semplicemente modificare i sensori della tua nave, noi lo faremmo. Per un po', sintonizzati apposta per scansionare i mondi dei Quarg, essi sarebbero," chiarisce il Kimek. "Nessuna prova contro di te, essi avrebbero."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Alright, which worlds do you need me to land on?"|600|0
units.english: "Alright, which worlds do you need me to land on?"
units.italian: "Va bene, su quali mondi devo atterrare?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Sorry, I don't want to get involved in your conflict with the Quarg."|601|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to get involved in your conflict with the Quarg."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non voglio essere coinvolto nel vostro conflitto con i Quarg."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	They ask you to show them your map of the galaxy, so you bring them inside your ship and point out to them all the Quarg planets and stations you have found. They're a bit startled when they first see the entire map, as if unsure about where to send you.|603|0
units.english: They ask you to show them your map of the galaxy, so you bring them inside your ship and point out to them all the Quarg planets and stations you have found. They're a bit startled when they first see the entire map, as if unsure about where to send you.
units.italian: Ti chiedono di mostrare loro la tua mappa della galassia, così li porti dentro la nave e indichi tutti i pianeti e le stazioni dei Quarg che hai trovato. Restano un po' sorpresi quando vedono l'intera mappa, come se non sapessero dove mandarti.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	You give them a quick rundown of each Quarg world, and after discussing among themselves for a bit, the Saryd speaks. "Interested in the Quarg's mining operations, and the various construction stages of their ringworlds, the consul is."|604|0
units.english: You give them a quick rundown of each Quarg world, and after discussing among themselves for a bit, the Saryd speaks. "Interested in the Quarg's mining operations, and the various construction stages of their ringworlds, the consul is."
units.italian: Fai loro un rapido riepilogo di ogni mondo dei Quarg, e dopo aver discusso tra loro per un po', il Saryd parla. "Interessato alle operazioni minerarie dei Quarg, e alle varie fasi di costruzione dei loro mondi ad anello, il console è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	He points to some of the worlds, and you list the places you need to land: <stopovers>.|605|0
units.english: He points to some of the worlds, and you list the places you need to land: <stopovers>.
units.italian: Indica alcuni dei mondi, e tu elenchi i luoghi dove devi atterrare: <stopovers>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	They call for some engineers to come work on your ship's sensors, the whole thing taking just a few minutes. When they're done, the Heliarch agents thank you for your cooperation, and tell you to head for the <destination> when you've collected all the data.|606|0
units.english: They call for some engineers to come work on your ship's sensors, the whole thing taking just a few minutes. When they're done, the Heliarch agents thank you for your cooperation, and tell you to head for the <destination> when you've collected all the data.
units.italian: Chiamano alcuni ingegneri a lavorare sui sensori della tua nave, e il tutto richiede solo pochi minuti. Quando hanno finito, gli agenti degli Heliarchs ti ringraziano per la collaborazione e ti dicono di dirigerti verso <destination> quando avrai raccolto tutti i dati.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|The Heliarch trio are eagerly waiting for you when you return. They are quick to welcome you, urging you to show them your ship's logs so they can see what information you've gathered. They don't seem to pay much mind to data on Grakhord or Forpelog, being much more interested in the ringworlds. As they examine the data, though, the Saryd frowns. The Kimek brings all his legs closer to his body, and the Arach squints all her eyes - probably their versions of the Saryd's reaction.|618|0
units.english: The Heliarch trio are eagerly waiting for you when you return. They are quick to welcome you, urging you to show them your ship's logs so they can see what information you've gathered. They don't seem to pay much mind to data on Grakhord or Forpelog, being much more interested in the ringworlds. As they examine the data, though, the Saryd frowns. The Kimek brings all his legs closer to his body, and the Arach squints all her eyes - probably their versions of the Saryd's reaction.
units.italian: Il trio degli Heliarchs ti aspetta con impazienza al ritorno. Si affrettano a darti il benvenuto, esortandoti a mostrare i registri della nave così che possano vedere quali informazioni hai raccolto. Non sembrano dare molto peso ai dati su Grakhord o Forpelog, essendo molto più interessati ai mondi ad anello. Mentre esaminano i dati, però, il Saryd aggrotta la fronte. Il Kimek avvicina tutte le zampe al corpo, e l'Arach stringe tutti gli occhi, probabilmente le loro versioni della reazione del Saryd.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	"Land on the rings, you really did, right Captain?" the Saryd asks while pointing at the places you visited.|619|0
units.english: "Land on the rings, you really did, right Captain?" the Saryd asks while pointing at the places you visited.
units.italian: "Atterrato sugli anelli, davvero tu l'hai fatto, vero Capitano?" chiede il Saryd indicando i luoghi che hai visitato.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	You nod, and the Kimek hits your control panel lightly with one of his legs. "No data on the rings, the sensors collected! Gone wrong, something must have."|620|0
units.english: You nod, and the Kimek hits your control panel lightly with one of his legs. "No data on the rings, the sensors collected! Gone wrong, something must have."
units.italian: Fai cenno di sì, e il Kimek colpisce leggermente il tuo pannello di controllo con una zampa. "Nessun dato sugli anelli, i sensori hanno raccolto! Andato storto, qualcosa deve essere."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	They have engineers return your sensors to normal, while you explain how your ship behaved while landing on them. They speak among themselves for a while, then the Arach says, "Too straightforward an approach, we might have taken. Captain <last>, contact you again soon, we will."|621|0
units.english: They have engineers return your sensors to normal, while you explain how your ship behaved while landing on them. They speak among themselves for a while, then the Arach says, "Too straightforward an approach, we might have taken. Captain <last>, contact you again soon, we will."
units.italian: Fanno tornare i loro ingegneri a riportare i sensori alla normalità, mentre tu spieghi come si è comportata la nave durante gli atterraggi. Parlano tra loro per un po', poi l'Arach dice: "Un approccio troppo diretto, forse abbiamo usato. Capitano <last>, contattarti di nuovo presto, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 1|	They hand you <payment>, and leave to one of the Heliarch sections of the ring.|622|0
units.english: They hand you <payment>, and leave to one of the Heliarch sections of the ring.
units.italian: Ti consegnano <payment> e si dirigono verso una delle sezioni dell'anello riservate agli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon Alta Hai|Coming in for a landing, something from inside your ship produces an irritating, high pitched whistle sound. It grows stronger the closer you get to the ringworld, until your ship completely shuts down. Your controls are rendered useless as you scramble to land manually, only for your autopilot to click back to normal and land as usual at the last moment. Looking outside, you spot several Quarg standing still, staring at your ship, until they hastily leave without contacting you at all.|633|0
units.english: Coming in for a landing, something from inside your ship produces an irritating, high pitched whistle sound. It grows stronger the closer you get to the ringworld, until your ship completely shuts down. Your controls are rendered useless as you scramble to land manually, only for your autopilot to click back to normal and land as usual at the last moment. Looking outside, you spot several Quarg standing still, staring at your ship, until they hastily leave without contacting you at all.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, qualcosa dentro la nave produce un fischio acuto e fastidioso. Diventa più forte man mano che ti avvicini al mondo ad anello, finché la nave non si spegne del tutto. I comandi diventano inutili mentre cerchi di atterrare manualmente, ma all'ultimo momento il pilota automatico torna in funzione e atterra come al solito. Guardando fuori, scorgi diversi Quarg immobili che fissano la tua nave, finché non si allontanano in fretta senza contattarti affatto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon Forpelog|	While you told them this was nothing more than a barren mining outpost, the Heliarchs still insisted on gathering intel on this small moon. Regardless of its usefulness, you land as they asked and let your scanners get a proper reading on this world.|645|0
units.english: While you told them this was nothing more than a barren mining outpost, the Heliarchs still insisted on gathering intel on this small moon. Regardless of its usefulness, you land as they asked and let your scanners get a proper reading on this world.
units.italian: Anche se hai detto loro che non era altro che un avamposto minerario sterile, gli Heliarchs hanno insistito per raccogliere informazioni su questa piccola luna. A prescindere dalla sua utilità, atterri come hanno chiesto e lasci che i tuoi scanner ne ricavino una lettura adeguata.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon Grakhord|As instructed, you land on Grakhord and let your ship work normally while the Heliarch sensor gets its reading. Though Heliarch technology is very advanced, you wonder if just by modifying your scanners they could penetrate the layers of rock to fully reveal the Quarg mining operation.|657|0
units.english: As instructed, you land on Grakhord and let your ship work normally while the Heliarch sensor gets its reading. Though Heliarch technology is very advanced, you wonder if just by modifying your scanners they could penetrate the layers of rock to fully reveal the Quarg mining operation.
units.italian: Come da istruzioni, atterri su Grakhord e lasci che la nave funzioni normalmente mentre il sensore degli Heliarchs prende la sua lettura. Anche se la tecnologia degli Heliarchs è molto avanzata, ti chiedi se solo modificando i tuoi scanner possano penetrare gli strati di roccia per rivelare del tutto l'operazione mineraria dei Quarg.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon Kuwaru Efreti|When you approach the ringworld for landing, a couple of lights start flickering on your control panel, and you can make out some whistling coming from somewhere inside your ship. It continues for a few seconds before stopping.|669|0
units.english: When you approach the ringworld for landing, a couple of lights start flickering on your control panel, and you can make out some whistling coming from somewhere inside your ship. It continues for a few seconds before stopping.
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini al mondo ad anello per atterrare, un paio di luci cominciano a lampeggiare sul pannello di controllo, e distingui un fischio provenire da qualche parte dentro la nave. Continua per qualche secondo prima di fermarsi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon Lagrange|You don't really know what the Heliarchs did to your sensors, or if you can even see the data they are collecting, but as you come in for a landing, you hear a faint whistling sound from the hull of your ship. It's short lived, and you land normally. Hopefully nothing broke.|681|0
units.english: You don't really know what the Heliarchs did to your sensors, or if you can even see the data they are collecting, but as you come in for a landing, you hear a faint whistling sound from the hull of your ship. It's short lived, and you land normally. Hopefully nothing broke.
units.italian: Non sai bene che cosa abbiano fatto gli Heliarchs ai tuoi sensori, né se tu possa persino vedere i dati che stanno raccogliendo, ma mentre ti avvicini per atterrare senti un debole fischio provenire dallo scafo. Dura poco, e atterri normalmente. Speriamo che non si sia rotto niente.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|name|688|0
units.english: Scanning Preparations
units.italian: Preparativi per la scansione

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|description|689|0
units.english: Install an Outfit Scanner, then land on <destination>, where the Heliarchs will modify it to be able to scan Quarg ships the way they need it.
units.italian: Installa uno scanner per equipaggiamenti, poi atterra su <destination>, dove gli Heliarchs lo modificheranno per poter scansionare le navi dei Quarg come serve a loro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|When you land, you're contacted by the Heliarch agents who had you land on some Quarg worlds and rings to collect data. "Captain <last>, a new task for you, we have," the Kimek says.|701|0
units.english: When you land, you're contacted by the Heliarch agents who had you land on some Quarg worlds and rings to collect data. "Captain <last>, a new task for you, we have," the Kimek says.
units.italian: Quando atterri, ti contattano gli agenti degli Heliarchs che ti avevano fatto atterrare su alcuni mondi e anelli dei Quarg per raccogliere dati. "Capitano <last>, un nuovo compito per te, noi abbiamo," dice il Kimek.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|	"What do you need me to do?"|703|0
units.english: "What do you need me to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|	"I'm sorry, but I'm not willing to risk my ship any longer to help you spy on the Quarg."|704|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm not willing to risk my ship any longer to help you spy on the Quarg."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono disposto a rischiare ancora la mia nave per aiutarvi a spiare i Quarg."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|	"Too large and complex for a quick reading, planets and ringworlds are, so wish to get updated scans on Quarg ships, the consul now does," the Arach says.|706|0
units.english: "Too large and complex for a quick reading, planets and ringworlds are, so wish to get updated scans on Quarg ships, the consul now does," the Arach says.
units.italian: "Troppo grandi e complessi per una lettura rapida, i pianeti e i mondi ad anello sono, quindi desiderio di ottenere scansioni aggiornate delle navi dei Quarg, il console ora ha," dice l'Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|	"Scan them during our war, we of course did, but much more precise now, our technology has become," the Saryd explains. "To use one of our own scanners, we cannot ask of you. Much risk, it would pose, but if to the <planet>, a human outfit scanner you could bring, alter it to suit our purposes, we will."|707|0
units.english: "Scan them during our war, we of course did, but much more precise now, our technology has become," the Saryd explains. "To use one of our own scanners, we cannot ask of you. Much risk, it would pose, but if to the <planet>, a human outfit scanner you could bring, alter it to suit our purposes, we will."
units.italian: "Scansionarli durante la nostra guerra, noi naturalmente lo abbiamo fatto, ma molto più precisa ora, la nostra tecnologia è diventata," spiega il Saryd. "Usare uno dei nostri scanner, noi non possiamo chiedertelo. Troppo rischio, porrebbe, ma se su <planet>, uno scanner per equipaggiamenti umano tu potessi portare, modificarlo per i nostri scopi, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|	"Alright, I'll go there once I have an outfit scanner ready."|709|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll go there once I have an outfit scanner ready."
units.italian: "Va bene, andrò là quando avrò pronto uno scanner per equipaggiamenti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|	"That sounds even more dangerous than what you had me do before. Sorry, but I'm not interested."|710|0
units.english: "That sounds even more dangerous than what you had me do before. Sorry, but I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Sembra ancora più pericoloso di quello che mi avete fatto fare prima. Mi dispiace, ma non sono interessato."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-A|	They thank you for your willingness to help, and tell you they will be waiting on the <destination>.|712|0
units.english: They thank you for your willingness to help, and tell you they will be waiting on the <destination>.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano per la disponibilità ad aiutare e ti dicono che ti aspetteranno su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-B|name|722|0
units.english: Silent Scan
units.italian: Scansione muta

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-B|description|723|0
units.english: Now that the Heliarchs have altered your Outfit Scanner, head to <waypoints> and scan some Quarg ships there, then report back to <destination>.
units.italian: Ora che gli Heliarchs hanno modificato il tuo scanner per equipaggiamenti, recati a <waypoints> e scansiona alcune navi dei Quarg lì, poi riferisci a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-B|The Heliarch agents who spoke to you are ready with a team of engineers once you land. They remove the outfit scanner from your ship and take it to a restricted area. After about an hour, they come back, and while you can't see any visible changes to the outfit, they assure you it is better suited for scanning Quarg ships now.|733|0
units.english: The Heliarch agents who spoke to you are ready with a team of engineers once you land. They remove the outfit scanner from your ship and take it to a restricted area. After about an hour, they come back, and while you can't see any visible changes to the outfit, they assure you it is better suited for scanning Quarg ships now.
units.italian: Gli agenti degli Heliarchs che ti hanno parlato sono pronti con una squadra di ingegneri quando atterri. Togliere lo scanner per equipaggiamenti dalla tua nave e lo portano in un'area riservata. Dopo circa un'ora tornano, e anche se non vedi cambiamenti visibili nell'equipaggiamento, ti assicurano che ora è più adatto a scansionare le navi dei Quarg.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-B|	The agents then come into your ship, asking for your map again. "Now, in the earliest stages of construction, this ring you showed us is," the Arach says, pointing to <waypoints>, where Lagrange is. "Interested in the Quarg ships guarding that system, Consul Aulori is. Suffice, one scan per type of ship there should."|734|0
units.english: The agents then come into your ship, asking for your map again. "Now, in the earliest stages of construction, this ring you showed us is," the Arach says, pointing to <waypoints>, where Lagrange is. "Interested in the Quarg ships guarding that system, Consul Aulori is. Suffice, one scan per type of ship there should."
units.italian: Gli agenti entrano poi nella tua nave e chiedono di nuovo la tua mappa. "Ora, nelle primissime fasi di costruzione, questo anello che ci hai mostrato è," dice l'Arach, indicando <waypoints>, dove si trova Lagrange. "Interessato alle navi dei Quarg che sorvegliano quel sistema, il console Aulori è. Basterà, una scansione per tipo di nave lì dovrebbe."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-B|Once again the engineers remove your outfit scanner, take a copy of the scan logs, and hand it to the Heliarch agents, who give you <payment>. "Grateful to you, we are, Captain <last>," the Saryd says. "Remember your assistance, the consul will."|754|0
units.english: Once again the engineers remove your outfit scanner, take a copy of the scan logs, and hand it to the Heliarch agents, who give you <payment>. "Grateful to you, we are, Captain <last>," the Saryd says. "Remember your assistance, the consul will."
units.italian: Ancora una volta gli ingegneri rimuovono il tuo scanner per equipaggiamenti, prendono una copia dei registri di scansione e la consegnano agli agenti degli Heliarchs, che ti danno <payment>. "Grati a te, noi siamo, Capitano <last>," dice il Saryd. "Ricordare il tuo aiuto, il console lo farà."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-B|	When the engineers return, they put your outfit scanner back in place. The Heliarch agents say their goodbyes, reassuring you that the Quarg shouldn't attack you for this. "If interested in doing some investigation of your own, you wish, maybe land on their rings again, you could," the Kimek suggests. "Maybe find out something of interest for us, you will."|755|0
units.english: When the engineers return, they put your outfit scanner back in place. The Heliarch agents say their goodbyes, reassuring you that the Quarg shouldn't attack you for this. "If interested in doing some investigation of your own, you wish, maybe land on their rings again, you could," the Kimek suggests. "Maybe find out something of interest for us, you will."
units.italian: Quando gli ingegneri tornano, rimettono a posto il tuo scanner per equipaggiamenti. Gli agenti degli Heliarchs si congedano, assicurandoti che i Quarg non dovrebbero attaccarti per questo. "Se interessato a fare qualche indagine per conto tuo, tu desideri, magari atterrare di nuovo sui loro anelli, tu potresti," suggerisce il Kimek. "Magari scoprire qualcosa di interessante per noi, tu potresti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 2-B|	He wishes you safe travels and leaves with his colleagues.|756|0
units.english: He wishes you safe travels and leaves with his colleagues.
units.italian: Ti augura buon viaggio e se ne va con i suoi colleghi.

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|As you land on <origin>, a Quarg is patiently waiting right outside your ship, as if expecting you to open the hatch. You think nothing of it at first, but when you try and access the local news feed, you notice your monitors' interfaces aren't showing any of the local services and facilities. A few more minutes go by until you realize your ship hasn't been refueled either. You look out to see some more Quarg standing by the refueling machines of the landing pad you landed on, simply looking at your ship. Seeing that the other Quarg is still waiting by your hatch, you head outside to speak with it.|770|0
units.english: As you land on <origin>, a Quarg is patiently waiting right outside your ship, as if expecting you to open the hatch. You think nothing of it at first, but when you try and access the local news feed, you notice your monitors' interfaces aren't showing any of the local services and facilities. A few more minutes go by until you realize your ship hasn't been refueled either. You look out to see some more Quarg standing by the refueling machines of the landing pad you landed on, simply looking at your ship. Seeing that the other Quarg is still waiting by your hatch, you head outside to speak with it.
units.italian: Mentre atterri su <origin>, un Quarg aspetta con pazienza proprio fuori dalla tua nave, come se si aspettasse che tu apra il portello. All'inizio non ci fai caso, ma quando provi ad accedere al notiziario locale, noti che le interfacce dei monitor non mostrano nessuno dei servizi e delle strutture locali. Passano altri minuti prima che tu ti accorga che la nave non è stata nemmeno rifornita. Guardi fuori e vedi altri Quarg in piedi accanto alle macchine di rifornimento della piazzola dove sei atterrato, che si limitano a guardare la tua nave. Visto che l'altro Quarg sta ancora aspettando vicino al portello, esci a parlargli.

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"Hello, <first> <last>," it says.|771|0
units.english: "Hello, <first> <last>," it says.
units.italian: "Salve, <first> <last>," dice.

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"Hello, can I help you?"|773|0
units.english: "Hello, can I help you?"
units.italian: "Salve, posso aiutarla?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"Is there some sort of problem?"|774|0
units.english: "Is there some sort of problem?"
units.italian: "C'è qualche problema?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	It blinks, then slowly looks to a Wardragon parked farther away. "You were seen landing on some of our worlds and rings, bringing about strange scanning mechanisms, and were also found to be scanning some of our ships. Why is that?"|775|0
units.english: It blinks, then slowly looks to a Wardragon parked farther away. "You were seen landing on some of our worlds and rings, bringing about strange scanning mechanisms, and were also found to be scanning some of our ships. Why is that?"
units.italian: Sbatte le palpebre, poi guarda lentamente un Wardragon parcheggiato più lontano. "Sei stato visto atterrare su alcuni dei nostri mondi e anelli, portando strani meccanismi di scansione, e sei stato anche scoperto a scansionare alcune delle nostre navi. Perché?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"I was just curious about your species."|777|0
units.english: "I was just curious about your species."
units.italian: "Ero solo curioso della vostra specie."

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"What are you talking about? I never did any of that."|779|0
units.english: "What are you talking about? I never did any of that."
units.italian: "Di che cosa parli? Non ho mai fatto nulla di tutto questo."

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"Scanning? I'm sorry, I think my ship just had some malfunctions. I didn't mean to offend."|781|0
units.english: "Scanning? I'm sorry, I think my ship just had some malfunctions. I didn't mean to offend."
units.italian: "Scansionare? Mi dispiace, credo che la mia nave abbia avuto qualche malfunzionamento. Non volevo offendere."

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"The Heliarchs asked me to do it."|783|0
units.english: "The Heliarchs asked me to do it."
units.italian: "Sono stati gli Heliarchs a chiedermelo."

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	Around ten seconds pass without it saying anything, simply staring at your eyes and blinking slowly. "I see." Without another word, it walks away, heading toward the Wardragon.|786|0
units.english: Around ten seconds pass without it saying anything, simply staring at your eyes and blinking slowly. "I see." Without another word, it walks away, heading toward the Wardragon.
units.italian: Passano una decina di secondi senza che dica nulla, limitandosi a guardarti negli occhi e a sbattere le palpebre lentamente. "Capisco." Senza un'altra parola si allontana, diretto verso il Wardragon.

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"And why did you agree? Do you wish to join their ranks, perhaps?" it asks.|789|0
units.english: "And why did you agree? Do you wish to join their ranks, perhaps?" it asks.
units.italian: "E perché hai accettato? Desideri forse unirti ai loro ranghi?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"I just wanted to help. It's not like I destroyed your ships or something."|791|0
units.english: "I just wanted to help. It's not like I destroyed your ships or something."
units.italian: "Volevo solo aiutare. Non è che abbia distrutto le vostre navi o roba simile."

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"They told me that the Quarg keep others in 'separate boxes,' and that you hinder their development."|792|0
units.english: "They told me that the Quarg keep others in 'separate boxes,' and that you hinder their development."
units.italian: "Mi hanno detto che i Quarg tengono gli altri in 'scatole separate', e che voi ostacolate il loro sviluppo."

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"Perhaps not, but you agreed to collect information on us and our worlds, which hold countless civilians, and deliver the findings to a group that despises us."|794|0
units.english: "Perhaps not, but you agreed to collect information on us and our worlds, which hold countless civilians, and deliver the findings to a group that despises us."
units.italian: "Forse no, ma hai accettato di raccogliere informazioni su di noi e sui nostri mondi, che ospitano innumerevoli civili, e di consegnare i risultati a un gruppo che ci disprezza."

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	"And you believe that? Have we restricted your movement? Chastised you for interacting with the Hai or Korath? Even after you agreed to help those foolish, tyrannical Heliarchs, are you not here, in one of our worlds, peacefully conversing with a Quarg?"|797|0
units.english: "And you believe that? Have we restricted your movement? Chastised you for interacting with the Hai or Korath? Even after you agreed to help those foolish, tyrannical Heliarchs, are you not here, in one of our worlds, peacefully conversing with a Quarg?"
units.italian: "E tu ci credi? Abbiamo forse limitato i tuoi movimenti? Ti abbiamo punito per aver interagito con gli Hai o i Korath? Anche dopo aver accettato di aiutare quei folli e tirannici Heliarchs, non sei forse qui, su uno dei nostri mondi, a conversare pacificamente con un Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Interrogation|	It blinks a few more times as a few small stripes on its face rapidly alternate between shades of deep blue and bright red. It then ends with, "It would be most wise to cut off all your ties with these 'Heliarchs,' human." It walks away, headed to the Wardragon it looked at before.|799|0
units.english: It blinks a few more times as a few small stripes on its face rapidly alternate between shades of deep blue and bright red. It then ends with, "It would be most wise to cut off all your ties with these 'Heliarchs,' human." It walks away, headed to the Wardragon it looked at before.
units.italian: Sbatte le palpebre ancora qualche volta mentre alcune piccole strisce sul suo viso si alternano rapidamente tra sfumature di blu profondo e rosso acceso. Poi conclude: "Sarebbe molto saggio troncare tutti i tuoi legami con questi 'Heliarchs', umano." Si allontana, diretto al Wardragon che aveva guardato prima.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|name|811|0
units.english: Preparations for Scanning
units.italian: Preparare la scansione

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|description|812|0
units.english: Head to <destination>, where the Heliarchs will discuss the next recon task they have for you.
units.italian: Recati a <destination>, dove gli Heliarchs discuteranno il prossimo compito di ricognizione che hanno per te.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|Upon landing, you're contacted by the Heliarch agents who have had you scan Quarg worlds and ships. "Hello again, Captain <last>!" the Kimek greets you. "Thank you again, we must, for your latest service. Much more detailed than what we had, your scans are."|824|0
units.english: Upon landing, you're contacted by the Heliarch agents who have had you scan Quarg worlds and ships. "Hello again, Captain <last>!" the Kimek greets you. "Thank you again, we must, for your latest service. Much more detailed than what we had, your scans are."
units.italian: All'atterraggio ti contattano gli agenti degli Heliarchs che ti hanno fatto scansionare mondi e navi dei Quarg. "Di nuovo salve, Capitano <last>!" ti saluta il Kimek. "Ringraziarti ancora, noi dobbiamo, per il tuo ultimo servizio. Molto più dettagliate di quelle che avevamo, le tue scansioni sono."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	The Saryd interrupts him. "Not... satisfied with them, Consul Aulori was, however. Tasked with acquiring your help again, we were."|825|0
units.english: The Saryd interrupts him. "Not... satisfied with them, Consul Aulori was, however. Tasked with acquiring your help again, we were."
units.italian: Il Saryd lo interrompe. "Non... soddisfatto di esse, il console Aulori è stato, però. Incaricati di ottenere di nuovo il tuo aiuto, noi siamo stati."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"An exception, the council has decided to make," the Arach explains. "Granted one of our Scanning Modules, you will be. Just for the mission, it is, so return it once it's over, you must. Install it on your ship, a team on the <planet> will."|828|0
units.english: "An exception, the council has decided to make," the Arach explains. "Granted one of our Scanning Modules, you will be. Just for the mission, it is, so return it once it's over, you must. Install it on your ship, a team on the <planet> will."
units.italian: "Un'eccezione, il consiglio ha deciso di fare," spiega l'Arach. "Concederti uno dei nostri moduli di scansione, ti sarà. Solo per la missione, è, quindi restituirlo una volta finita, tu devi. Installarlo sulla tua nave, una squadra su <planet> lo farà."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"A 'proper' close-up scan, with a Heliarch Scanning Module, the consul wants," the Arach explains. "Now that in our ranks, you are, simple enough for you, purchasing one should be. Once ready, you are, head to the <planet> to hear the plan, you must."|831|0
units.english: "A 'proper' close-up scan, with a Heliarch Scanning Module, the consul wants," the Arach explains. "Now that in our ranks, you are, simple enough for you, purchasing one should be. Once ready, you are, head to the <planet> to hear the plan, you must."
units.italian: "Una scansione ravvicinata 'come si deve', con un modulo di scansione degli Heliarchs, il console vuole," spiega l'Arach. "Ora che nei nostri ranghi, tu sei, abbastanza semplice per te, acquistarne uno dovrebbe essere. Una volta pronto, tu sei, recarti su <planet> per sentire il piano, tu devi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Okay, I'll be heading there as soon as possible."|834|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll be heading there as soon as possible."
units.italian: "Va bene, andrò là il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Sorry, but I don't want to risk upsetting the Quarg any more than I already have."|836|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't want to risk upsetting the Quarg any more than I already have."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non voglio rischiare di urtare i Quarg più di quanto abbia già fatto."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Why didn't you just have me do that last time?"|838|0
units.english: "Why didn't you just have me do that last time?"
units.italian: "Perché non me lo avete fatto fare l'ultima volta?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Restricted technology, it is. For Heliarch use only," the Arach tells you.|841|0
units.english: "Restricted technology, it is. For Heliarch use only," the Arach tells you.
units.italian: "Tecnologia riservata, è. Solo per uso degli Heliarchs," ti dice l'Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Dangerous for you, it also was," the Saryd adds. "Provoked into attacking you, the Quarg might have been, if our technology, on your ship they noticed."|842|0
units.english: "Dangerous for you, it also was," the Saryd adds. "Provoked into attacking you, the Quarg might have been, if our technology, on your ship they noticed."
units.italian: "Pericoloso per te, lo era anche," aggiunge il Saryd. "Provocati ad attaccarti, i Quarg sarebbero potuti essere, se la nostra tecnologia, sulla tua nave avessero notato."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"And why would that be any different this time?"|844|0
units.english: "And why would that be any different this time?"
units.italian: "E perché questa volta dovrebbe essere diverso?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Well, I don't want to risk any of that. Sorry, but I can't help you."|846|0
units.english: "Well, I don't want to risk any of that. Sorry, but I can't help you."
units.italian: "Beh, non voglio rischiare nulla di tutto questo. Mi dispiace, ma non posso aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Dangerous for you, it could have been," the Arach explains. "Provoked the Quarg into attacking you, it might have."|849|0
units.english: "Dangerous for you, it could have been," the Arach explains. "Provoked the Quarg into attacking you, it might have."
units.italian: "Pericoloso per te, sarebbe potuto essere," spiega l'Arach. "Provocare i Quarg ad attaccarti, avrebbe potuto."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"And why would that be any different this time?"|851|0
units.english: "And why would that be any different this time?"
units.italian: "E perché questa volta dovrebbe essere diverso?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Well, I don't want to risk any of that. Sorry, but I can't help you."|852|0
units.english: "Well, I don't want to risk any of that. Sorry, but I can't help you."
units.italian: "Beh, non voglio rischiare nulla di tutto questo. Mi dispiace, ma non posso aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Come upon some valuable information, the consuls have," the Saryd responds. "A much safer, easier task it would be. Until at the <planet>, you are, permitted to discuss the details, we are not. Interested in helping us once again, are you, Captain?"|855|0
units.english: "Come upon some valuable information, the consuls have," the Saryd responds. "A much safer, easier task it would be. Until at the <planet>, you are, permitted to discuss the details, we are not. Interested in helping us once again, are you, Captain?"
units.italian: "Incappati in alcune informazioni preziose, i consoli sono," risponde il Saryd. "Un compito molto più sicuro e facile sarebbe. Finché su <planet>, tu non sia, permetterci di discutere i dettagli, noi non possiamo. Interessato ad aiutarci ancora una volta, tu sei, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Alright, if you're sure it'll be safe, I'll help you."|857|0
units.english: "Alright, if you're sure it'll be safe, I'll help you."
units.italian: "Va bene, se sei sicuro che sarà sicuro, vi aiuterò."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Sorry, I don't like the sound of this."|859|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't like the sound of this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi piace come suona."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	They are both surprised and distraught by your refusal, clearly not having expected it. They insist a bit further, but eventually give up on trying to convince you to help. Disappointed, they leave for a Heliarch office.|863|0
units.english: They are both surprised and distraught by your refusal, clearly not having expected it. They insist a bit further, but eventually give up on trying to convince you to help. Disappointed, they leave for a Heliarch office.
units.italian: Restano entrambi sorpresi e afflitti dal tuo rifiuto, chiaramente non se lo aspettavano. Insistono ancora un po', ma alla fine rinunciano a convincerti ad aiutare. Delusi, si dirigono verso un ufficio degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	They are both surprised and distraught by your refusal, clearly not having expected it. Their expressions then coalesce into cold, fearful gazes. They whisper briefly among themselves, then the Saryd addresses you.|866|0
units.english: They are both surprised and distraught by your refusal, clearly not having expected it. Their expressions then coalesce into cold, fearful gazes. They whisper briefly among themselves, then the Saryd addresses you.
units.italian: Restano entrambi sorpresi e afflitti dal tuo rifiuto, chiaramente non se lo aspettavano. Le loro espressioni si fondono poi in sguardi freddi e timorosi. Sussurrano brevemente tra loro, poi il Saryd si rivolge a te.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Captain, insist we must. An order from the consul, it is. In our ranks now you are, so do you should as dictates the chain of command."|867|0
units.english: "Captain, insist we must. An order from the consul, it is. In our ranks now you are, so do you should as dictates the chain of command."
units.italian: "Capitano, insistere noi dobbiamo. Un ordine del console, è. Nei nostri ranghi ora tu sei, quindi fare ciò che la catena di comando impone, tu dovresti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Lose your rank, you could, if to disobey such an order you were. For the best it is that continue aiding us and the consul, you do," the Kimek continues.|868|0
units.english: "Lose your rank, you could, if to disobey such an order you were. For the best it is that continue aiding us and the consul, you do," the Kimek continues.
units.italian: "Perdere il tuo grado, potresti, se disobbedire a un tale ordine tu osassi. Per il meglio è che continuare ad aiutarci e il console, tu lo faccia," continua il Kimek.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-A|	"Continue, you will. Inform the consul of that we shall." The Arach says, bringing out a device and seemingly confirming you'll be heading to <destination>. Without giving you much window to protest, the three thank you for your compliance and board a Heliarch ship.|869|0
units.english: "Continue, you will. Inform the consul of that we shall." The Arach says, bringing out a device and seemingly confirming you'll be heading to <destination>. Without giving you much window to protest, the three thank you for your compliance and board a Heliarch ship.
units.italian: "Continuare, tu lo farai. Informare il console di questo, noi lo faremo." Dice l'Arach, tirando fuori un dispositivo e confermando apparentemente che andrai a <destination>. Senza darti molto spazio per protestare, i tre ti ringraziano per la tua obbedienza e salgono su una nave degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|name|881|0
units.english: Not So Silent Scan
units.italian: Scansione non così silenziosa

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|description|882|0
units.english: Now that your ship is equipped with a Heliarch Scanning Module, head to the <waypoints> system and scan the Quarg Wardragon there.
units.italian: Ora che la tua nave è equipaggiata con un modulo di scansione degli Heliarchs, recati nel sistema <waypoints> e scansiona il Wardragon dei Quarg che si trova lì.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|The Heliarch agents and engineers are waiting for you when you land, immediately getting to work on installing the Scanning Module in your ship.|895|0
units.english: The Heliarch agents and engineers are waiting for you when you land, immediately getting to work on installing the Scanning Module in your ship.
units.italian: Gli agenti e gli ingegneri degli Heliarchs ti aspettano quando atterri, e si mettono subito al lavoro per installare il modulo di scansione sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"Remember Captain, only borrowing, you are. Once returned, you have, take our scanner back, we will," the Saryd says.|896|0
units.english: "Remember Captain, only borrowing, you are. Once returned, you have, take our scanner back, we will," the Saryd says.
units.italian: "Ricorda Capitano: solo in prestito, tu lo hai. Una volta restituito, tu lo avrai, riprendere il nostro scanner, noi lo faremo," dice il Saryd.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"At most until <date>, keep it, you may. Considered theft, it will be, if any longer you take," the Arach adds.|897|0
units.english: "At most until <date>, keep it, you may. Considered theft, it will be, if any longer you take," the Arach adds.
units.italian: "Al massimo fino a <date>, tenerlo, tu potrai. Considerato furto, sarà, se più a lungo tu lo terrai," aggiunge l'Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"And will that time be enough?"|899|0
units.english: "And will that time be enough?"
units.italian: "E quel tempo sarà abbastanza?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"What exactly will I do with this scanner?"|900|0
units.english: "What exactly will I do with this scanner?"
units.italian: "Che cosa farò esattamente con questo scanner?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"Normally, unavailable for us low ranks, this information would be," the Kimek begins. "But, instructed us on it, Consul Aulori has, so that relay the plan to you we could. Learned, the consuls have, that guarding a nearby archaeological site in human space, a lone Quarg Wardragon is. Aware of that, were you?"|901|0
units.english: "Normally, unavailable for us low ranks, this information would be," the Kimek begins. "But, instructed us on it, Consul Aulori has, so that relay the plan to you we could. Learned, the consuls have, that guarding a nearby archaeological site in human space, a lone Quarg Wardragon is. Aware of that, were you?"
units.italian: "Normalmente, indisponibili ai nostri ranghi bassi, queste informazioni sarebbero," comincia il Kimek. "Ma, istruiti su di esse, il console Aulori ci ha, così che illustrarti il piano potessimo. Appreso, i consoli hanno, che a sorvegliare un vicino sito archeologico nello spazio umano, un solo Wardragon dei Quarg è. Consapevole di questo, tu eri?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	You confirm it, explaining to them that you were involved in the work around the site on Zug, and were there when the Wardragon came in to protect it.|902|0
units.english: You confirm it, explaining to them that you were involved in the work around the site on Zug, and were there when the Wardragon came in to protect it.
units.italian: Lo confermi, spiegando loro che sei stato coinvolto nel lavoro intorno al sito su Zug, e che eri lì quando il Wardragon è arrivato a proteggerlo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"Then no trouble finding it, you should have," the Arach says. "Far from other Quarg, that ship is, so easier for you to flee, it should be, if attack you it does."|903|0
units.english: "Then no trouble finding it, you should have," the Arach says. "Far from other Quarg, that ship is, so easier for you to flee, it should be, if attack you it does."
units.italian: "Allora nessuna difficoltà a trovarlo, tu dovresti avere," dice l'Arach. "Lontano dagli altri Quarg, quella nave è, quindi più facile per te fuggire, dovrebbe essere, se ti attacca."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"All we need, a quick scan is," the Saryd tells you. "Once scanned it, you have, come back right away, you should."|904|0
units.english: "All we need, a quick scan is," the Saryd tells you. "Once scanned it, you have, come back right away, you should."
units.italian: "Tutto ciò che ci serve, una rapida scansione è," ti dice il Saryd. "Una volta scansionato, tu lo avrai, tornare subito indietro, tu dovresti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	You're warned not to disable or destroy the Wardragon should it attack you, as that would no doubt permanently damage your standing with the Quarg.|905|0
units.english: You're warned not to disable or destroy the Wardragon should it attack you, as that would no doubt permanently damage your standing with the Quarg.
units.italian: Ti avvertono di non neutralizzare né distruggere il Wardragon se ti attacca, perché ciò danneggerebbe senza dubbio in modo permanente la tua reputazione con i Quarg.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	When the engineers are done, the agents wish you good luck, and you head back inside your ship.|906|0
units.english: When the engineers are done, the agents wish you good luck, and you head back inside your ship.
units.italian: Quando gli ingegneri hanno finito, gli agenti ti augurano buona fortuna, e rientri nella tua nave.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|log|924|0
units.english: Scanned the Quarg Wardragon flying around the Zubeneschamali system, and delivered the scan logs to the Heliarchs.
units.italian: Hai scansionato il Wardragon dei Quarg che volava intorno al sistema Zubeneschamali, e consegnato i registri della scansione agli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|The Heliarch agents have the engineers remove their scanners from your ship immediately when you land back. They seem pleased with the results, looking at the scan logs for the first time as they hand you <payment>.|928|0
units.english: The Heliarch agents have the engineers remove their scanners from your ship immediately when you land back. They seem pleased with the results, looking at the scan logs for the first time as they hand you <payment>.
units.italian: Gli agenti degli Heliarchs fanno togliere immediatamente i loro scanner dalla tua nave dagli ingegneri quando atterri al ritorno. Sembrano soddisfatti dei risultati, guardando i registri di scansione per la prima volta mentre ti consegnano <payment>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"Survived, you thankfully have, Captain," the Saryd taps your arm.|929|0
units.english: "Survived, you thankfully have, Captain," the Saryd taps your arm.
units.italian: "Sopravvissuto, per fortuna tu sei, Capitano," il Saryd ti tocca il braccio.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"Odd, it is, that attack the Captain, the Wardragon did not..." the Arach thinks out loud, looking at the scan data. "A fortunate thing, no doubt, but very odd of them."|930|0
units.english: "Odd, it is, that attack the Captain, the Wardragon did not..." the Arach thinks out loud, looking at the scan data. "A fortunate thing, no doubt, but very odd of them."
units.italian: "Strano, è, che non abbia attaccato il Capitano, il Wardragon..." riflette ad alta voce l'Arach, guardando i dati della scansione. "Una cosa fortunata, senza dubbio, ma molto strano da parte loro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	"Much more detailed, these scans are. Certain, I am, that pleased with the results, Consul Aulori will be," the Kimek tells you. "Assisted us greatly you have, Captain."|931|0
units.english: "Much more detailed, these scans are. Certain, I am, that pleased with the results, Consul Aulori will be," the Kimek tells you. "Assisted us greatly you have, Captain."
units.italian: "Molto più dettagliate, queste scansioni sono. Certa, io sono, che soddisfatto dei risultati, il console Aulori sarà," ti dice il Kimek. "Aiutati molto, tu ci hai, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-B|	They pass along a message from the consul, who thanks you for all your efforts, and asks that you seek out his agents on <planet>, should you acquire any significant information on Quarg ships or ringworlds. The Heliarchs say their goodbyes and head on their way.|932|0
units.english: They pass along a message from the consul, who thanks you for all your efforts, and asks that you seek out his agents on <planet>, should you acquire any significant information on Quarg ships or ringworlds. The Heliarchs say their goodbyes and head on their way.
units.italian: Ti passano un messaggio del console, che ti ringrazia per tutti i tuoi sforzi e ti chiede di cercare i suoi agenti su <planet>, qualora tu ottenga informazioni significative sulle navi o sui mondi ad anello dei Quarg. Gli Heliarchs si congedano e si avviano.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|name|936|0
units.english: Not So Silent Scan
units.italian: Scansione non così silenziosa

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|description|937|0
units.english: Now that your ship is equipped with a Heliarch Scanning Module, head to the <waypoints> system and scan the Quarg Wardragon there.
units.italian: Ora che la tua nave è equipaggiata con un modulo di scansione degli Heliarchs, recati nel sistema <waypoints> e scansiona il Wardragon dei Quarg che si trova lì.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|The Heliarch agents are waiting for you when you land with a team of engineers. They have them perform some quick tests on your Scanning Module.|949|0
units.english: The Heliarch agents are waiting for you when you land with a team of engineers. They have them perform some quick tests on your Scanning Module.
units.italian: Gli agenti degli Heliarchs ti aspettano all'atterraggio con una squadra di ingegneri. Fanno eseguire loro alcuni test rapidi sul tuo modulo di scansione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|	"Take your time with this task, you of course can, Captain, but told us to ask you to be hasty, Consul Aulori has," the Arach says. "Unsure about how long this window of opportunity will last, all of us are."|950|0
units.english: "Take your time with this task, you of course can, Captain, but told us to ask you to be hasty, Consul Aulori has," the Arach says. "Unsure about how long this window of opportunity will last, all of us are."
units.italian: "Prenderti il tuo tempo con questo compito, tu naturalmente puoi, Capitano, ma chiestoci di domandarti di fare in fretta, il console Aulori lo ha," dice l'Arach. "Incerti su quanto durerà questa finestra di opportunità, tutti noi siamo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|	"What's this 'window of opportunity' about?"|952|0
units.english: "What's this 'window of opportunity' about?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa si tratta, questa 'finestra di opportunità'?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|	"What exactly is the task?"|953|0
units.english: "What exactly is the task?"
units.italian: "Qual è esattamente il compito?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|log|974|0
units.english: Scanned the Quarg Wardragon flying around the Zubeneschamali system, and delivered the scan logs to the Heliarchs.
units.italian: Hai scansionato il Wardragon dei Quarg che volava intorno al sistema Zubeneschamali, e consegnato i registri della scansione agli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|The Heliarch agents seem pleased with the results, looking at the scan logs for the first time as they hand you <payment>.|977|0
units.english: The Heliarch agents seem pleased with the results, looking at the scan logs for the first time as they hand you <payment>.
units.italian: Gli agenti degli Heliarchs sembrano soddisfatti dei risultati, guardando i registri di scansione per la prima volta mentre ti consegnano <payment>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|	"Survived, you thankfully have, Captain," the Saryd taps your arm.|978|0
units.english: "Survived, you thankfully have, Captain," the Saryd taps your arm.
units.italian: "Sopravvissuto, per fortuna tu sei, Capitano," il Saryd ti tocca il braccio.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|	"Odd, it is, that attack the Captain, the Wardragon did not..." the Arach thinks out loud, looking at the scan data. "A fortunate thing, no doubt, but very odd of them."|979|0
units.english: "Odd, it is, that attack the Captain, the Wardragon did not..." the Arach thinks out loud, looking at the scan data. "A fortunate thing, no doubt, but very odd of them."
units.italian: "Strano, è, che non abbia attaccato il Capitano, il Wardragon..." riflette ad alta voce l'Arach, guardando i dati della scansione. "Una cosa fortunata, senza dubbio, ma molto strano da parte loro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|	"Much more detailed, these scans are. Certain, I am, that pleased with the results, Consul Aulori will be," the Kimek tells you. "Assisted us greatly you have, Captain."|980|0
units.english: "Much more detailed, these scans are. Certain, I am, that pleased with the results, Consul Aulori will be," the Kimek tells you. "Assisted us greatly you have, Captain."
units.italian: "Molto più dettagliate, queste scansioni sono. Certa, io sono, che soddisfatto dei risultati, il console Aulori sarà," ti dice il Kimek. "Aiutati molto, tu ci hai, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Recon 3-C|	They pass along a message from the consul, who thanks you for all your efforts, and asks that you seek out his agents on <planet> should you acquire any significant information on the Quarg ships or ringworlds. The Heliarchs say their goodbyes and head on their way.|981|0
units.english: They pass along a message from the consul, who thanks you for all your efforts, and asks that you seek out his agents on <planet> should you acquire any significant information on the Quarg ships or ringworlds. The Heliarchs say their goodbyes and head on their way.
units.italian: Ti passano un messaggio del console, che ti ringrazia per tutti i tuoi sforzi e ti chiede di cercare i suoi agenti su <planet> qualora tu ottenga informazioni significative sulle navi o sui mondi ad anello dei Quarg. Gli Heliarchs si congedano e si avviano.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|name|1002|0
units.english: Extraterritorial Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione extraterritoriale

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|description|1003|0
units.english: Head through the wormhole in Deneb, land on the planet there, and enter the system with the broken ringworld to get data for the Heliarchy.
units.italian: Attraversa il cunicolo spaziale in Deneb, atterra sul pianeta che c'è, ed entra nel sistema con il mondo ad anello rotto per ottenere dati per l'Eliarchia.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|As you land on the <origin>, you remember that the Heliarchs have asked you to share with them any information you get on Quarg ships and ringworlds. Would you like to tell them about the destroyed ring you saw on the other side of the wormhole in Deneb?|1015|0
units.english: As you land on the <origin>, you remember that the Heliarchs have asked you to share with them any information you get on Quarg ships and ringworlds. Would you like to tell them about the destroyed ring you saw on the other side of the wormhole in Deneb?
units.italian: Mentre atterri su <origin>, ricordi che gli Heliarchs ti hanno chiesto di condividere con loro qualsiasi informazione su navi e mondi ad anello dei Quarg. Vuoi raccontare loro dell'anello distrutto che hai visto dall'altra parte del cunicolo in Deneb?

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	(Yes.)|1017|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	(Not right now.)|1018|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	(No, they don't need to know.)|1020|0
units.english: (No, they don't need to know.)
units.italian: (No, non hanno bisogno di saperlo.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	You flag down a group of Heliarch agents who were walking by, and they salute you. "A valuable friend, you've proven to be, Captain," a Saryd of the group says. "Of assistance, how can we be?"|1022|0
units.english: You flag down a group of Heliarch agents who were walking by, and they salute you. "A valuable friend, you've proven to be, Captain," a Saryd of the group says. "Of assistance, how can we be?"
units.italian: Fermi un gruppo di agenti degli Heliarchs che passava di lì, e ti salutano. "Un amico prezioso, tu si è dimostrato, Capitano," dice un Saryd del gruppo. "In che modo possiamo esserle utili?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Can you bring me to a higher-up? I have some information on ringworlds."|1024|0
units.english: "Can you bring me to a higher-up? I have some information on ringworlds."
units.italian: "Potete portarmi da un superiore? Ho delle informazioni sui mondi ad anello."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Is there anyone I can talk to about a broken ringworld?"|1025|0
units.english: "Is there anyone I can talk to about a broken ringworld?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcuno con cui posso parlare di un mondo ad anello rotto?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	The group discusses among themselves for a bit before bringing you into a restricted section of the ringworld. The inner halls of the <origin> are unlike those of any other Heliarch facility you've been to, with messy arrays of large canisters, equipment boxes, and some form of isolating texture plastered all over the walls, floor and ceiling. Most notable of all, though, is the sheer number of guards stationed here, which, if the few halls you've passed are anything to go by, might well outnumber the civilians present in the ring. "Wait here, please," the Heliarchs escorting you tell you, opening a door to something akin to a conference room. They offer you a seat on one end of a long table.|1026|0
units.english: The group discusses among themselves for a bit before bringing you into a restricted section of the ringworld. The inner halls of the <origin> are unlike those of any other Heliarch facility you've been to, with messy arrays of large canisters, equipment boxes, and some form of isolating texture plastered all over the walls, floor and ceiling. Most notable of all, though, is the sheer number of guards stationed here, which, if the few halls you've passed are anything to go by, might well outnumber the civilians present in the ring. "Wait here, please," the Heliarchs escorting you tell you, opening a door to something akin to a conference room. They offer you a seat on one end of a long table.
units.italian: Il gruppo discute tra sé per un po' prima di portarti in una sezione riservata del mondo ad anello. I corridoi interni di <origin> sono diversi da quelli di qualsiasi altra struttura degli Heliarchs in cui sei stato: file disordinate di grandi contenitori, casse di attrezzature e una specie di rivestimento isolante incollato su pareti, pavimento e soffitto. La cosa più notevole, però, è il numero enorme di guardie di stanza qui che, a giudicare dai pochi corridoi che hai attraversato, potrebbero ben superare i civili presenti nell'anello. "Aspetti qui, per favore," ti dicono gli Heliarchs che ti scortano, aprendo una porta su qualcosa di simile a una sala conferenze. Ti offrono un posto a un'estremità di un lungo tavolo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	Some ten minutes pass before anyone comes in, but after that many Heliarch members start filling up the room, taking their own seats at the table. When the door opens for the last of them to come in, the guard announces "Consul Aulori," to which all the Helliarchs stand up and salute, the noise of conversation giving room to hooves hitting the ground. He is an old Saryd, with gray eyes, pale hair, and a short, well-kept beard. He wears a peculiar necklace with four large gemstones hanging from it. He sits opposite to you, the other Heliarchs sitting back down when he does.|1027|0
units.english: Some ten minutes pass before anyone comes in, but after that many Heliarch members start filling up the room, taking their own seats at the table. When the door opens for the last of them to come in, the guard announces "Consul Aulori," to which all the Helliarchs stand up and salute, the noise of conversation giving room to hooves hitting the ground. He is an old Saryd, with gray eyes, pale hair, and a short, well-kept beard. He wears a peculiar necklace with four large gemstones hanging from it. He sits opposite to you, the other Heliarchs sitting back down when he does.
units.italian: Passano una decina di minuti prima che entri qualcuno, ma dopo di ciò molti membri degli Heliarchs cominciano a riempire la stanza, prendendo posto al tavolo. Quando la porta si apre per l'ultimo di loro, la guardia annuncia "Console Aulori", e tutti gli Heliarchs si alzano in piedi e salutano, il brusio delle conversazioni lasciando spazio agli zoccoli che battono sul pavimento. È un Saryd anziano, con occhi grigi, capelli chiari e una barba corta e ben curata. Porta una collana particolare con quattro grandi pietre preziose appese. Si siede di fronte a te, e gli altri Heliarchs si risiedono quando lo fa lui.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Forgive me for the delay you must, colleagues," he says to the other Heliarchs. "Caught up in my evening prayers, I was." He examines the room for a while, briefly glancing at each of the Heliarchs, until his eyes settle on yours. "Told, I was, that some valuable information for us, you have, Captain <last>."|1028|0
units.english: "Forgive me for the delay you must, colleagues," he says to the other Heliarchs. "Caught up in my evening prayers, I was." He examines the room for a while, briefly glancing at each of the Heliarchs, until his eyes settle on yours. "Told, I was, that some valuable information for us, you have, Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Perdonarmi il ritardo, voi dovete, colleghi," dice agli altri Heliarchs. "Preso dalle mie preghiere serali, io ero." Esamina la stanza per un po', lanciando brevi sguardi a ciascuno degli Heliarchs, finché i suoi occhi non si fermano sui tuoi. "Detto, mi è stato, che alcune informazioni preziose per noi, tu hai, Capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"I know of a system where a broken Quarg ringworld is. I figured I should tell you."|1030|0
units.english: "I know of a system where a broken Quarg ringworld is. I figured I should tell you."
units.italian: "Conosco un sistema dove c'è un mondo ad anello dei Quarg rotto. Ho pensato che doveste saperlo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Would I be paid if I told you about a place where you can find a broken Quarg ringworld?"|1031|0
units.english: "Would I be paid if I told you about a place where you can find a broken Quarg ringworld?"
units.italian: "Verrei pagato se vi dicessi di un luogo dove potete trovare un mondo ad anello dei Quarg rotto?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	He squints his eyes, then speaks, "Repeat that, could you?" You say it again, and he once more looks puzzled. He gestures to a Heliarch beside him, then takes off the translation box from around his neck, swapping it for theirs.|1032|0
units.english: He squints his eyes, then speaks, "Repeat that, could you?" You say it again, and he once more looks puzzled. He gestures to a Heliarch beside him, then takes off the translation box from around his neck, swapping it for theirs.
units.italian: Strizza gli occhi, poi parla: "Ripeterlo, potresti?" Lo dici di nuovo, e lui sembra di nuovo perplesso. Fa cenno a un Heliarch accanto a sé, poi si toglie la scatola di traduzione dal collo e la scambia con la loro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	He asks again, and you repeat it again. "An... incomplete ringworld, is it?"|1033|0
units.english: He asks again, and you repeat it again. "An... incomplete ringworld, is it?"
units.italian: Chiede di nuovo, e tu ripeti ancora. "Un... mondo ad anello incompleto, è?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"No, it is definitely broken. There's tons of debris littering the system, and no sign of life in it."|1035|0
units.english: "No, it is definitely broken. There's tons of debris littering the system, and no sign of life in it."
units.italian: "No, è decisamente rotto. Ci sono tonnellate di detriti sparsi per il sistema, e nessun segno di vita."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"I didn't say incomplete, I said broken. I know the difference."|1037|0
units.english: "I didn't say incomplete, I said broken. I know the difference."
units.italian: "Non ho detto incompleto, ho detto rotto. So la differenza."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	The other Heliarchs freeze at your tone, and all keep staring at you, as if afraid to look toward Aulori for his reaction.|1038|0
units.english: The other Heliarchs freeze at your tone, and all keep staring at you, as if afraid to look toward Aulori for his reaction.
units.italian: Gli altri Heliarchs si bloccano al tuo tono, e continuano tutti a fissarti, come se temessero di guardare verso Aulori per la sua reazione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	He stares intently at you for a few seconds, then at the agents guarding the entry door. They open it, and call for some more Heliarchs. They come in and position themselves to your sides, and behind you. "Afraid I am that once again, failed to understand it I have, <first> <last>. Now, one final time, repeat it, would you?" Reading the room, you carefully repeat the information, taking care to not come off as impolite again.|1041|0
units.english: He stares intently at you for a few seconds, then at the agents guarding the entry door. They open it, and call for some more Heliarchs. They come in and position themselves to your sides, and behind you. "Afraid I am that once again, failed to understand it I have, <first> <last>. Now, one final time, repeat it, would you?" Reading the room, you carefully repeat the information, taking care to not come off as impolite again.
units.italian: Ti fissa intensamente per qualche secondo, poi guarda gli agenti che sorvegliano la porta d'ingresso. La aprono e chiamano altri Heliarchs. Entrano e si posizionano ai tuoi fianchi e dietro di te. "Temo che ancora una volta, capirlo io non sia riuscito, <first> <last>. Ora, un'ultima volta, ripeterlo, potresti?" Leggendo l'atmosfera, ripeti con attenzione l'informazione, badando a non sembrare di nuovo irriguardoso.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Do you now?" He begins. "And hope might I that get to explaining the difference, today still you shall? Require my attention, important work does, so if done being insubordinate, you are, suggest I do that enlighten us all on the difference, you do. Then, decide on whether or not to drop the symbol you seem so eager to disrespect into this system's sun, I will," he says, gesturing to your head and the Heliarch circlet you bear. You carefully repeat the information, taking care to not come off as impolite again.|1044|0
units.english: "Do you now?" He begins. "And hope might I that get to explaining the difference, today still you shall? Require my attention, important work does, so if done being insubordinate, you are, suggest I do that enlighten us all on the difference, you do. Then, decide on whether or not to drop the symbol you seem so eager to disrespect into this system's sun, I will," he says, gesturing to your head and the Heliarch circlet you bear. You carefully repeat the information, taking care to not come off as impolite again.
units.italian: "Ah, davvero?" Comincia. "E sperare io spero che spiegare la differenza, oggi stesso tu lo farai? Richiedere la mia attenzione, un lavoro importante lo fa, quindi se hai finito di essere insubordinato, suggerire io suggerisco che illuminarci tutti sulla differenza, tu lo faccia. Poi, decidere se far cadere o no nel sole di questo sistema il simbolo che sembri tanto desideroso di mancare di rispetto, io lo farò," dice, indicando la tua testa e il cerchietto degli Heliarchs che porti. Ripeti con attenzione l'informazione, badando a non sembrare di nuovo irriguardoso.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	He leans forward lightly, staring at you. Looking around the table, the other Heliarchs are engaged in a what appears to be a quiet, heated discussion, gesticulating and occasionally tilting the table with their body weight amidst whispers.|1046|0
units.english: He leans forward lightly, staring at you. Looking around the table, the other Heliarchs are engaged in a what appears to be a quiet, heated discussion, gesticulating and occasionally tilting the table with their body weight amidst whispers.
units.italian: Si sporge leggermente in avanti, fissandoti. Guardandoti intorno al tavolo, gli altri Heliarchs sono presi da quella che sembra una discussione sussurrata e accesa, gesticolando e ogni tanto inclinando il tavolo con il peso del corpo tra i bisbigli.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"How?" Aulori asks, eyes still locked on you. You explain as best as you can about where Deneb is, and what you saw on the other side of the wormhole. When you get to explaining how the system was discovered, the Heliarchs seem to collectively gasp when you first utter the word "Pug." You pause, and many go back to the quiet, whispering discussions, some laughing it off, and others staying silent.|1047|0
units.english: "How?" Aulori asks, eyes still locked on you. You explain as best as you can about where Deneb is, and what you saw on the other side of the wormhole. When you get to explaining how the system was discovered, the Heliarchs seem to collectively gasp when you first utter the word "Pug." You pause, and many go back to the quiet, whispering discussions, some laughing it off, and others staying silent.
units.italian: "Come?" chiede Aulori, gli occhi ancora fissi su di te. Spieghi come meglio puoi dove si trova Deneb, e che cosa hai visto dall'altra parte del cunicolo spaziale. Quando arrivi a spiegare come è stato scoperto il sistema, gli Heliarchs sembrano sussultare all'unisono la prima volta che pronunci la parola "Pug". Ti fermi, e molti tornano alle discussioni sussurrate, alcuni ridendoci sopra e altri restando in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	One Saryd moves as if getting up, but sits back down once Aulori stands, firmly pushing one hand against the table. Conversation around the table dies out, as he stares you down for a long minute. "Leave us for a moment, would you?" he finally says, having some guards bring you outside the room.|1048|0
units.english: One Saryd moves as if getting up, but sits back down once Aulori stands, firmly pushing one hand against the table. Conversation around the table dies out, as he stares you down for a long minute. "Leave us for a moment, would you?" he finally says, having some guards bring you outside the room.
units.italian: Un Saryd si muove come per alzarsi, ma si risiede quando Aulori si alza in piedi, premendo con fermezza una mano sul tavolo. La conversazione intorno al tavolo muore, mentre lui ti fissa per un lungo minuto. "Lasciarci per un momento, vorreste?" dice infine, facendo portare voi fuori dalla stanza da alcune guardie.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	The whispering discussion from earlier now becomes a much louder debate, though the door muffles it all enough that no translator outside the room manages to pick up what is being said.
