After half an hour, most voices are cut as someone rapidly hits the table, roughly, yelling something in what you think is the Saryd language.|1049|0
units.english: The whispering discussion from earlier now becomes a much louder debate, though the door muffles it all enough that no translator outside the room manages to pick up what is being said. After half an hour, most voices are cut as someone rapidly hits the table, roughly, yelling something in what you think is the Saryd language.
units.italian: La discussione sussurrata di prima diventa ora un dibattito molto più rumoroso, anche se la porta lo attutisce abbastanza che nessun traduttore fuori dalla stanza riesca a captare cosa viene detto. Dopo mezz'ora, la maggior parte delle voci si interrompe quando qualcuno colpisce rapidamente il tavolo, con violenza, urlando qualcosa in quella che pensi sia la lingua Saryd.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	It all grows quiet for a while, and then the door opens again. Some of the other Heliarchs leave in a haste, and you're asked to head inside again. Consul Aulori is standing up still, giving you a nod as you come in.|1050|0
units.english: It all grows quiet for a while, and then the door opens again. Some of the other Heliarchs leave in a haste, and you're asked to head inside again. Consul Aulori is standing up still, giving you a nod as you come in.
units.italian: Tutto diventa silenzioso per un po', e poi la porta si apre di nuovo. Alcuni degli altri Heliarchs escono in fretta, e ti chiedono di rientrare. Il console Aulori è ancora in piedi e ti fa un cenno quando entri.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Adjusted, your ship's sensors will be. Better suited, they will become, for detailed tridimensional projections," he says. He has a pair of Heliarch guards bring you back to your ship, where some engineers go inside your ship and spend some time tinkering with it. After they're done, one of the Heliarchs that was in the room approaches you, telling you they need you to land on the planet you described, <stopovers>, and to travel to <waypoints> to scan the ringworld. He wishes you luck, then hurries back to the restricted areas.|1051|0
units.english: "Adjusted, your ship's sensors will be. Better suited, they will become, for detailed tridimensional projections," he says. He has a pair of Heliarch guards bring you back to your ship, where some engineers go inside your ship and spend some time tinkering with it. After they're done, one of the Heliarchs that was in the room approaches you, telling you they need you to land on the planet you described, <stopovers>, and to travel to <waypoints> to scan the ringworld. He wishes you luck, then hurries back to the restricted areas.
units.italian: "Modificati, i sensori della tua nave saranno. Più adatti, diventeranno, a proiezioni tridimensionali dettagliate," dice. Fa accompagnare te alla tua nave da un paio di guardie degli Heliarchs, dove alcuni ingegneri entrano e passano un po' di tempo ad armeggiare. Quando hanno finito, uno degli Heliarchs che era nella stanza ti si avvicina, dicendoti che hanno bisogno che tu atterri sul pianeta che hai descritto, <stopovers>, e che ti rechi a <waypoints> per scansionare il mondo ad anello. Ti augura buona fortuna e si affretta verso le aree riservate.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|dialog|1056|0
units.english: You fly around the mysterious world for a while, until your sensors beep in an odd way, in what you guess is the signal that the Heliarch's modifications are done doing their read on the planet.
units.italian: Vola intorno al mondo misterioso per un po', finché i tuoi sensori non emettono un segnale strano, che immagini sia il segnale che le modifiche degli Heliarchs hanno finito la loro lettura del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|dialog|1058|0
units.english: You fire up your ship's sensors, letting it collect the data the Heliarch want for hours on end. Eventually you hear a series of beeps in a dull rhythm, and look to see that their performance is back to normal.
units.italian: Accendi i sensori della nave e li lasci raccogliere per ore e ore i dati che gli Heliarchs vogliono. Alla fine senti una serie di bip in un ritmo cupo, e vedi che le loro prestazioni sono tornate normali.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|You're met by a dozen Heliarch guards when you land, and they quickly escort you to the ring's restricted sections after you transmit the scan logs. Aulori, as well as several other Heliarchs from the meeting you had last time, are waiting for you in a large room, where a holographic model of the broken ringworld starts being projected for all to see.|1066|0
units.english: You're met by a dozen Heliarch guards when you land, and they quickly escort you to the ring's restricted sections after you transmit the scan logs. Aulori, as well as several other Heliarchs from the meeting you had last time, are waiting for you in a large room, where a holographic model of the broken ringworld starts being projected for all to see.
units.italian: All'atterraggio ti accolgono una dozzina di guardie degli Heliarchs, che ti scortano rapidamente nelle sezioni riservate dell'anello dopo che hai trasmesso i registri della scansione. Aulori, insieme a diversi altri Heliarchs della riunione dell'altra volta, ti aspettano in una grande stanza, dove un modello olografico del mondo ad anello rotto comincia a essere proiettato per tutti.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Skeptical of what you told us, we all were, Captain," Aulori says, gesturing for you to accompany him as he walks around the projection. "Claimed that insane, you were, some of those here did." He looks down at a Kimek briefly. "Or that wasting our time with jokes, you were." A Saryd steps back as you two continue, making way for the consul. "Assured me, some of them had, that wholly impossible, it was, to break a ring." He stomps down his hooves close to an Arach and stops where the projection shows signs of greater damage. A large, cut off chunk of the ring is in full display, surrounded by clouds of floating debris. "But not insane, neither a joker, you are. And impossible, this clearly is not. Invaluable information, what you've brought us is, Captain <last>. Investigate the site thoroughly, we must, so ask for your assistance again, we will, when a suitable crew for it, we have found."|1067|0
units.english: "Skeptical of what you told us, we all were, Captain," Aulori says, gesturing for you to accompany him as he walks around the projection. "Claimed that insane, you were, some of those here did." He looks down at a Kimek briefly. "Or that wasting our time with jokes, you were." A Saryd steps back as you two continue, making way for the consul. "Assured me, some of them had, that wholly impossible, it was, to break a ring." He stomps down his hooves close to an Arach and stops where the projection shows signs of greater damage. A large, cut off chunk of the ring is in full display, surrounded by clouds of floating debris. "But not insane, neither a joker, you are. And impossible, this clearly is not. Invaluable information, what you've brought us is, Captain <last>. Investigate the site thoroughly, we must, so ask for your assistance again, we will, when a suitable crew for it, we have found."
units.italian: "Scettici su ciò che ci hai detto, tutti noi eravamo, Capitano," dice Aulori, facendoti cenno di accompagnarlo mentre gira intorno alla proiezione. "Sostenuto che fossi pazzo, alcuni di quelli qui lo hanno." Guarda brevemente un Kimek. "O che stessi facendoci perdere tempo con degli scherzi." Un Saryd fa un passo indietro mentre proseguite, lasciando passare il console. "Assicurato a me, alcuni di loro lo avevano, che del tutto impossibile, era, rompere un anello." Batte gli zoccoli vicino a un Arach e si ferma dove la proiezione mostra i danni maggiori. Un grande pezzo tagliato via dall'anello è ben visibile, circondato da nuvole di detriti fluttuanti. "Ma pazzo, né un burlone, tu non sei. E impossibile, questo chiaramente non lo è. Informazioni inestimabili, ciò che ci hai portato è, Capitano <last>. Indagare a fondo sul sito, noi dobbiamo, quindi chiederti di nuovo assistenza, noi lo faremo, quando un equipaggio adatto per l'impresa, avremo trovato."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	A Saryd rushes closer once Aulori says that, "Sir, against sending off anyone, the council is-".|1068|0
units.english: A Saryd rushes closer once Aulori says that, "Sir, against sending off anyone, the council is-".
units.italian: Un Saryd si precipita più vicino appena Aulori lo dice: "Signore, contro l'invio di qualcuno, il consiglio è...".

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Agree, the council will," Aulori cuts him off, still looking at the projection.|1069|0
units.english: "Agree, the council will," Aulori cuts him off, still looking at the projection.
units.italian: "D'accordo, il consiglio sarà," lo interrompe Aulori, sempre guardando la proiezione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	The Saryd thinks for a while, then continues, "Take years, it would, to find and train someone willing to become an inspector. A dangerous task it-"|1070|0
units.english: The Saryd thinks for a while, then continues, "Take years, it would, to find and train someone willing to become an inspector. A dangerous task it-"
units.italian: Il Saryd riflette un momento, poi continua: "Anni ci vorrebbero, per trovare e addestrare qualcuno disposto a diventare un ispettore. Un compito pericoloso è..."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"And wait around for years, we will not," Aulori interrupts him again. "On borrowed time, we already are. Either find someone willing, and find them fast, you should, or find another line of work, you will," he looks at the Saryd, then at the door.|1073|0
units.english: "And wait around for years, we will not," Aulori interrupts him again. "On borrowed time, we already are. Either find someone willing, and find them fast, you should, or find another line of work, you will," he looks at the Saryd, then at the door.
units.italian: "E aspettare anni, noi non lo faremo," lo interrompe di nuovo Aulori. "A tempo scaduto, noi siamo già. O trovare qualcuno disposto, e trovarlo in fretta, tu dovresti, oppure trovarti un altro mestiere, tu lo farai," guarda il Saryd, poi la porta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|label|1075|0
units.english: expeditions past
units.italian: expeditions past

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	"Dangerous?" Aulori scoffs, interrupting the Heliarch once again. "Plagued by the council's cowardice, your mind is. Make it back, Arbiter Sedlitaris did. Alive and well she is, and helped by this very human in her expedition, she was," he says as he nods your way. "Living proof she is that unfounded, the council's archaic paranoia is. Now, find someone willing quickly, you must, before learn of this and meddle with our work again, they do."|1076|0
units.english: "Dangerous?" Aulori scoffs, interrupting the Heliarch once again. "Plagued by the council's cowardice, your mind is. Make it back, Arbiter Sedlitaris did. Alive and well she is, and helped by this very human in her expedition, she was," he says as he nods your way. "Living proof she is that unfounded, the council's archaic paranoia is. Now, find someone willing quickly, you must, before learn of this and meddle with our work again, they do."
units.italian: "Pericoloso?" sbuffa Aulori, interrompendo ancora una volta l'Heliarch. "Infettata dalla codardia del consiglio, la tua mente è. Tornare, l'arbitro Sedlitaris lo ha fatto. Viva e vegeta lei è, e aiutata da questo stesso umano nella sua spedizione, lei lo è stata," dice facendoti un cenno. "Prova vivente lei è che infondata, l'arcana paranoia del consiglio è. Ora, trovare qualcuno disposto in fretta, voi dovete, prima che ne apprendano e si intromettano di nuovo nel nostro lavoro, essi lo facciano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 1|	The Heliarch leaves the room, and Aulori hands you a chip worth <payment>. He has you escorted out of the room and back to your ship, promising to have more work for you soon.|1078|0
units.english: The Heliarch leaves the room, and Aulori hands you a chip worth <payment>. He has you escorted out of the room and back to your ship, promising to have more work for you soon.
units.italian: L'Heliarch lascia la stanza, e Aulori ti consegna un chip del valore di <payment>. Ti fa scortare fuori dalla stanza e di nuovo alla nave, promettendo che avrà presto altro lavoro per te.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 2|name|1084|0
units.english: Contacted
units.italian: Contattato

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 2|description|1085|0
units.english: Head to <destination> where the Heliarchs will tell you about their future plans for investigating the broken Quarg ringworld.
units.italian: Recati a <destination>, dove gli Heliarchs ti parleranno dei loro piani futuri per indagare sul mondo ad anello dei Quarg rotto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 2|A Heliarch delegation contacts you as you land on <origin>. "Greetings, Captain. Sent by Consul Aulori, we were," one of them says. "Requested, your presence is, at the <destination>."|1094|0
units.english: A Heliarch delegation contacts you as you land on <origin>. "Greetings, Captain. Sent by Consul Aulori, we were," one of them says. "Requested, your presence is, at the <destination>."
units.italian: Una delegazione degli Heliarchs ti contatta mentre atterri su <origin>. "Salve, Capitano. Mandati dal console Aulori, noi siamo stati," dice uno di loro. "Richiesta, la tua presenza è, su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 2|	They tell you they weren't informed as to what the consul needs of you, but ask that you head to the <planet> when possible.|1095|0
units.english: They tell you they weren't informed as to what the consul needs of you, but ask that you head to the <planet> when possible.
units.italian: Ti dicono che non sono stati informati di che cosa il console ti voglia, ma ti chiedono di recarti su <planet> quando possibile.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|name|1106|0
units.english: Extraterritorial Venture
units.italian: Impresa extraterritoriale

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|description|1107|0
units.english: Escort a Heliarch ship to <destination> to pick up supplies, then guide them through human space and through the wormhole in Deneb so that they can further investigate the broken ringworld.
units.italian: Scorta una nave degli Heliarchs fino a <destination> per prendere provviste, poi guidala attraverso lo spazio umano e il cunicolo spaziale in Deneb così che possano indagare più a fondo sul mondo ad anello rotto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|When you arrive, you find the landing bays empty of ships save for one Heliarch Punisher close to your own ship. What must be hundreds of armed Heliarchs patrol the area. Consul Aulori meets you as you're coming down the ramp. "Carefully analyzing your findings, we have been, Captain. Much insight, they have brought us," he says. "Only so much can be gained from second hand observation, unfortunately. For that reason, escort one of our own ships there, you must."|1115|0
units.english: When you arrive, you find the landing bays empty of ships save for one Heliarch Punisher close to your own ship. What must be hundreds of armed Heliarchs patrol the area. Consul Aulori meets you as you're coming down the ramp. "Carefully analyzing your findings, we have been, Captain. Much insight, they have brought us," he says. "Only so much can be gained from second hand observation, unfortunately. For that reason, escort one of our own ships there, you must."
units.italian: Quando arrivi, trovi i bacini di atterraggio vuoti di navi, tranne un Punisher degli Heliarchs vicino alla tua. Quelli che devono essere centinaia di Heliarchs armati pattugliano l'area. Il console Aulori ti incontra mentre scendi dalla rampa. "Analizzare con cura i tuoi risultati, noi stiamo," dice. "Molte intuizioni, essi ci hanno portato. Solo fino a un certo punto si può guadagnare dall'osservazione indiretta, purtroppo. Per questo motivo, scortare una delle nostre navi laggiù, tu devi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	He points to the Punisher close to your ship, and you see its crew loading dozens of cargo containers into it. He tells you the ship will follow you to the broken ring, and set up a base on Ruin so that they may study the debris closely for a longer period.|1116|0
units.english: He points to the Punisher close to your ship, and you see its crew loading dozens of cargo containers into it. He tells you the ship will follow you to the broken ring, and set up a base on Ruin so that they may study the debris closely for a longer period.
units.italian: Indica il Punisher vicino alla tua nave, e vedi il suo equipaggio caricare dozzine di container. Ti dice che la nave ti seguirà fino all'anello rotto e stabilirà una base su Ruin, così che possano studiare i detriti da vicino per un periodo più lungo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"Of course. I'll show them the way."|1118|0
units.english: "Of course. I'll show them the way."
units.italian: "Certo. Mostrerò loro la strada."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"What do you expect to find there? Spare parts?"|1120|0
units.english: "What do you expect to find there? Spare parts?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vi aspettate di trovare laggiù? Pezzi di ricambio?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"Well, I think they're probably good to get there on their own. Sorry, but I'm not interested."|1122|0
units.english: "Well, I think they're probably good to get there on their own. Sorry, but I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Beh, credo che siano perfettamente in grado di arrivarci da soli. Mi dispiace, ma non sono interessato."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	He grimaces lightly. "Afraid I am, Captain, that an option, that is not. Very unfamiliar with navigating human space as is, we are, and in a truly exceptional location, this ring is. Remind you, I must, that bring us to our attention in the first place, you did, abandon this work now, you cannot. On behalf of our Coalition, insist I must that aid us in this effort, you do." Pausing for just a second, he continues in a lower tone. "Very... unwelcoming to you, the Coalition would become, if drop this now, you did. A few last scanners, the scientists have requested, so after quick stop at <destination>, to the ringworld, you will bring them."|1126|0
units.english: He grimaces lightly. "Afraid I am, Captain, that an option, that is not. Very unfamiliar with navigating human space as is, we are, and in a truly exceptional location, this ring is. Remind you, I must, that bring us to our attention in the first place, you did, abandon this work now, you cannot. On behalf of our Coalition, insist I must that aid us in this effort, you do." Pausing for just a second, he continues in a lower tone. "Very... unwelcoming to you, the Coalition would become, if drop this now, you did. A few last scanners, the scientists have requested, so after quick stop at <destination>, to the ringworld, you will bring them."
units.italian: Fa una leggera smorfia. "Temo, Capitano, che un'opzione, questa non sia. Molto poco familiari con la navigazione nello spazio umano, noi siamo, e in una posizione davvero eccezionale, questo anello è. Ricordarti, io devo, che portarci all'attenzione in primo luogo, tu lo hai fatto: abbandonare questo lavoro ora, tu non puoi. A nome della nostra Coalizione, insistere io devo che aiutarci in questo sforzo, tu lo farai." Facendo una pausa di un secondo, continua a voce più bassa. "Molto... poco accogliente con te, la Coalizione diventerebbe, se lasciassi perdere ora, tu lo facessi. Un ultimo gruppo di scanner, gli scienziati hanno richiesto, quindi dopo una breve sosta a <destination>, al mondo ad anello, tu li porterai."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"Asking for your cooperation, I was not. Orders, these are." He looks at you sternly. "Escort the ship there, you will, or find our Coalition much less hospitable to you, you shall. A few last scanners, the scientists have requested, so after a quick stop at <destination>, bring them you will to the broken ring."|1129|0
units.english: "Asking for your cooperation, I was not. Orders, these are." He looks at you sternly. "Escort the ship there, you will, or find our Coalition much less hospitable to you, you shall. A few last scanners, the scientists have requested, so after a quick stop at <destination>, bring them you will to the broken ring."
units.italian: "Chiederti la collaborazione, io non lo stavo facendo. Ordini, questi sono." Ti guarda severamente. "Scortare la nave laggiù, tu lo farai, o trovare la nostra Coalizione molto meno ospitale nei tuoi confronti, tu dovrai. Un ultimo gruppo di scanner, gli scienziati hanno richiesto, quindi dopo una breve sosta a <destination>, portarglieli tu lo farai, all'anello rotto."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"Too advanced, the composites that make up this and all other ringworlds are. Replicate them, we cannot. Not yet. If how this one was destroyed, we learn, maybe how to construct parts of our own, we could. If not, then perhaps find we may what means used to damage it were, and so ways of our own to damage the rings, we may find. Managed to do so before, we haven't."|1132|0
units.english: "Too advanced, the composites that make up this and all other ringworlds are. Replicate them, we cannot. Not yet. If how this one was destroyed, we learn, maybe how to construct parts of our own, we could. If not, then perhaps find we may what means used to damage it were, and so ways of our own to damage the rings, we may find. Managed to do so before, we haven't."
units.italian: "Troppo avanzati, i compositi che formano questo e tutti gli altri mondi ad anello sono. Replicarli, noi non possiamo. Non ancora. Se come questo sia stato distrutto, noi scopriamo, forse come costruire parti dei nostri, noi potremmo. Se no, allora magari scoprire potremmo quali mezzi siano stati usati per danneggiarlo, e così modi nostri per danneggiare gli anelli, noi potremmo trovare. Riusciti a farlo prima, noi non ci siamo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"Alright, I'll show them the way."|1134|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll show them the way."
units.italian: "Va bene, mostrerò loro la strada."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"Well, I'm no megastructure engineer, so I don't see the need to go there myself. They can find their own way."|1136|0
units.english: "Well, I'm no megastructure engineer, so I don't see the need to go there myself. They can find their own way."
units.italian: "Beh, non sono un ingegnere di megastrutture, quindi non vedo la necessità di andarci di persona. Possono trovare la strada da soli."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	"Excellent. Equipped with a jump drive, the ship is, and to reach this 'Ruin' planet, enough fuel, it has. A few last scanners, the scientists have requested, so after quick stop at <destination>, to the ringworld, you may bring them."|1139|0
units.english: "Excellent. Equipped with a jump drive, the ship is, and to reach this 'Ruin' planet, enough fuel, it has. A few last scanners, the scientists have requested, so after quick stop at <destination>, to the ringworld, you may bring them."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Dotata di un motore di salto, la nave è, e per raggiungere questo pianeta 'Ruin', carburante a sufficienza, ha. Un ultimo gruppo di scanner, gli scienziati hanno richiesto, quindi dopo una breve sosta a <destination>, al mondo ad anello, tu potrai portarglieli."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 3|	He introduces you to the Punisher's crew, and the dozens of scientists and engineers who are preparing to board the warship, ready to accompany you. He wishes you all good luck and leaves, escorted by a few dozen guards. Once the consul is out of sight, some among the Punisher's crew start fidgeting. Their Captain, an Arach, has them ready the ship to follow yours, and they prepare to depart.|1141|0
units.english: He introduces you to the Punisher's crew, and the dozens of scientists and engineers who are preparing to board the warship, ready to accompany you. He wishes you all good luck and leaves, escorted by a few dozen guards. Once the consul is out of sight, some among the Punisher's crew start fidgeting. Their Captain, an Arach, has them ready the ship to follow yours, and they prepare to depart.
units.italian: Ti presenta all'equipaggio del Punisher, e alle dozzine di scienziati e ingegneri che si preparano a salire sulla nave da guerra, pronti ad accompagnarti. Augura buona fortuna a tutti e se ne va, scortato da qualche dozzina di guardie. Appena il console è fuori vista, alcuni dell'equipaggio del Punisher cominciano a agitarsi. Il loro capitano, un Arach, fa preparare la nave a seguire la tua, e si preparano a partire.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|name|1161|0
units.english: Extraterritorial Venture
units.italian: Impresa extraterritoriale

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|description|1162|0
units.english: Escort a Heliarch ship through human space and into the wormhole in Deneb, so that they can further investigate the broken ringworld.
units.italian: Scorta una nave degli Heliarchs attraverso lo spazio umano e dentro il cunicolo spaziale in Deneb, così che possano indagare più a fondo sul mondo ad anello rotto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|The Punisher's captain has some equipment loaded onto the ship, and the mechanics do one last maintenance check on the ship before it leaves Coalition space. The captain tells you they will follow your lead when you launch. Every other minute, he looks nervously at the sky.|1170|0
units.english: The Punisher's captain has some equipment loaded onto the ship, and the mechanics do one last maintenance check on the ship before it leaves Coalition space. The captain tells you they will follow your lead when you launch. Every other minute, he looks nervously at the sky.
units.italian: Il capitano del Punisher fa caricare un po' di attrezzatura sulla nave, e i meccanici fanno un ultimo controllo di manutenzione prima che lasci lo spazio della Coalizione. Il capitano ti dice che seguiranno la tua guida quando partirai. Ogni due minuti guarda nervosamente il cielo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|dialog|1179|0
units.english: You've reached <planet> but left the Heliarch ship behind. Best depart and wait for them to arrive.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet> ma hai lasciato indietro la nave degli Heliarchs. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|The Punisher's captain had you follow his ship all over the planet after they refueled in <planet>'s odd facilities. Apparently they want an isolated place to set up their camp here, somewhere they wouldn't be easily spotted.|1191|0
units.english: The Punisher's captain had you follow his ship all over the planet after they refueled in <planet>'s odd facilities. Apparently they want an isolated place to set up their camp here, somewhere they wouldn't be easily spotted.
units.italian: Il capitano del Punisher ti ha fatto seguire la sua nave per tutto il pianeta dopo che si sono riforniti nelle strane strutture di <planet>. A quanto pare vogliono un posto isolato dove sistemare qui il loro campo, un luogo dove non possano essere facilmente individuati.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	They settle for a cavern on the way up a mountain, overlooking a foggy valley. A river is faintly visible through the dense fog. As they unload the cargo and start setting up, the captain comes to you. He is a young Arach, and his previous demeanor of taking worried glances at the sky has grown even more intense here, as he struggles to so much as look at you as he begins talking. "In the name of the crew, thank you I must for guiding us, Captain <last>." He finally settles on a compromise: one pair of eyes fixated on you, and the rest scouring the skies. "Stocked with enough supplies to last just under a year, the ship is, but if fruitful in our efforts to establish some manner of farm we are, remain for much longer, we will. The consul's orders, those are. When about to head back into the Coalition we are, send a message to you I will, notifying that our work here is finished."|1192|0
units.english: They settle for a cavern on the way up a mountain, overlooking a foggy valley. A river is faintly visible through the dense fog. As they unload the cargo and start setting up, the captain comes to you. He is a young Arach, and his previous demeanor of taking worried glances at the sky has grown even more intense here, as he struggles to so much as look at you as he begins talking. "In the name of the crew, thank you I must for guiding us, Captain <last>." He finally settles on a compromise: one pair of eyes fixated on you, and the rest scouring the skies. "Stocked with enough supplies to last just under a year, the ship is, but if fruitful in our efforts to establish some manner of farm we are, remain for much longer, we will. The consul's orders, those are. When about to head back into the Coalition we are, send a message to you I will, notifying that our work here is finished."
units.italian: Si accontentano di una caverna salendo su una montagna, affacciata su una valle nebbiosa. Un fiume è vagamente visibile attraverso la nebbia fitta. Mentre scaricano il carico e cominciano a sistemarsi, il capitano viene da te. È un Arach giovane, e il suo atteggiamento di prima, con le occhiate preoccupate al cielo, è diventato qui ancora più intenso: fatica persino a guardarti mentre comincia a parlare. "A nome dell'equipaggio, ringraziarti io devo per averci guidato, Capitano <last>." Alla fine trova un compromesso: un paio di occhi fissi su di te, e il resto a scrutare i cieli. "Rifornita con provviste sufficienti per poco meno di un anno, la nave è, ma se fruttuosi nei nostri sforzi di stabilire una qualche forma di coltivazione noi saremo, restare molto più a lungo, noi lo faremo. Ordini del console, questi sono. Quando sul punto di tornare nella Coalizione noi saremo, mandarti un messaggio io lo farò, avvisando che il nostro lavoro qui è finito."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"Understood. Until then, good luck on your research here."|1194|0
units.english: "Understood. Until then, good luck on your research here."
units.italian: "Ho capito. Fino ad allora, buona fortuna con la vostra ricerca qui."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"Is something wrong?"|1196|0
units.english: "Is something wrong?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che non va?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	He goes back to looking to the sky with all eyes. "Forbidden it is, to leave the Coalition. To both civilians and Heliarchs alike. Far too dangerous, the outside has proven, and not deemed worthy to risk our jump drives like this, it has been. Worried I am about the ship's - the crew's - safety."|1197|0
units.english: He goes back to looking to the sky with all eyes. "Forbidden it is, to leave the Coalition. To both civilians and Heliarchs alike. Far too dangerous, the outside has proven, and not deemed worthy to risk our jump drives like this, it has been. Worried I am about the ship's - the crew's - safety."
units.italian: Torna a guardare il cielo con tutti gli occhi. "Proibito è, lasciare la Coalizione. Sia per i civili sia per gli Heliarchs. Troppo pericoloso, l'esterno si è dimostrato, e non ritenuto degno di rischiare i nostri motori di salto così, è stato. Preoccupato io sono per la sicurezza della nave, dell'equipaggio."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"Why is that forbidden?"|1201|0
units.english: "Why is that forbidden?"
units.italian: "Perché è proibito?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"Don't worry, I'm sure you'll be alright. Good luck on your research."|1202|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'm sure you'll be alright. Good luck on your research."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, sono sicuro che starete bene. Buona fortuna con la ricerca."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"Fared poorly, previous Heliarch expeditions to the outside have, besides the very first." He breaks watch of the sky and focuses entirely on you. "Understand I do the importance of this mission, and that counting on us the consul is. Only... sometimes, wonder I do if worth risking us all, the mission is."|1204|0
units.english: "Fared poorly, previous Heliarch expeditions to the outside have, besides the very first." He breaks watch of the sky and focuses entirely on you. "Understand I do the importance of this mission, and that counting on us the consul is. Only... sometimes, wonder I do if worth risking us all, the mission is."
units.italian: "Andate male, le precedenti spedizioni degli Heliarchs all'esterno, tranne la prima in assoluto." Interrompe la sorveglianza del cielo e si concentra interamente su di te. "Capire io capisco l'importanza di questa missione, e che contare su di noi il console sta. Solo... a volte, chiedermi io mi chiedo se valga la pena rischiare tutti noi, la missione valga."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|label|1206|0
units.english: expeditions past
units.italian: expeditions past

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"It's still forbidden? But Sedlitaris returned just fine, I flew her through human space and back with no issues."|1208|0
units.english: "It's still forbidden? But Sedlitaris returned just fine, I flew her through human space and back with no issues."
units.italian: "È ancora proibito? Ma Sedlitaris è tornata senza problemi: l'ho portata io attraverso lo spazio umano e ritorno, senza intoppi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"Don't worry, I'm sure you'll be alright. Good luck on your research."|1209|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'm sure you'll be alright. Good luck on your research."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, sono sicuro che starete bene. Buona fortuna con la ricerca."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	"True that is, but repealed, the measure that prohibits everyone leaving was not. Speak with Arbiter Sedlitaris myself I did, and admit I must that much more at ease now I am. But, still, remain vigilant for the crew's sake, I must. Changed their opinions like me, not many of them have."|1211|0
units.english: "True that is, but repealed, the measure that prohibits everyone leaving was not. Speak with Arbiter Sedlitaris myself I did, and admit I must that much more at ease now I am. But, still, remain vigilant for the crew's sake, I must. Changed their opinions like me, not many of them have."
units.italian: "Vero questo è, ma abrogata, la misura che proibisce a tutti di uscire non è stata. Parlare con l'arbitro Sedlitaris io stesso l'ho fatto, e ammettere io devo che molto più tranquillo ora io sono. Ma, comunque, restare vigile per il bene dell'equipaggio, io devo. Cambiato idea come me, non molti di loro lo hanno."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 4|	He thanks you again for your help, and with a salute bids you farewell, heading to help the Punisher's crew establish their base of operations inside the caverns. You get back in your ship and fly back to the empty docks of <planet>. Now it's a matter of waiting for the Heliarch teams here to do their job and return to the Coalition.|1213|0
units.english: He thanks you again for your help, and with a salute bids you farewell, heading to help the Punisher's crew establish their base of operations inside the caverns. You get back in your ship and fly back to the empty docks of <planet>. Now it's a matter of waiting for the Heliarch teams here to do their job and return to the Coalition.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia di nuovo per l'aiuto e, con un saluto, si congeda, dirigendosi ad aiutare l'equipaggio del Punisher a stabilire la loro base operativa dentro le caverne. Torni nella tua nave e voli ai moli vuoti di <planet>. Ora resta solo da aspettare che le squadre degli Heliarchs qui facciano il loro lavoro e tornino nella Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|name|1219|0
units.english: Meet With Aulori
units.italian: Incontro con Aulori

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|description|1220|0
units.english: Head to <destination>, where Consul Aulori wishes to speak with you about the Heliarch's findings on the destroyed ringworld.
units.italian: Recati a <destination>, dove il console Aulori desidera parlarti dei risultati degli Heliarchs sul mondo ad anello distrutto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|When you've touched down on the landing pads, you see you've received a message from the Heliarchs you brought to Ruin, the mysterious world on the other side of the wormhole the Pug left in Deneb. "Captain <last>, finished what research we could do on the broken ring, we have. About to jump back into the Coalition, we are. Imagine I do that like to speak with you after receiving our report, Consul Aulori will, so head you should to the <planet> as soon as possible."|1229|0
units.english: When you've touched down on the landing pads, you see you've received a message from the Heliarchs you brought to Ruin, the mysterious world on the other side of the wormhole the Pug left in Deneb. "Captain <last>, finished what research we could do on the broken ring, we have. About to jump back into the Coalition, we are. Imagine I do that like to speak with you after receiving our report, Consul Aulori will, so head you should to the <planet> as soon as possible."
units.italian: Quando ti sei posato sulle piazzole di atterraggio, vedi che hai ricevuto un messaggio dagli Heliarchs che hai portato su Ruin, il mondo misterioso dall'altra parte del cunicolo spaziale che i Pug hanno lasciato in Deneb. "Capitano <last>, finito ciò che di ricerca potevamo fare sull'anello rotto, noi abbiamo. Sul punto di saltare di nuovo nella Coalizione, noi siamo. Immaginare io immagino che desideri parlarti dopo aver ricevuto il nostro rapporto, il console Aulori lo farà, quindi recarti tu dovresti su <planet> il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|To your surprise, your arrival to the <planet> sees no reception party waiting for you, or so much as a payment message from Aulori. You leave your ship, and mention to the nearest Heliarch that you were asked to see Consul Aulori here. They brush you off, saying there has been no such request by the consul. You try and explain that the Heliarch leading the expedition to Ruin mentioned you should come, but they again dismiss you, seemingly unaware of what you're talking about and going on about their business.|1240|0
units.english: To your surprise, your arrival to the <planet> sees no reception party waiting for you, or so much as a payment message from Aulori. You leave your ship, and mention to the nearest Heliarch that you were asked to see Consul Aulori here. They brush you off, saying there has been no such request by the consul. You try and explain that the Heliarch leading the expedition to Ruin mentioned you should come, but they again dismiss you, seemingly unaware of what you're talking about and going on about their business.
units.italian: Con tua sorpresa, al tuo arrivo su <planet> non c'è nessuna delegazione ad accoglierti, né tanto meno un messaggio di pagamento da Aulori. Lasci la nave e fai presente all'Heliarch più vicino che ti è stato chiesto di vedere il console Aulori qui. Ti liquidano, dicendo che non c'è stata alcuna richiesta del genere da parte del console. Provi a spiegare che l'Heliarch a capo della spedizione su Ruin ha detto che saresti dovuto venire, ma ti congedano di nuovo, apparentemente senza capire di che cosa parli, e tornano ai loro affari.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	You try a few more times to no avail, and decide to head back to your ship for the time being. It's not until the day is about to turn that a pair of Heliarch guards come to your ship, asking that you step outside. You comply, and they tell you to follow, "for ready to see you, the consul is."|1241|0
units.english: You try a few more times to no avail, and decide to head back to your ship for the time being. It's not until the day is about to turn that a pair of Heliarch guards come to your ship, asking that you step outside. You comply, and they tell you to follow, "for ready to see you, the consul is."
units.italian: Provi altre volte senza successo, e decidi di tornare alla nave per il momento. Solo quando la giornata sta per finire un paio di guardie degli Heliarchs vengono alla tua nave a chiederti di uscire. Obbedisci, e ti dicono di seguirli, "che pronto a vederti, il console è".

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	Once again you're led through the inscrutable, guard-crowded halls of the <planet>, being brought to a long corridor with dozens of closed doors. The one at the very end is apparently your goal. From there, however, two more guards arrive, and they explain to those escorting you that "received word, the Ring of Friendship has." They apologize to you, saying Aulori might be busy for some time more. You are brought to just outside the room, so that you're received as soon as his "meeting" ends.|1242|0
units.english: Once again you're led through the inscrutable, guard-crowded halls of the <planet>, being brought to a long corridor with dozens of closed doors. The one at the very end is apparently your goal. From there, however, two more guards arrive, and they explain to those escorting you that "received word, the Ring of Friendship has." They apologize to you, saying Aulori might be busy for some time more. You are brought to just outside the room, so that you're received as soon as his "meeting" ends.
units.italian: Ancora una volta vieni condotto attraverso gli imperscrutabili corridoi di <planet> affollati di guardie, fino a un lungo corridoio con dozzine di porte chiuse. Quella in fondo è apparentemente la tua meta. Da lì, però, arrivano altre due guardie, che spiegano a quelle che ti scortano che "ricevuto parola, l'Anello dell'Amicizia ha". Si scusano con te, dicendo che Aulori potrebbe essere occupato ancora per un po'. Ti portano appena fuori dalla stanza, così che tu sia ricevuto appena la sua "riunione" finisce.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	From another room, a Heliarch arbiter waves for the guards waiting with you, and passes some other task to them. Three of them leave, and you're left with the one who fetched you from your ship, a Saryd. Despite the door to Aulori's room being locked, you two can still clearly hear intense shouting from within - not just his, but from many others who you assume to be consuls as well. After a particularly long - and heated - debate segment from what seems to be Aulori's voice, the Heliarch guard waiting with you declares they'll be coming back soon and hastily moves away, turning the corner.|1243|0
units.english: From another room, a Heliarch arbiter waves for the guards waiting with you, and passes some other task to them. Three of them leave, and you're left with the one who fetched you from your ship, a Saryd. Despite the door to Aulori's room being locked, you two can still clearly hear intense shouting from within - not just his, but from many others who you assume to be consuls as well. After a particularly long - and heated - debate segment from what seems to be Aulori's voice, the Heliarch guard waiting with you declares they'll be coming back soon and hastily moves away, turning the corner.
units.italian: Da un'altra stanza, un arbitro degli Heliarchs fa cenno alle guardie che aspettano con te e affida loro qualche altro compito. Tre di loro se ne vanno, e tu resti con quella che ti ha prelevato dalla nave, una Saryd. Nonostante la porta della stanza di Aulori sia chiusa a chiave, riuscite a sentire chiaramente delle urla intense da dentro: non solo le sue, ma di molti altri che immagini essere consoli. Dopo un segmento di dibattito particolarmente lungo e acceso, che sembra essere la voce di Aulori, la guardia degli Heliarchs che aspetta con te dichiara che torneranno presto, e si allontana in fretta svoltando l'angolo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	A few more minutes pass, and you hear some more of the heated discussion from within. After a while, it stops, and the door opens with Aulori on the other side, alone. "Arrived you have, I see, Captain. Forgive me for the wait, you must. Just going over the findings of the expedition, some more consuls and I were."|1247|0
units.english: A few more minutes pass, and you hear some more of the heated discussion from within. After a while, it stops, and the door opens with Aulori on the other side, alone. "Arrived you have, I see, Captain. Forgive me for the wait, you must. Just going over the findings of the expedition, some more consuls and I were."
units.italian: Passano altri minuti, e senti ancora la discussione accesa da dentro. Dopo un po' si ferma, e la porta si apre con Aulori dall'altra parte, da solo. "Arrivato tu sei, vedo, Capitano. Perdonarmi l'attesa, tu devi. Solo passare in rassegna i risultati della spedizione, io e altri consoli stavamo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"It's alright, I didn't mind the wait."|1249|0
units.english: "It's alright, I didn't mind the wait."
units.italian: "Va bene, l'attesa non mi ha dato fastidio."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"I was just about to head back to my ship. It seemed your meeting was never going to end."|1250|0
units.english: "I was just about to head back to my ship. It seemed your meeting was never going to end."
units.italian: "Stavo proprio per tornare alla mia nave. Sembrava che la vostra riunione non dovesse finire mai."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	He beckons you to the middle of the room, still lit up only by the many monitors used for the video calls with other consuls. He moves to a small desk near the wall with the monitors, and picks up <payment> in chips, handing them to you. "Find what they could with what time they had, the expedition did. Only so much time to experiment there was, when a single ship - a warship - the fleet had. Mistake me not, greatly pleased with the preliminary results, I so far have been, but frustrating it is that limited we are by such time and resource constraints." He sighs. "Like I would, for there to be a larger, more substantial expedition to that ring. But stand as it does, seem it does that wait I must for the council's approval, before taking any further action."|1252|0
units.english: He beckons you to the middle of the room, still lit up only by the many monitors used for the video calls with other consuls. He moves to a small desk near the wall with the monitors, and picks up <payment> in chips, handing them to you. "Find what they could with what time they had, the expedition did. Only so much time to experiment there was, when a single ship - a warship - the fleet had. Mistake me not, greatly pleased with the preliminary results, I so far have been, but frustrating it is that limited we are by such time and resource constraints." He sighs. "Like I would, for there to be a larger, more substantial expedition to that ring. But stand as it does, seem it does that wait I must for the council's approval, before taking any further action."
units.italian: Ti fa cenno di avvicinarti al centro della stanza, ancora illuminata solo dai molti monitor usati per le videochiamate con gli altri consoli. Si avvicina a una piccola scrivania vicino alla parete con i monitor, prende <payment> in chip e te li consegna. "Trovare ciò che potevano con il tempo che avevano, la spedizione lo ha fatto. Solo un certo tempo per sperimentare c'era, dato che una sola nave, una nave da guerra, aveva la flotta. Non fraintendermi: molto soddisfatto dei risultati preliminari, finora io sono stato, ma frustrante è che limitati siamo da tali vincoli di tempo e risorse." Sospira. "Come vorrei, che ci fosse una spedizione più grande e più sostanziosa a quell'anello. Ma così come stanno le cose, sembra che aspettare l'approvazione del consiglio io debba, prima di prendere qualsiasi altra iniziativa."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	He moves to pick up a small box on the other side of the room, sitting atop a table surrounded by boards with scribbled notes and mock-up schematics. He brings the box to you and opens it, revealing inside a very small piece of something clearly metallic in nature, but with some odd, unknown property to it you can't identify. "One billion."|1253|0
units.english: He moves to pick up a small box on the other side of the room, sitting atop a table surrounded by boards with scribbled notes and mock-up schematics. He brings the box to you and opens it, revealing inside a very small piece of something clearly metallic in nature, but with some odd, unknown property to it you can't identify. "One billion."
units.italian: Si sposta per prendere una piccola scatola dall'altra parte della stanza, appoggiata su un tavolo circondato da lavagne con appunti scarabocchiati e schemi di progetto. Ti porta la scatola e la apre, rivelando all'interno un pezzetto molto piccolo di qualcosa chiaramente metallico, ma con una strana proprietà sconosciuta che non riesci a identificare. "Un miliardo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"What?"|1255|0
units.english: "What?"
units.italian: "Come?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"Is this that expensive?"|1256|0
units.english: "Is this that expensive?"
units.italian: "Vuoi dire che costa così tanto?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"Over the course of the War of Independence, the amount of kilotons of fissile material used in projectiles that bombarded this ring. One billion. For this ring alone. Not a single dent, they left. Not one." He picks up the piece. "One of the smaller shards of the shattered ring that recover, the expedition could." He gazes at it for a few seconds, before putting it back in the box and returning it to the table. "In my position, to learn of the Quarg, learn as a Quarg, I have had to. Think like them, I must, if to attempt to breach the many blockades they have placed to impede others from learning from their technology, I am. Outnumbered by them, we are. Inferior we remain in our technology. If a means to close the gap, I do not find, then perhaps learning what monstrous weapon could break their rings, learning how to create such a weapon, the only hope for deterring a Quarg offensive is."|1257|0
units.english: "Over the course of the War of Independence, the amount of kilotons of fissile material used in projectiles that bombarded this ring. One billion. For this ring alone. Not a single dent, they left. Not one." He picks up the piece. "One of the smaller shards of the shattered ring that recover, the expedition could." He gazes at it for a few seconds, before putting it back in the box and returning it to the table. "In my position, to learn of the Quarg, learn as a Quarg, I have had to. Think like them, I must, if to attempt to breach the many blockades they have placed to impede others from learning from their technology, I am. Outnumbered by them, we are. Inferior we remain in our technology. If a means to close the gap, I do not find, then perhaps learning what monstrous weapon could break their rings, learning how to create such a weapon, the only hope for deterring a Quarg offensive is."
units.italian: "Nel corso della Guerra d'Indipendenza, la quantità di kilotoni di materiale fissile usata nei proiettili che hanno bombardato questo anello. Un miliardo. Per questo anello soltanto. Non una sola ammaccatura, hanno lasciato. Nemmeno una." Prende il pezzo. "Uno dei frammenti più piccoli dell'anello in frantumi che recuperare, la spedizione è riuscita." Lo guarda per qualche secondo, poi lo rimette nella scatola e la riporta sul tavolo. "Nella mia posizione, conoscere i Quarg, conoscerli come un Quarg, io ho dovuto. Pensare come loro, io devo, se tentare di superare i molti blocchi che hanno posto per impedire agli altri di imparare dalla loro tecnologia, io voglio. Superati in numero da loro, noi siamo. Inferiori restiamo nella nostra tecnologia. Se un mezzo per colmare il divario, io non lo trovo, allora forse scoprire quale mostruosa arma potrebbe spezzare i loro anelli, imparare a creare una tale arma, l'unica speranza per dissuadere un'offensiva dei Quarg è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	Aulori pauses for nearly a minute, looking at the monitors. "It matters not what nonsense other consuls may tell you, Captain. Know this: give up on their rings the Quarg never will. With your help, and the efforts of the expedition, prepared yet for them, we may become."|1258|0
units.english: Aulori pauses for nearly a minute, looking at the monitors. "It matters not what nonsense other consuls may tell you, Captain. Know this: give up on their rings the Quarg never will. With your help, and the efforts of the expedition, prepared yet for them, we may become."
units.italian: Aulori tace per quasi un minuto, guardando i monitor. "Non importa quali sciocchezze altri consoli possano raccontarti, Capitano. Sappi questo: rinunciare ai loro anelli, i Quarg non lo faranno mai. Con il tuo aiuto, e gli sforzi della spedizione, pronti per loro, noi potremmo diventare."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	He thanks you again, and gestures for the door. Many guards arrive soon after you two leave, and you're accompanied back to your ship. As you leave, Aulori heads deeper into the ring's hallways to further study the report about the destroyed ringworld.|1259|0
units.english: He thanks you again, and gestures for the door. Many guards arrive soon after you two leave, and you're accompanied back to your ship. As you leave, Aulori heads deeper into the ring's hallways to further study the report about the destroyed ringworld.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia di nuovo e ti fa cenno verso la porta. Molte guardie arrivano subito dopo che uscite, e vieni accompagnato di nuovo alla nave. Mentre te ne vai, Aulori si addentra nei corridoi dell'anello per studiare più a fondo il rapporto sul mondo ad anello distrutto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	The discussion inside continues, with no sign of dying down. Judging from the relatively quick journey from your ship to here, you figure you're not very deep into the ring's restricted sections, so your circlet's neural interface might have permission to open the door.|1262|0
units.english: The discussion inside continues, with no sign of dying down. Judging from the relatively quick journey from your ship to here, you figure you're not very deep into the ring's restricted sections, so your circlet's neural interface might have permission to open the door.
units.italian: La discussione dentro continua, senza segno di attenuarsi. A giudicare dal viaggio relativamente breve dalla tua nave a qui, immagini di non essere molto in profondità nelle sezioni riservate dell'anello, quindi l'interfaccia neurale del tuo cerchietto potrebbe avere il permesso di aprire la porta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	(Try to open it.)|1264|0
units.english: (Try to open it.)
units.italian: (Prova ad aprirla.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	(Just wait outside.)|1265|0
units.english: (Just wait outside.)
units.italian: (Aspetta fuori e basta.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	As you thought, the door responds to your command. The room is dark, with many lab instruments, computers, and countless boards with notes all over them being lit up solely by the various monitors on one end of the room. Aulori is there, alone, speaking with several other consuls via video call.|1267|0
units.english: As you thought, the door responds to your command. The room is dark, with many lab instruments, computers, and countless boards with notes all over them being lit up solely by the various monitors on one end of the room. Aulori is there, alone, speaking with several other consuls via video call.
units.italian: Come pensavi, la porta risponde al tuo comando. La stanza è buia, con molti strumenti di laboratorio, computer e innumerevoli lavagne piene di appunti illuminati soltanto dai vari monitor a un'estremità della stanza. Aulori è lì, da solo, che parla con diversi altri consoli in videochiamata.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	A Kimek consul occupies the most prominent monitor, and seems to be leading the discussion at the moment. "Exempt you are not from our laws and protocol. Your transgression aside, call I must for the others involved to be deposed at once. The Punisher's captain, and crew as well."|1270|0
units.english: A Kimek consul occupies the most prominent monitor, and seems to be leading the discussion at the moment. "Exempt you are not from our laws and protocol. Your transgression aside, call I must for the others involved to be deposed at once. The Punisher's captain, and crew as well."
units.italian: Un console Kimek occupa il monitor più importante, e sembra guidare la discussione in questo momento. "Esonerato tu non sei dalle nostre leggi e dal nostro protocollo. A parte la tua trasgressione, chiedere io devo che gli altri coinvolti siano destituiti immediatamente. Il capitano del Punisher, e anche l'equipaggio."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|label|1272|0
units.english: knows iekie
units.italian: knows iekie

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	On the most prominent monitor, you recognize Consul Iekie, the Kimek Heliarch who you aided in investigating various Coalition worlds for suspicious activity. She seems to be leading the discussion at the moment. "Exempt you are not from our laws and protocol. Your transgression aside, call I must for the others involved to be deposed at once. The Punisher's captain, and crew as well."|1273|0
units.english: On the most prominent monitor, you recognize Consul Iekie, the Kimek Heliarch who you aided in investigating various Coalition worlds for suspicious activity. She seems to be leading the discussion at the moment. "Exempt you are not from our laws and protocol. Your transgression aside, call I must for the others involved to be deposed at once. The Punisher's captain, and crew as well."
units.italian: Sul monitor più importante riconosci il console Iekie, la Kimek degli Heliarchs che hai aiutato a indagare su vari mondi della Coalizione per attività sospette. Sembra guidare la discussione in questo momento. "Esonerato tu non sei dalle nostre leggi e dal nostro protocollo. A parte la tua trasgressione, chiedere io devo che gli altri coinvolti siano destituiti immediatamente. Il capitano del Punisher, e anche l'equipaggio."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"Come to pass that will not. Given they were those orders by me. Serving the will of a superior, they were," Aulori replies. "Surely encourage the lower ranks to disobey, you would not."|1275|0
units.english: "Come to pass that will not. Given they were those orders by me. Serving the will of a superior, they were," Aulori replies. "Surely encourage the lower ranks to disobey, you would not."
units.italian: "Non accadrà questo. Dato che quegli ordini li ho dati io. Servire la volontà di un superiore, essi stavano," risponde Aulori. "Di certo incoraggiare i ranghi inferiori a disobbedire, tu non lo faresti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"So claim you do full responsibility over this clear transgression?"|1276|0
units.english: "So claim you do full responsibility over this clear transgression?"
units.italian: "Quindi rivendicare tu rivendichi la piena responsabilità di questa chiara trasgressione?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"Claim I do that acting on my behalf and on my orders, my subordinates were. Committed, no transgressions were. Now, if to talk about taking responsibility for the actions of those working under us, we are-"|1277|0
units.english: "Claim I do that acting on my behalf and on my orders, my subordinates were. Committed, no transgressions were. Now, if to talk about taking responsibility for the actions of those working under us, we are-"
units.italian: "Rivendicare io rivendico che agire per mio conto e sui miei ordini, i miei subordinati stavano. Commesse, nessuna trasgressione è stata. Ora, se parlare di assumersi la responsabilità delle azioni di chi lavora sotto di noi, noi vogliamo..."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"Weasel out of the matter at hand you will not," she interrupts him. "Aware you of course were that forbidden, further expeditions to the outside are, and to not have alerted the council of it, broken law twice-fold, you have."|1278|0
units.english: "Weasel out of the matter at hand you will not," she interrupts him. "Aware you of course were that forbidden, further expeditions to the outside are, and to not have alerted the council of it, broken law twice-fold, you have."
units.italian: "Svicolare dalla questione in esame tu non lo farai," lo interrompe lei. "Consapevole tu naturalmente eri che proibite, ulteriori spedizioni all'esterno sono, e non aver avvisato il consiglio, infranto la legge due volte, tu l'hai."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	The other consuls lash out some more at Aulori after she's done, and he waits for them to finish. "Made chief researcher I was on Quarg artifacts and ringworlds, centuries ago. Continued to study and deepen our knowledge on the subject, I since then have, and acted against the interest of uncovering the secrets of the Quarg, I not once have. Saved us centuries - if not millennia - of research, this expedition has. Now, look deeper into the findings myself, I must. To further our fight, and so that a fighting chance we may have. Believe, I do, that likewise, much more productive activities you all have, where concerned the well-being and stability of our Coalition is?"|1279|0
units.english: The other consuls lash out some more at Aulori after she's done, and he waits for them to finish. "Made chief researcher I was on Quarg artifacts and ringworlds, centuries ago. Continued to study and deepen our knowledge on the subject, I since then have, and acted against the interest of uncovering the secrets of the Quarg, I not once have. Saved us centuries - if not millennia - of research, this expedition has. Now, look deeper into the findings myself, I must. To further our fight, and so that a fighting chance we may have. Believe, I do, that likewise, much more productive activities you all have, where concerned the well-being and stability of our Coalition is?"
units.italian: Gli altri consoli si accaniscono ancora un po' contro Aulori dopo che lei ha finito, e lui aspetta che terminino. "Nominato capo ricercatore su manufatti dei Quarg e mondi ad anello io fui, secoli fa. Continuato a studiare e ad approfondire la nostra conoscenza sull'argomento, da allora io ho, e agito contro l'interesse di scoprire i segreti dei Quarg, io non una volta l'ho fatto. Risparmiato secoli, se non millenni, di ricerca, questa spedizione lo ha. Ora, esaminare più a fondo i risultati io stesso, io devo. Per portare avanti la nostra lotta, e così che una possibilità di combattere noi possiamo avere. Credere, io credo, che allo stesso modo, attività molto più produttive voi tutti abbiate, per quanto riguarda il benessere e la stabilità della nostra Coalizione?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	The others deliberate for a few minutes, before settling on an end to the discussion. "Once done analyzing the findings you are, report them at once you must, before the full council on the Ring of Friendship. Decide then, we shall, whether overlooked, these transgressions will be." Aulori agrees, and the call ends.|1280|0
units.english: The others deliberate for a few minutes, before settling on an end to the discussion. "Once done analyzing the findings you are, report them at once you must, before the full council on the Ring of Friendship. Decide then, we shall, whether overlooked, these transgressions will be." Aulori agrees, and the call ends.
units.italian: Gli altri deliberano per qualche minuto, prima di stabilire la fine della discussione. "Una volta finito di analizzare i risultati, riferirli subito tu devi, davanti al consiglio completo sull'Anello dell'Amicizia. Decidere allora, noi lo faremo, se ignorate, queste trasgressioni saranno." Aulori acconsente, e la chiamata finisce.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	He turns to leave, and you see the quick surprise on his face as he spots you, clearly too immersed in the discussion before to have noticed you watching. "Well, clear it is that arrived you have. Curious, were we, <last>?"|1281|0
units.english: He turns to leave, and you see the quick surprise on his face as he spots you, clearly too immersed in the discussion before to have noticed you watching. "Well, clear it is that arrived you have. Curious, were we, <last>?"
units.italian: Si volta per uscire, e vedi la sorpresa rapida sul suo viso quando ti nota, chiaramente troppo immerso nella discussione precedente per essersi accorto che stavi guardando. "Beh, chiaro è che arrivato tu sia. Curiosi, eravamo, <last>?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"I was only here for the end."|1283|0
units.english: "I was only here for the end."
units.italian: "Ero qui solo per la fine."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	"They didn't seem too happy with you."|1284|0
units.english: "They didn't seem too happy with you."
units.italian: "Non sembravano molto contenti di te."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Expedition 5|	He grunts. "Cowards, the lot of them. True, it is, that something of a gamble I took, risking one of our jump drives beyond an unknown wormhole. But, necessary it was. Necessary for our understanding. For our survival."|1285|0
units.english: He grunts. "Cowards, the lot of them. True, it is, that something of a gamble I took, risking one of our jump drives beyond an unknown wormhole. But, necessary it was. Necessary for our understanding. For our survival."
units.italian: Emette un grugnito. "Codardi, tutti quanti. Vero è, che una specie di azzardo l'ho fatto, rischiando uno dei nostri motori di salto oltre un cunicolo spaziale sconosciuto. Ma necessario era. Necessario per la nostra comprensione. Per la nostra sopravvivenza."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|name|1292|0
units.english: Transport Heliarch Soldiers
units.italian: Trasportare soldati degli Heliarchs

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|description|1293|0
units.english: Bring these <bunks> Heliarch soldiers, along with <cargo>, to <destination> by <date> so they can combat a terrorist group.
units.italian: Porta questi <bunks> soldati degli Heliarchs, insieme a <cargo>, a <destination> entro <date> così che possano combattere un gruppo terroristico.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|The spaceport on <origin> is in quite a lot of turmoil, as dozens of Heliarch agents march around at an accelerated pace. Some prepare to board their own ships, and others speak with some of the captains here. It's no different with you, as a Kimek agent approaches you after noticing you watching.|1308|0
units.english: The spaceport on <origin> is in quite a lot of turmoil, as dozens of Heliarch agents march around at an accelerated pace. Some prepare to board their own ships, and others speak with some of the captains here. It's no different with you, as a Kimek agent approaches you after noticing you watching.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto su <origin> è nel bel mezzo del caos, con dozzine di agenti degli Heliarchs che marciano avanti e indietro a passo accelerato. Alcuni si preparano a salire sulle loro navi, altri parlano con alcuni capitani presenti. Non è diverso con te, dato che un agente Kimek ti si avvicina dopo aver notato che stavi guardando.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"Much assistance, we require, Captain," they say. "A transport for <destination>, we need. For <bunks> of us, and <cargo>. Of great urgency, this task is."|1309|0
units.english: "Much assistance, we require, Captain," they say. "A transport for <destination>, we need. For <bunks> of us, and <cargo>. Of great urgency, this task is."
units.italian: "Molto aiuto, noi richiediamo, Capitano," dicono. "Un trasporto per <destination>, ci serve. Per <bunks> di noi, e <cargo>. Di grande urgenza, questo compito è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	Without you even noticing it, an Arach agent has also gotten close, and after the Kimek is done speaking, says, "Attacking several factory districts and government buildings, the terrorists are, so at once we must go. <payment>, you will receive, if by <date> we arrive."|1310|0
units.english: Without you even noticing it, an Arach agent has also gotten close, and after the Kimek is done speaking, says, "Attacking several factory districts and government buildings, the terrorists are, so at once we must go. <payment>, you will receive, if by <date> we arrive."
units.italian: Senza che tu nemmeno te ne accorga, anche un agente Arach si è avvicinato, e dopo che il Kimek ha finito di parlare dice: "Attaccare diversi distretti industriali e palazzi del governo, i terroristi lo stanno facendo, quindi subito dobbiamo andare. <payment>, tu riceverai, se entro <date> arriveremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"I'd be glad to help. Bring your colleagues and the cargo to my ship."|1312|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. Bring your colleagues and the cargo to my ship."
units.italian: "Sarei lieto di aiutare. Porta i tuoi colleghi e il carico alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"Terrorists? Can't the Heliarchs on that planet take care of it themselves?"|1314|0
units.english: "Terrorists? Can't the Heliarchs on that planet take care of it themselves?"
units.italian: "Terroristi? Gli Heliarchs di quel pianeta non possono occuparsene da soli?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"You'll have to find someone else. I'm not heading there right now."|1315|0
units.english: "You'll have to find someone else. I'm not heading there right now."
units.italian: "Dovrete trovare qualcun altro. Non vado in quella direzione adesso."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"As I said, hit many government buildings, they have," the Arach explains. "Damaged several garrisons, the attacks did, and crippled the local agents' immediate response capabilities, they have. Not to mention, a very populous and busy world, <planet> is, so a more difficult task, locating and arresting the criminals is."|1317|0
units.english: "As I said, hit many government buildings, they have," the Arach explains. "Damaged several garrisons, the attacks did, and crippled the local agents' immediate response capabilities, they have. Not to mention, a very populous and busy world, <planet> is, so a more difficult task, locating and arresting the criminals is."
units.italian: "Come ho detto, colpito molti palazzi del governo, loro lo hanno," spiega l'Arach. "Danneggiato diverse guarnigioni, gli attacchi lo hanno fatto, e azzoppato le capacità di risposta immediata degli agenti locali, essi le hanno. Senza contare che, un mondo molto popoloso e trafficato, <planet> è, quindi un compito più difficile, individuare e arrestare i criminali è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"To keep the peace, our job is," the Kimek adds. "If to assist in achieving that goal, you wish, transport us there, you should."|1318|0
units.english: "To keep the peace, our job is," the Kimek adds. "If to assist in achieving that goal, you wish, transport us there, you should."
units.italian: "Mantenere la pace, il nostro lavoro è," aggiunge il Kimek. "Se contribuire a raggiungere quell'obiettivo, tu desideri, trasportarci là, tu dovresti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"Okay. Bring your colleagues and the cargo to my ship."|1320|0
units.english: "Okay. Bring your colleagues and the cargo to my ship."
units.italian: "Va bene. Porta i tuoi colleghi e il carico alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"You'll have to find someone else. I'm not heading there right now."|1321|0
units.english: "You'll have to find someone else. I'm not heading there right now."
units.italian: "Dovrete trovare qualcun altro. Non vado in quella direzione adesso."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	They thank you for your cooperation, and use a device to call the rest of the agents to your ship. After securing the last of their cargo in your hold, you show them to their bunks and head to the cockpit.|1324|0
units.english: They thank you for your cooperation, and use a device to call the rest of the agents to your ship. After securing the last of their cargo in your hold, you show them to their bunks and head to the cockpit.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano per la collaborazione e usano un dispositivo per chiamare il resto degli agenti alla tua nave. Dopo aver sistemato l'ultimo del loro carico nella stiva, mostri loro le cuccette e vai in cabina di pilotaggio.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	They're clearly disappointed, but thank you for your time anyway, before moving on to the next merchant captain and try to recruit their assistance.|1329|0
units.english: They're clearly disappointed, but thank you for your time anyway, before moving on to the next merchant captain and try to recruit their assistance.
units.italian: Sono chiaramente delusi, ma ti ringraziano comunque per il tempo dedicato, prima di passare al prossimo capitano mercantile per cercare di ottenere il suo aiuto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	They're confused by your refusal. "Willing are you not to help your fellow troops? A danger to the civilians of the area, the criminals are."|1332|0
units.english: They're confused by your refusal. "Willing are you not to help your fellow troops? A danger to the civilians of the area, the criminals are."
units.italian: Restano confusi dal tuo rifiuto. "Disposto tu non sei ad aiutare i tuoi commilitoni? Un pericolo per i civili della zona, i criminali sono."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"A shame that is," the Arach backs away, disapprovingly. "Find others to help, we will."|1333|0
units.english: "A shame that is," the Arach backs away, disapprovingly. "Find others to help, we will."
units.italian: "Un peccato è," l'Arach si allontana, disapprovando. "Trovare altri che ci aiutino, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	The two leave, moving to nearby merchant captains to try and recruit their assistance.|1334|0
units.english: The two leave, moving to nearby merchant captains to try and recruit their assistance.
units.italian: I due se ne vanno, avvicinandosi ai capitani mercantili vicini per cercare di ottenere il loro aiuto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|Having failed to deliver the Heliarch agents on time, they leave your ship with sour looks on their faces. You're contacted by the Heliarchs who had enlisted your help.|1343|0
units.english: Having failed to deliver the Heliarch agents on time, they leave your ship with sour looks on their faces. You're contacted by the Heliarchs who had enlisted your help.
units.italian: Non essendo riusciti a consegnare in tempo gli agenti degli Heliarchs, questi lasciano la tua nave con espressioni amare. Vieni contattato dagli Heliarchs che avevano chiesto il tuo aiuto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	"Thanks to your lack of discipline, lost we have a prime opportunity to capture dangerous criminals. Unreliable you have proven, <last>."|1344|0
units.english: "Thanks to your lack of discipline, lost we have a prime opportunity to capture dangerous criminals. Unreliable you have proven, <last>."
units.italian: "Grazie alla tua mancanza di disciplina, perso abbiamo un'occasione d'oro per catturare criminali pericolosi. Inaffidabile ti sei dimostrato, <last>."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|	They sign off. It seems you'll not be getting more offers to help the Heliarchs with this particular type of work again.|1345|0
units.english: They sign off. It seems you'll not be getting more offers to help the Heliarchs with this particular type of work again.
units.italian: Si disconnettono. Sembra che non riceverai più offerte di aiuto dagli Heliarchs per questo particolare tipo di lavoro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 1|dialog|1349|0
units.english: You're told to open your hatch as soon as you land, and when you do, the Heliarch agents storm out of your ship while a separate group that was waiting for you unloads the cargo. A few seconds later you see that <payment> have been added to your account.
units.italian: Ti dicono di aprire il portello appena atterri, e quando lo fai gli agenti degli Heliarchs si precipitano fuori dalla nave mentre un altro gruppo che ti aspettava scarica il carico. Pochi secondi dopo vedi che <payment> sono stati aggiunti al tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|name|1352|0
units.english: Pick Up Injured Soldiers
units.italian: Prendere i soldati feriti

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|description|1353|0
units.english: Land on <stopovers>, to pick up the <bunks> Heliarch soldiers in need of medical attention, and transport them to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Atterra su <stopovers> per prendere i <bunks> soldati degli Heliarchs bisognosi di cure mediche, e trasportali a <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|You're stopped by a group of Heliarch agents as you enter the spaceport, most of them Arachi.|1367|0
units.english: You're stopped by a group of Heliarch agents as you enter the spaceport, most of them Arachi.
units.italian: Vieni fermato da un gruppo di agenti degli Heliarchs appena entri nello spazioporto, in maggioranza Arachi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Injured, many colleagues of ours have been. On <stopovers>, they are," one of them says. "Dealing with containing criminal operations, they were, and surprised them with an attack amidst civilians, the rogues did. Given the circumstances, dangerous for them, it might be, if treated within hospitals there, they are."|1368|0
units.english: "Injured, many colleagues of ours have been. On <stopovers>, they are," one of them says. "Dealing with containing criminal operations, they were, and surprised them with an attack amidst civilians, the rogues did. Given the circumstances, dangerous for them, it might be, if treated within hospitals there, they are."
units.italian: "Feriti, molti nostri colleghi sono stati. Su <stopovers>, essi sono," dice uno di loro. "Occuparsi di contenere operazioni criminali, essi lo stavano facendo, e sorprenderli con un attacco in mezzo ai civili, i banditi lo hanno fatto. Date le circostanze, pericoloso per loro, potrebbe essere, se curati negli ospedali laggiù, essi sono."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"<bunks>, in total, you would transport. To <destination> by <date>, they must be brought," the one Saryd of the group adds.|1369|0
units.english: "<bunks>, in total, you would transport. To <destination> by <date>, they must be brought," the one Saryd of the group adds.
units.italian: "<bunks>, in totale, tu trasporteresti. A <destination> entro <date>, devono essere portati," aggiunge l'unica Saryd del gruppo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Don't worry, I'll make sure they get help quickly."|1371|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'll make sure they get help quickly."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, mi assicurerò che ricevano aiuto in fretta."
