units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Can't you pick them up in your own ships?"|1373|0
units.english: "Can't you pick them up in your own ships?"
units.italian: "Non potete prenderli con le vostre navi?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Tragic, but I'm not interested. Sorry."|1375|0
units.english: "Tragic, but I'm not interested. Sorry."
units.italian: "Tragico, ma non sono interessato. Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	The Saryd shakes her head. "Fled <stopovers> right after the attack, many of the outlaws have. On high alert, local fleets are, to attempt to intercept their ships. Sent a few available ships as aid, we of course have, but still, use more help, we could."|1378|0
units.english: The Saryd shakes her head. "Fled <stopovers> right after the attack, many of the outlaws have. On high alert, local fleets are, to attempt to intercept their ships. Sent a few available ships as aid, we of course have, but still, use more help, we could."
units.italian: La Saryd scuote la testa. "Fuggiti da <stopovers> subito dopo l'attacco, molti dei fuorilegge lo hanno fatto. In massimo allarme, le flotte locali sono, per tentare di intercettare le loro navi. Mandato alcune navi disponibili come aiuto, noi naturalmente lo abbiamo, ma comunque, usare altro aiuto, noi potremmo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Enlisting the aid of other captains, we have been," another Arach from the group replies. "Heading there, seven other ships already are. In need of as much help as possible, we are."|1379|0
units.english: "Enlisting the aid of other captains, we have been," another Arach from the group replies. "Heading there, seven other ships already are. In need of as much help as possible, we are."
units.italian: "Arruolare l'aiuto di altri capitani, noi lo stiamo facendo," risponde un altro Arach del gruppo. "Dirette là, altre sette navi già lo sono. Bisogno di quanto più aiuto possibile, noi abbiamo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"I see. Alright, I'll head there to pick them up."|1381|0
units.english: "I see. Alright, I'll head there to pick them up."
units.italian: "Capisco. Va bene, andrò là a prenderli."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Sorry, but it sounds like you've got a lot of help already, and I'm busy with something else."|1382|0
units.english: "Sorry, but it sounds like you've got a lot of help already, and I'm busy with something else."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma sembra che abbiate già molto aiuto, e sono occupato con altro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	They thank you, and urge you to move to <stopovers> with haste. Spotting a convoy of Kimek ships landing nearby, the group moves to new potential captains to help with the efforts.|1385|0
units.english: They thank you, and urge you to move to <stopovers> with haste. Spotting a convoy of Kimek ships landing nearby, the group moves to new potential captains to help with the efforts.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano e ti esortano a raggiungere <stopovers> in fretta. Scorgendo un convoglio di navi Kimek in atterraggio lì vicino, il gruppo si sposta verso nuovi potenziali capitani per contribuire agli sforzi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	The Saryd frowns. "A shame that is, use we could all the help available." The group leaves, moving to ask the next merchant captain for help.|1390|0
units.english: The Saryd frowns. "A shame that is, use we could all the help available." The group leaves, moving to ask the next merchant captain for help.
units.italian: La Saryd aggrotta la fronte. "Un peccato è, usare noi potremmo tutto l'aiuto disponibile." Il gruppo se ne va, passando a chiedere aiuto al prossimo capitano mercantile.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	The group is clearly appalled. "Willing are you not to help your fellow troops?!" One of the Arachi exclaims.|1393|0
units.english: The group is clearly appalled. "Willing are you not to help your fellow troops?!" One of the Arachi exclaims.
units.italian: Il gruppo è chiaramente inorridito. "Disposto tu non sei ad aiutare i tuoi commilitoni?!" esclama uno degli Arachi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Disgraceful." The Saryd shakes her head. "If injured were you, would you not from your fellow Heliarchs help expect?"|1394|0
units.english: "Disgraceful." The Saryd shakes her head. "If injured were you, would you not from your fellow Heliarchs help expect?"
units.italian: "Vergognoso." La Saryd scuote la testa. "Se ferito fossi tu, non ti aspetteresti aiuto dai tuoi compagni Heliarchs?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	The group stomps away, trying to recruit more civilian captains to help.|1395|0
units.english: The group stomps away, trying to recruit more civilian captains to help.
units.italian: Il gruppo se ne va battendo i piedi, cercando di reclutare altri capitani civili.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|dialog|1400|0
units.english: You notice dozens of Heliarch warships rapidly surveying the planet. When you land, you see more of the ships that came to help pick up the injured agents. Hundreds of bandaged Saryds, Kimek, and Arachi are being brought to the ships that keep arriving and departing. You pick up your passengers and prepare to head to the medical center on <destination>.
units.italian: Noti dozzine di navi da guerra degli Heliarchs che sorvolano rapidamente il pianeta. Quando atterri, vedi altre navi arrivate per aiutare a prendere gli agenti feriti. Centinaia di Saryd, Kimek e Arachi fasciati vengono portati sulle navi che continuano ad arrivare e partire. Prendi i tuoi passeggeri e ti prepari a dirigerti al centro medico su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|Having failed to pick up and deliver the injured Heliarch agents to the healthcare facilities on time, some have succumbed to their wounds, and those who are still alive leave your ship while angrily throwing insults and complaints your way. You're contacted by the Heliarchs who had enlisted your help.|1406|0
units.english: Having failed to pick up and deliver the injured Heliarch agents to the healthcare facilities on time, some have succumbed to their wounds, and those who are still alive leave your ship while angrily throwing insults and complaints your way. You're contacted by the Heliarchs who had enlisted your help.
units.italian: Non essendo riusciti a prendere e consegnare in tempo gli agenti feriti degli Heliarchs alle strutture sanitarie, alcuni sono soccombenti alle ferite, e quelli ancora vivi lasciano la tua nave lanciandoti rabbiosamente insulti e lamentele. Vieni contattato dagli Heliarchs che avevano chiesto il tuo aiuto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Unbelievable. Cost us the lives of valuable soldiers, your lack of discipline has. Unreliable and apathetic to the woes of our troops you have proven, <last>."|1407|0
units.english: "Unbelievable. Cost us the lives of valuable soldiers, your lack of discipline has. Unreliable and apathetic to the woes of our troops you have proven, <last>."
units.italian: "Incredibile. Costato la vita a soldati preziosi, la tua mancanza di disciplina lo ha fatto. Inaffidabile e indifferente ai guai delle nostre truppe ti sei dimostrato, <last>."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	They sign off. It seems you'll not be getting more offers to help the Heliarchs with this particular type of work again.|1408|0
units.english: They sign off. It seems you'll not be getting more offers to help the Heliarchs with this particular type of work again.
units.italian: Si disconnettono. Sembra che non riceverai più offerte di aiuto dagli Heliarchs per questo particolare tipo di lavoro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|You help the medical workers get the agents on transport vehicles, and one of the Arach Heliarchs supervising the operation hands you <payment>.|1413|0
units.english: You help the medical workers get the agents on transport vehicles, and one of the Arach Heliarchs supervising the operation hands you <payment>.
units.italian: Aiuti gli operatori sanitari a caricare gli agenti sui veicoli di trasporto, e una degli Arachi degli Heliarchs che sovrintende all'operazione ti consegna <payment>.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Avoided, many casualties were, thanks to your assistance in our joint efforts, Captain," she says. "Of this cooperativeness, inform my superiors, I shall."|1414|0
units.english: "Avoided, many casualties were, thanks to your assistance in our joint efforts, Captain," she says. "Of this cooperativeness, inform my superiors, I shall."
units.italian: "Evitate, molte vittime sono state, grazie al tuo contributo nei nostri sforzi congiunti, Capitano," dice. "Di questa collaborazione, informare i miei superiori, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Thank you, but I didn't really do anything too impressive. It was just a simple transport mission."|1416|0
units.english: "Thank you, but I didn't really do anything too impressive. It was just a simple transport mission."
units.italian: "Grazie, ma non ho fatto niente di così straordinario. Era solo una semplice missione di trasporto."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"There were a lot of injured people there. What happened there with the outlaws, exactly?"|1417|0
units.english: "There were a lot of injured people there. What happened there with the outlaws, exactly?"
units.italian: "C'erano un sacco di feriti laggiù. Che cosa è successo esattamente con i fuorilegge?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"Nonsense. Looking for 'impressive' actions, we are not, when asking for assistance we are. Much more valued, your continuous assistance and cooperation is. The key to our Coalition's success, such assistance is."|1419|0
units.english: "Nonsense. Looking for 'impressive' actions, we are not, when asking for assistance we are. Much more valued, your continuous assistance and cooperation is. The key to our Coalition's success, such assistance is."
units.italian: "Sciocchezze. Cercare azioni 'straordinarie', noi non lo stiamo facendo, quando chiediamo assistenza. Molto più apprezzato, il tuo continuo aiuto e la tua collaborazione sono. La chiave del successo della nostra Coalizione, tale assistenza è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	"A terrorist attack, it was. The valuable resources and equipment stockpiled there, they sought. Thanks to the agents' efforts though, robbed, the warehouses were not," she says, pointing to the injured Heliarchs being moved from your ship and into the land vehicles.|1422|0
units.english: "A terrorist attack, it was. The valuable resources and equipment stockpiled there, they sought. Thanks to the agents' efforts though, robbed, the warehouses were not," she says, pointing to the injured Heliarchs being moved from your ship and into the land vehicles.
units.italian: "Un attacco terroristico, è stato. Le preziose risorse e attrezzature accumulate laggiù, cercavano. Grazie agli sforzi degli agenti, però, saccheggiati, i magazzini non sono stati," dice, indicando gli Heliarchs feriti che vengono spostati dalla tua nave ai veicoli terrestri.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 2|	She bids you farewell and goes back to making sure the injured agents find their way to hospitals.|1424|0
units.english: She bids you farewell and goes back to making sure the injured agents find their way to hospitals.
units.italian: Ti saluta e torna ad assicurarsi che gli agenti feriti trovino la strada per gli ospedali.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|name|1428|0
units.english: Informational Medicine
units.italian: Medicina informativa

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|description|1429|0
units.english: While picking up <cargo> from <planet stopovers>, let loose the spy bots the Heliarchs gave you to act as surveillance for the planet.
units.italian: Mentre prendi <cargo> da <planet stopovers>, libera i droni spia che gli Heliarchs ti hanno dato per sorvegliare il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|Three Heliarch officers approach you as you're walking around the spaceport. "Greetings, Captain <last>. Interested, would you be, in accompanying us? A proposition, we have," the Saryd says.|1441|0
units.english: Three Heliarch officers approach you as you're walking around the spaceport. "Greetings, Captain <last>. Interested, would you be, in accompanying us? A proposition, we have," the Saryd says.
units.italian: Tre ufficiali degli Heliarchs ti si avvicinano mentre stai girando per lo spazioporto. "Salve, Capitano <last>. Interessato, tu saresti, ad accompagnarci? Una proposta, noi abbiamo," dice il Saryd.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"What's it about?"|1443|0
units.english: "What's it about?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"Sure, lead the way."|1444|0
units.english: "Sure, lead the way."
units.italian: "Certo, fai strada."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"Sorry, not up for taking a stroll right now."|1446|0
units.english: "Sorry, not up for taking a stroll right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho voglia di fare una passeggiata adesso."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"Inform you of that, we cannot," the Kimek says. "Not until accepted our offer, you have."|1448|0
units.english: "Inform you of that, we cannot," the Kimek says. "Not until accepted our offer, you have."
units.italian: "Informarti di questo, noi non possiamo," dice il Kimek. "Non prima che accettato la nostra offerta, tu abbia."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"Fine. Bring me to somewhere you can tell me."|1450|0
units.english: "Fine. Bring me to somewhere you can tell me."
units.italian: "Va bene. Portami in un posto dove potete dirmelo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"That seems a bit sketchy, I'll pass."|1452|0
units.english: "That seems a bit sketchy, I'll pass."
units.italian: "Sembra un po' losco, passo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|Three Heliarch officers approach you as you're walking around the spaceport. They salute you, and the Saryd speaks. "Greetings, Captain <last>. Sent by Consul Plortub, we were."|1455|0
units.english: Three Heliarch officers approach you as you're walking around the spaceport. They salute you, and the Saryd speaks. "Greetings, Captain <last>. Sent by Consul Plortub, we were."
units.italian: Tre ufficiali degli Heliarchs ti si avvicinano mentre stai girando per lo spazioporto. Ti salutano, e il Saryd parla. "Salve, Capitano <last>. Mandati dal console Plortub, noi siamo stati."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"A mission for you, he has, but to discuss it in private, he wishes." The Kimek explains. "Follow us, would you?"|1456|0
units.english: "A mission for you, he has, but to discuss it in private, he wishes." The Kimek explains. "Follow us, would you?"
units.italian: "Una missione per te, lui ha, ma discuterne in privato, desidera." Spiega il Kimek. "Seguirci, tu lo faresti?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	After a few dozen twists and turns through the restricted sections of the ring, they bring you to a room where an Arach is waiting, alongside a few other Heliarchs who are discussing something while pointing at a map of the Coalition projected over the table.|1458|0
units.english: After a few dozen twists and turns through the restricted sections of the ring, they bring you to a room where an Arach is waiting, alongside a few other Heliarchs who are discussing something while pointing at a map of the Coalition projected over the table.
units.italian: Dopo qualche dozzina di svolte attraverso le sezioni riservate dell'anello, ti portano in una stanza dove aspetta un Arach, insieme a qualche altro Heliarch che sta discutendo qualcosa indicando una mappa della Coalizione proiettata sul tavolo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"Ready to work with us, are you, Captain?" the Arach asks. "The one who asked for you, I am. Call me Consul Plortub, you may."|1459|0
units.english: "Ready to work with us, are you, Captain?" the Arach asks. "The one who asked for you, I am. Call me Consul Plortub, you may."
units.italian: "Pronto a lavorare con noi, tu sei, Capitano?" chiede l'Arach. "Colui che ti ha chiesto, io sono. Chiamarmi console Plortub, tu puoi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"<first> <last>. Pleasure to meet you."|1461|0
units.english: "<first> <last>. Pleasure to meet you."
units.italian: "<first> <last>. Piacere di conoscerti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"What job did you have for me?"|1462|0
units.english: "What job did you have for me?"
units.italian: "Che lavoro avevi per me?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"In need of one such as you, we are. Received anonymous reports, we have, from loyal patriots and colleagues alike. On <stopovers>, a Saryd world, brewing, terrible activity may be. Rising in activity there, outlaw groups are, we fear," he says. "Your destination, that is."|1463|0
units.english: "In need of one such as you, we are. Received anonymous reports, we have, from loyal patriots and colleagues alike. On <stopovers>, a Saryd world, brewing, terrible activity may be. Rising in activity there, outlaw groups are, we fear," he says. "Your destination, that is."
units.italian: "Bisogno di uno come te, noi abbiamo. Ricevuto segnalazioni anonime, noi abbiamo, da leali patrioti e colleghi. Su <stopovers>, un mondo Saryd, covare, una terribile attività potrebbe. In crescita, i gruppi fuorilegge laggiù sono, temiamo," dice. "La tua destinazione, quella è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	A couple small boxes are brought inside and set on the table. Upon opening them, Plortub shows you they contain several small drones - drones very similar to those employed by the hull repair modules used in Coalition ships.|1464|0
units.english: A couple small boxes are brought inside and set on the table. Upon opening them, Plortub shows you they contain several small drones - drones very similar to those employed by the hull repair modules used in Coalition ships.
units.italian: Vengono portate dentro un paio di piccole scatole e appoggiate sul tavolo. Aprendole, Plortub ti mostra che contengono diversi piccoli droni, molto simili a quelli impiegati dai moduli di riparazione dello scafo usati sulle navi della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"A union of technologies, it is. Of the scanning module, the incredible surveillance capabilities are. Of the repair drones, the versatile mobility and durable shells are." He explains to you that you're to head to <planet stopovers> to pick up <cargo> produced on the planet, but as you're coming in for a landing, you are to jettison the crates with the drones so that they may act as spybots. "Be inconspicuous, you must. Appear to be a simple, regular job, this must. Return to <origin>, you must, after completed this task, you have. Readily available then, your payment will be. Suffice, <payment> will, surely."|1465|0
units.english: "A union of technologies, it is. Of the scanning module, the incredible surveillance capabilities are. Of the repair drones, the versatile mobility and durable shells are." He explains to you that you're to head to <planet stopovers> to pick up <cargo> produced on the planet, but as you're coming in for a landing, you are to jettison the crates with the drones so that they may act as spybots. "Be inconspicuous, you must. Appear to be a simple, regular job, this must. Return to <origin>, you must, after completed this task, you have. Readily available then, your payment will be. Suffice, <payment> will, surely."
units.italian: "Un'unione di tecnologie, è. Del modulo di scansione, le incredibili capacità di sorveglianza sono. Dei droni di riparazione, la mobilità versatile e i gusci resistenti sono." Ti spiega che devi recarti a <planet stopovers> a prendere <cargo> prodotto sul pianeta, ma mentre ti avvicini per atterrare devi sganciare le casse con i droni, così che possano agire come droni spia. "Invisibile, tu devi essere. Sembrare un lavoro semplice e normale, questo deve. Tornare a <origin>, tu devi, dopo aver completato questo compito, tu avrai. Prontamente disponibile allora, il tuo pagamento sarà. Basterà, <payment> basteranno, sicuramente."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	He wishes you good luck, and the trio from earlier escorts you back to your ship.|1466|0
units.english: He wishes you good luck, and the trio from earlier escorts you back to your ship.
units.italian: Ti augura buona fortuna, e il trio di prima ti riaccompagna alla nave.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|dialog|1471|0
units.english: As instructed, you release the drones as you come in for a landing. Judging by the normal conditions of the spaceport, no one seems to have noticed anything as you pick up the cargo.
units.italian: Come da istruzioni, liberi i droni mentre ti avvicini per atterrare. A giudicare dalle condizioni normali dello spazioporto, nessuno sembra essersi accorto di nulla mentre prendi il carico.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|Landing back on <planet>, you're met by a squad of armed Heliarchs, who are escorting Consul Plortub. He hands you your payment of <payment> with an approving nod.|1478|0
units.english: Landing back on <planet>, you're met by a squad of armed Heliarchs, who are escorting Consul Plortub. He hands you your payment of <payment> with an approving nod.
units.italian: Atterrando di nuovo su <planet>, ti accoglie una squadra di Heliarchs armati, che scorta il console Plortub. Ti consegna il pagamento di <payment> con un cenno di approvazione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 3|	"Aided us once more, you have, Captain. Look forward to further work with you, I do. Search for one of my subordinates in the local spaceport anytime, you should. Have more work for you soon, I might." He performs a brief salute, and leaves for some other section of the ring.|1479|0
units.english: "Aided us once more, you have, Captain. Look forward to further work with you, I do. Search for one of my subordinates in the local spaceport anytime, you should. Have more work for you soon, I might." He performs a brief salute, and leaves for some other section of the ring.
units.italian: "Aiutato noi ancora una volta, tu lo hai, Capitano. Non vedo l'ora di lavorare ancora con te, io. Cercare uno dei miei subordinati nello spazioporto locale, quando vuoi, tu dovresti. Altro lavoro per te presto, potrei avere." Fa un breve saluto e si dirige verso un'altra sezione dell'anello.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|name|1482|0
units.english: Undercover Transports
units.italian: Trasporti sotto copertura

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|description|1483|0
units.english: Escort three Kimek Spires full of Heliarch agents to <destination>, where they hope the use of civilian ships will give them the element of surprise.
units.italian: Scorta tre Guglie Kimek piene di agenti degli Heliarchs fino a <destination>, dove sperano che l'uso di navi civili dia loro il fattore sorpresa.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|You're stopped by one of the many armed Heliarchs in the spaceport, and are asked to follow him into the restricted sections. You comply and are led through the corridors until you're brought before Consul Plortub, in a smaller room than last time. Three Kimek Heliarchs are with him.|1493|0
units.english: You're stopped by one of the many armed Heliarchs in the spaceport, and are asked to follow him into the restricted sections. You comply and are led through the corridors until you're brought before Consul Plortub, in a smaller room than last time. Three Kimek Heliarchs are with him.
units.italian: Vieni fermato da uno dei tanti Heliarchs armati dello spazioporto, che ti chiede di seguirlo nelle sezioni riservate. Obbedisci e vieni condotto attraverso i corridoi finché non ti trovi davanti al console Plortub, in una stanza più piccola dell'ultima volta. Con lui ci sono tre Heliarchs Kimek.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|	"Ask for your assistance, once again, I must, Captain <last>," he begins. "Long been a difficult world for the Heliarchy, <destination> has. Admit I must, that known and, to my shame, ignored, lawless behavior there has been. Your continued support, you'll once more provide we hope, Captain."|1494|0
units.english: "Ask for your assistance, once again, I must, Captain <last>," he begins. "Long been a difficult world for the Heliarchy, <destination> has. Admit I must, that known and, to my shame, ignored, lawless behavior there has been. Your continued support, you'll once more provide we hope, Captain."
units.italian: "Chiederti assistenza, ancora una volta, io devo, Capitano <last>," comincia. "A lungo un mondo difficile per l'Eliarchia, <destination> lo è stato. Ammettere io devo, che noti e, con mia vergogna, ignorati, comportamenti senza legge laggiù sono stati. Il tuo continuo sostegno, ancora una volta fornirai, speriamo, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|	"What do you have in mind?"|1496|0
units.english: "What do you have in mind?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete in mente?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|	"I'm not really comfortable in helping with these. Can you let me go?"|1498|0
units.english: "I'm not really comfortable in helping with these. Can you let me go?"
units.italian: "Non mi sento a mio agio ad aiutare in queste cose. Potete lasciarmi andare?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|	He perks his head up a bit, then mumbles something in his own language, momentarily turning off the translator. He gives in, and has someone bring you back to your ship in a quick march.|1501|0
units.english: He perks his head up a bit, then mumbles something in his own language, momentarily turning off the translator. He gives in, and has someone bring you back to your ship in a quick march.
units.italian: Solleva un po' la testa, poi borbotta qualcosa nella propria lingua, spegnendo momentaneamente il traduttore. Cede, e fa riportare te alla nave a passo svelto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|	He stares at you for a few seconds, almost like a statue. "Afraid I am that orders, these are. Received them directly from the Ring of Friendship, from Consul Iekie, I have. A great asset for this task, you would be, Captain, so insist upon your involvement, I must."|1504|0
units.english: He stares at you for a few seconds, almost like a statue. "Afraid I am that orders, these are. Received them directly from the Ring of Friendship, from Consul Iekie, I have. A great asset for this task, you would be, Captain, so insist upon your involvement, I must."
units.italian: Ti fissa per qualche secondo, quasi come una statua. "Temo che ordini, questi siano. Ricevuti direttamente dall'Anello dell'Amicizia, dal console Iekie, io li ho. Una grande risorsa per questo compito, tu saresti, Capitano, quindi insistere sulla tua partecipazione, io devo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|	He introduces you to the three Kimek, and goes to explain the plan. "Been granted access to our civilian ships, you have. Three new Kimek Spires, you have very recently bought. Carrying many passengers to <destination>, in them you are. A very lucrative job, it is." He pauses for a moment to give the Kimek permission to head out. "Pose as civilians, working in your ships, they will. Armed and ready to investigate <planet> thoroughly, the soldiers in those Spires are. Instructed to follow your ship there, these three were."|1506|0
units.english: He introduces you to the three Kimek, and goes to explain the plan. "Been granted access to our civilian ships, you have. Three new Kimek Spires, you have very recently bought. Carrying many passengers to <destination>, in them you are. A very lucrative job, it is." He pauses for a moment to give the Kimek permission to head out. "Pose as civilians, working in your ships, they will. Armed and ready to investigate <planet> thoroughly, the soldiers in those Spires are. Instructed to follow your ship there, these three were."
units.italian: Ti presenta ai tre Kimek e passa a spiegare il piano. "Concesso l'accesso alle nostre navi civili, tu l'hai. Tre nuove Guglie Kimek, hai comprato molto di recente. Trasportare molti passeggeri a <destination>, con esse tu stai. Un lavoro molto redditizio, è." Si ferma un momento per dare ai Kimek il permesso di uscire. "Fingere di essere civili, lavorando sulle tue navi, essi lo faranno. Armati e pronti a indagare a fondo su <planet>, i soldati in quelle Guglie sono. Incaricati di seguire la tua nave laggiù, questi tre lo erano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|	Plortub wishes you all good luck, and you're escorted back to your ship. You see the three aforementioned Kimek Spires parked near the <ship>, and one of the Kimek Heliarchs hails you, saying they're ready to depart when you are.|1507|0
units.english: Plortub wishes you all good luck, and you're escorted back to your ship. You see the three aforementioned Kimek Spires parked near the <ship>, and one of the Kimek Heliarchs hails you, saying they're ready to depart when you are.
units.italian: Plortub vi augura buona fortuna, e vieni scortato di nuovo alla nave. Vedi le tre Guglie Kimek di cui sopra parcheggiate vicino alla <ship>, e uno dei Kimek degli Heliarchs ti chiama, dicendo che sono pronti a partire quando vuoi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-A|dialog|1518|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the Heliarch transports haven't arrived yet! Best depart and wait for them to get here.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma i trasporti degli Heliarchs non sono ancora arrivati! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-B|name|1526|0
units.english: Meet with Plortub
units.italian: Incontro con Plortub

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-B|description|1527|0
units.english: Collect your payment for escorting the Heliarch transports.
units.italian: Ritira il pagamento per aver scortato i trasporti degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-B|Hundreds of Heliarch agents pour out of the three Kimek transports, rushing in groups to separate parts of the city. They march in unison, weapons in hand. From the reactions of the locals, it's clear they were neither expecting such a thing, nor are they happy with the agents going about the city in that manner.|1536|0
units.english: Hundreds of Heliarch agents pour out of the three Kimek transports, rushing in groups to separate parts of the city. They march in unison, weapons in hand. From the reactions of the locals, it's clear they were neither expecting such a thing, nor are they happy with the agents going about the city in that manner.
units.italian: Centinaia di agenti degli Heliarchs si riversano dai tre trasporti Kimek, precipitandosi in gruppi verso parti diverse della città. Marciano all'unisono, armi in pugno. Dalle reazioni dei locali è chiaro che non si aspettavano una cosa del genere, né sono contenti che gli agenti girino per la città in quel modo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-B|	When the last of the Heliarchs leave the transports, one of the Kimek captains informs you that you should now head to <destination> to meet with Consul Plortub, collect your payment of <payment>, and "avoid getting caught in any potential retaliation."|1537|0
units.english: When the last of the Heliarchs leave the transports, one of the Kimek captains informs you that you should now head to <destination> to meet with Consul Plortub, collect your payment of <payment>, and "avoid getting caught in any potential retaliation."
units.italian: Quando l'ultimo degli Heliarchs lascia i trasporti, uno dei capitani Kimek ti informa che ora dovresti recarti a <destination> per incontrare il console Plortub, ritirare il pagamento di <payment> e "evitare di farti coinvolgere in eventuali ritorsioni".

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-B|You land in the station to find that <payment> have been transferred to you. Along with the credits comes a transmission from Plortub. "For my absence, forgive me you must, Captain. Hit Fourth Shadow again, criminals have, so organizing some ships from within the Ring of Power, I am."|1547|0
units.english: You land in the station to find that <payment> have been transferred to you. Along with the credits comes a transmission from Plortub. "For my absence, forgive me you must, Captain. Hit Fourth Shadow again, criminals have, so organizing some ships from within the Ring of Power, I am."
units.italian: Atterri nella stazione e scopri che <payment> ti sono stati trasferiti. Insieme ai crediti arriva una trasmissione di Plortub. "Per la mia assenza, perdonarmi tu devi, Capitano. Colpito di nuovo Fourth Shadow, i criminali lo hanno, quindi organizzare alcune navi dall'interno dell'Anello del Potere, io sto."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 4-B|	He goes on to explain that the attack was quite a large one, and much of the fleet stationed here was sent to help contain it. The remaining ships are helping with the <origin> operation, so the station is fairly devoid of a military presence at the moment. "A troubled week, this will be, but bother you with that, I will not. Been very useful to us your support has, Captain."|1548|0
units.english: He goes on to explain that the attack was quite a large one, and much of the fleet stationed here was sent to help contain it. The remaining ships are helping with the <origin> operation, so the station is fairly devoid of a military presence at the moment. "A troubled week, this will be, but bother you with that, I will not. Been very useful to us your support has, Captain."
units.italian: Continua spiegando che l'attacco è stato piuttosto vasto, e che gran parte della flotta di stanza qui è stata mandata ad aiutare a contenerlo. Le navi rimanenti stanno aiutando con l'operazione su <origin>, quindi la stazione è piuttosto priva di presenza militare in questo momento. "Una settimana travagliata, questa sarà, ma disturbarti con questo, io non lo farò. Molto utili a noi, il tuo sostegno è stato, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|name|1552|0
units.english: Stop The Fleeing Ships
units.italian: Fermare le navi in fuga

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|description|1553|0
units.english: Defeat the criminal ships that are attempting to flee. You must disable and board their ships in order to help the Heliarchs find the source of their weapons.
units.italian: Sconfiggi le navi criminali che stanno tentando di fuggire. Devi neutralizzare e abbordare le loro navi per aiutare gli Heliarchs a trovare la fonte delle loro armi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|After the transmission with Plortub ends, the station is awfully quiet for a few hours. You head outside your ship to see if you can find something interesting to do, but you don't find anything particularly eye-catching, as the station holds few shops. You move to the job board, but find it completely empty. You also notice that the market's trade values are not updating, and any news system is non-functional.|1563|0
units.english: After the transmission with Plortub ends, the station is awfully quiet for a few hours. You head outside your ship to see if you can find something interesting to do, but you don't find anything particularly eye-catching, as the station holds few shops. You move to the job board, but find it completely empty. You also notice that the market's trade values are not updating, and any news system is non-functional.
units.italian: Dopo che la trasmissione con Plortub è finita, la stazione è terribilmente silenziosa per qualche ora. Esci dalla nave per vedere se trovi qualcosa di interessante da fare, ma non trovi nulla di particolarmente degno di nota, dato che la stazione ha pochi negozi. Ti avvicini alla bacheca degli incarichi, ma la trovi completamente vuota. Noti anche che i valori commerciali del mercato non si aggiornano, e che qualsiasi sistema di notizie non funziona.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	Suddenly, some of the few Heliarchs still stationed here rush past you heading for an office. They quickly reemerge and approach you.|1564|0
units.english: Suddenly, some of the few Heliarchs still stationed here rush past you heading for an office. They quickly reemerge and approach you.
units.italian: All'improvviso, alcuni dei pochi Heliarchs ancora di stanza qui ti passano accanto di corsa diretti a un ufficio. Riemergono in fretta e ti si avvicinano.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	"Captain! Helped us, you have, yes? Aiding in the Remote Blue operation?" You nod. "Think you trustworthy, the consul does, and in dire need of a combat-ready ship, we are. Aid us, you must!"|1565|0
units.english: "Captain! Helped us, you have, yes? Aiding in the Remote Blue operation?" You nod. "Think you trustworthy, the consul does, and in dire need of a combat-ready ship, we are. Aid us, you must!"
units.italian: "Capitano! Aiutati, tu ci hai, vero? Contribuendo all'operazione di Remote Blue?" Fai cenno di sì. "Considerarti affidabile, il console lo fa, e in disperato bisogno di una nave pronta al combattimento, noi siamo. Aiutarci, tu devi!"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	"What's going on?"|1567|0
units.english: "What's going on?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sta succedendo?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	"What do you mean combat-ready? Are we being attacked?"|1568|0
units.english: "What do you mean combat-ready? Are we being attacked?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuol dire pronta al combattimento? Siamo sotto attacco?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	They explain that it's not simply the station's mercantile and news systems that haven't been functioning properly - they haven't been able to contact the group on Remote Blue, nor the fleet that left for Fourth Shadow, nor get in any sort of contact with anywhere else in the Coalition.|1569|0
units.english: They explain that it's not simply the station's mercantile and news systems that haven't been functioning properly - they haven't been able to contact the group on Remote Blue, nor the fleet that left for Fourth Shadow, nor get in any sort of contact with anywhere else in the Coalition.
units.italian: Spiegano che non sono solo i sistemi commerciali e di notizie della stazione a non funzionare bene: non sono riusciti a contattare il gruppo su Remote Blue, né la flotta partita per Fourth Shadow, né a mettersi in contatto con qualsiasi altro posto nella Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	"Get readings of the local systems only, we can, and alerted us, they have, of incoming ships! Armed, civilian ships! Criminals, no doubt, and fleeing Remote Blue, they are!"|1570|0
units.english: "Get readings of the local systems only, we can, and alerted us, they have, of incoming ships! Armed, civilian ships! Criminals, no doubt, and fleeing Remote Blue, they are!"
units.italian: "Leggere solo i sistemi locali, noi possiamo, e avvisato, essi ci hanno, di navi in arrivo! Armate, navi civili! Criminali, senza dubbio, e in fuga da Remote Blue, esse sono!"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	You can't say much before they've practically pushed you back into your ship. They promise you'll be greatly compensated for this, and ask that you only disable the ships so you can board and check for hostages, or possibly allow for capture and questioning of the outlaws.|1571|0
units.english: You can't say much before they've practically pushed you back into your ship. They promise you'll be greatly compensated for this, and ask that you only disable the ships so you can board and check for hostages, or possibly allow for capture and questioning of the outlaws.
units.italian: Non fai in tempo a dire granché che ti hanno praticamente spinto di nuovo dentro la nave. Promettono che sarai ampiamente ricompensato per questo, e ti chiedono di neutralizzare soltanto le navi, così che tu possa abbordarle e controllare se ci sono ostaggi, o magari permettere la cattura e l'interrogatorio dei fuorilegge.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|As you suspected from when you were fighting it, this ship is equipped with Heliarch weaponry. Unfortunately you can neither verify the equipment it is using nor check for hostages, as a self destruction sequence starts when you're about to enter it.|1578|0
units.english: As you suspected from when you were fighting it, this ship is equipped with Heliarch weaponry. Unfortunately you can neither verify the equipment it is using nor check for hostages, as a self destruction sequence starts when you're about to enter it.
units.italian: Come sospettavi mentre la combattevi, questa nave è equipaggiata con armi degli Heliarchs. Purtroppo non puoi né verificare le attrezzature che usa né controllare se ci sono ostaggi, perché una sequenza di autodistruzione parte quando stai per entrarci.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|This ship is equipped with Plasma Turrets from human space, the very weapons the Free Worlds developed. Unfortunately, it initiates a self destruction sequence as you're about to board it, so you cannot verify if it had any hostages.|1585|0
units.english: This ship is equipped with Plasma Turrets from human space, the very weapons the Free Worlds developed. Unfortunately, it initiates a self destruction sequence as you're about to board it, so you cannot verify if it had any hostages.
units.italian: Questa nave è equipaggiata con torrette al plasma dello spazio umano, proprio le armi sviluppate dai Mondi Liberi. Purtroppo avvia una sequenza di autodistruzione mentre stai per abbordarla, quindi non puoi verificare se ci fossero ostaggi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|This ship is equipped with Torpedo Launchers. Somehow, the criminals have acquired human outfits. You're about to enter the ship and look for any hostages that might have been there, but you rush back when you notice its self destruction sequence start.|1592|0
units.english: This ship is equipped with Torpedo Launchers. Somehow, the criminals have acquired human outfits. You're about to enter the ship and look for any hostages that might have been there, but you rush back when you notice its self destruction sequence start.
units.italian: Questa nave è equipaggiata con lanciatori di siluri. In qualche modo, i criminali si sono procurati attrezzature umane. Stai per entrare nella nave e cercare eventuali ostaggi, ma torni indietro di corsa quando noti che parte la sua sequenza di autodistruzione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|Though you never managed to find out if there were any hostages on board, the Heliarchs stationed at <planet> still herald you as a hero for "detaining the bandits." They immediately set to repair your ship. You're still on alert for a few hours in case any more ships come through, but nothing appears to be out of the ordinary. Near the end of the day, the station returns to normal as well; communications and other functions are restored.|1605|0
units.english: Though you never managed to find out if there were any hostages on board, the Heliarchs stationed at <planet> still herald you as a hero for "detaining the bandits." They immediately set to repair your ship. You're still on alert for a few hours in case any more ships come through, but nothing appears to be out of the ordinary. Near the end of the day, the station returns to normal as well; communications and other functions are restored.
units.italian: Anche se non sei mai riuscito a scoprire se ci fossero ostaggi a bordo, gli Heliarchs di stanza su <planet> ti acclamano comunque come un eroe per aver "trattenuto i banditi". Si mettono subito a riparare la tua nave. Resti in allarme per qualche ora nel caso arrivino altre navi, ma nulla sembra fuori dall'ordinario. Verso la fine della giornata anche la stazione torna alla normalità: le comunicazioni e le altre funzioni sono ripristinate.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	As soon as the commlinks are back, the Heliarchs contact Consul Plortub and inform him of what happened. Shortly after, <payment> are added to your account, and you're put on a call with the consul.|1606|0
units.english: As soon as the commlinks are back, the Heliarchs contact Consul Plortub and inform him of what happened. Shortly after, <payment> are added to your account, and you're put on a call with the consul.
units.italian: Appena i collegamenti sono di nuovo attivi, gli Heliarchs contattano il console Plortub e lo informano di ciò che è successo. Poco dopo, <payment> vengono aggiunti al tuo conto, e vieni messo in collegamento con il console.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	"Humiliating, it would be, had under such circumstances, the criminal ships escaped. Done well, you have, Captain." He discusses with you the outfits that the ships were using, and is alarmed to learn that they not only had Heliarch equipment, but had acquired human weapons as well. He lets out something you can't quite get, resembling a gasp or a roar; you only know that your ears don't want to hear it again.|1607|0
units.english: "Humiliating, it would be, had under such circumstances, the criminal ships escaped. Done well, you have, Captain." He discusses with you the outfits that the ships were using, and is alarmed to learn that they not only had Heliarch equipment, but had acquired human weapons as well. He lets out something you can't quite get, resembling a gasp or a roar; you only know that your ears don't want to hear it again.
units.italian: "Umiliante, sarebbe stato, se in tali circostanze, le navi criminali fossero fuggite. Fatto bene, tu hai, Capitano." Discute con te delle attrezzature che le navi usavano, e si allarma nello scoprire che non avevano solo equipaggiamento degli Heliarchs, ma si erano anche procurate armi umane. Emette qualcosa che non riesci a decifrare bene, simile a un sussulto o a un ruggito; sai solo che le tue orecchie non vogliono sentirlo di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Containment 5|	"Bring this report to the other consuls, at once I will. Ask further tasks of you, we may, but for now, done your work is, Captain." He ends the transmission after a short salute. Heliarch ships rush back in as the local garrison returns from Remote Blue. Many of the ship captains come to personally congratulate you for stopping the fleeing ships.|1608|0
units.english: "Bring this report to the other consuls, at once I will. Ask further tasks of you, we may, but for now, done your work is, Captain." He ends the transmission after a short salute. Heliarch ships rush back in as the local garrison returns from Remote Blue. Many of the ship captains come to personally congratulate you for stopping the fleeing ships.
units.italian: "Portare questo rapporto agli altri consoli, subito io lo farò. Chiedere altri compiti a te, noi potremmo, ma per ora, finito il tuo lavoro è, Capitano." Chiude la trasmissione dopo un breve saluto. Le navi degli Heliarchs rientrano in fretta mentre la guarnigione locale torna da Remote Blue. Molti dei capitani delle navi vengono a congratularsi personalmente con te per aver fermato le navi in fuga.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|name|1622|0
units.english: Refueling Drill
units.italian: Prova di rifornimento

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|description|1623|0
units.english: Escort the two Heliarch Judicators to <destination>, as part of a drill testing the Coalition's refueling capabilities in emergency situations.
units.italian: Scorta i due Judicators degli Heliarchs fino a <destination>, nell'ambito di un'esercitazione che verifica le capacità di rifornimento della Coalizione nelle situazioni di emergenza.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|A pair of Heliarch Judicators land by your ship as you leave for the spaceport. The workers storm to the ships, getting ready to refuel them. Coming down from one of the Judicators, a young Saryd with black hair barely reaching her shoulders pulls out a watch of sorts, seeming to time how long they take to completely fill up the ships' fuel tanks.|1635|0
units.english: A pair of Heliarch Judicators land by your ship as you leave for the spaceport. The workers storm to the ships, getting ready to refuel them. Coming down from one of the Judicators, a young Saryd with black hair barely reaching her shoulders pulls out a watch of sorts, seeming to time how long they take to completely fill up the ships' fuel tanks.
units.italian: Un paio di Judicators degli Heliarchs atterrano accanto alla tua nave mentre esci verso lo spazioporto. Gli operai si precipitano alle navi e si preparano a rifornirle. Scendendo da uno dei Judicators, una giovane Saryd con i capelli neri che le arrivano appena alle spalle tira fuori una specie di orologio, e sembra cronometrare quanto ci mettono a riempire completamente i serbatoi.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	When they're done, she gives an approving nod and takes a look around the hangars. When she notices you watching, she approaches you. "Greetings, human visitor," she says. "Magister Lotuora, I am. Intrigued by our ships, were you?" You begin a nod, and that's enough for her to keep talking. "A refueling drill, it was. When coming down, inform the local authorities at the last minute, we do, so that more 'authentic' it is. An important part it is, of testing how well prepared for emergencies we are."|1636|0
units.english: When they're done, she gives an approving nod and takes a look around the hangars. When she notices you watching, she approaches you. "Greetings, human visitor," she says. "Magister Lotuora, I am. Intrigued by our ships, were you?" You begin a nod, and that's enough for her to keep talking. "A refueling drill, it was. When coming down, inform the local authorities at the last minute, we do, so that more 'authentic' it is. An important part it is, of testing how well prepared for emergencies we are."
units.italian: Quando hanno finito, fa un cenno di approvazione e si guarda intorno negli hangar. Quando nota che la stai osservando, si avvicina. "Salve, visitatore umano," dice. "Magistra Lotuora, io sono. Incuriosito dalle nostre navi, tu eri?" Cominci a fare cenno di sì, e questo le basta per continuare. "Un'esercitazione di rifornimento, era. Quando scendiamo, avvisare le autorità locali all'ultimo minuto, noi lo facciamo, così che più 'autentica' sia. Una parte importante è, verificare quanto bene preparati alle emergenze noi siamo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"What sort of emergencies?"|1638|0
units.english: "What sort of emergencies?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di emergenze?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"And you want me to help with some of these drills, I take it?"|1639|0
units.english: "And you want me to help with some of these drills, I take it?"
units.italian: "E vuoi che ti aiuti con alcune di queste esercitazioni, immagino?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"It's good that you do that. I should get going now, though."|1641|0
units.english: "It's good that you do that. I should get going now, though."
units.italian: "È positivo che lo facciate. Io però dovrei andare, ora."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"All sorts of emergencies," she responds. "Quarg invasions, criminal attacks, response action to natural disasters. Ready for all of them, we need to be."|1643|0
units.english: "All sorts of emergencies," she responds. "Quarg invasions, criminal attacks, response action to natural disasters. Ready for all of them, we need to be."
units.italian: "Ogni tipo di emergenza," risponde. "Invasioni dei Quarg, attacchi criminali, interventi in risposta a disastri naturali. Pronti a tutte, noi dobbiamo essere."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	She takes a look at your ship, then to the two Judicators. "About done with the refueling drills, we were. Heading back to <planet>, I was. Set up some more interesting drills, I could, if your assistance, I had. Accompany us back there, would you?"|1645|0
units.english: She takes a look at your ship, then to the two Judicators. "About done with the refueling drills, we were. Heading back to <planet>, I was. Set up some more interesting drills, I could, if your assistance, I had. Accompany us back there, would you?"
units.italian: Dà un'occhiata alla tua nave, poi ai due Judicators. "Quasi finito con le esercitazioni di rifornimento, noi eravamo. Tornare su <planet>, io stavo. Organizzare esercitazioni più interessanti, io potrei, se il tuo aiuto, io avessi. Accompagnarci laggiù, tu lo faresti?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"Alright, what do you need me to do?"|1647|0
units.english: "Alright, what do you need me to do?"
units.italian: "Va bene, che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"What would these 'more interesting drills' involve?"|1649|0
units.english: "What would these 'more interesting drills' involve?"
units.italian: "In che cosa consisterebbero queste 'esercitazioni più interessanti'?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in that kind of work."|1650|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in that kind of work."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non sono interessato a quel genere di lavoro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"Thought of that, I still haven't," she says. "Some ship combat training, potentially. Very beneficial, training with an outsider could be."|1652|0
units.english: "Thought of that, I still haven't," she says. "Some ship combat training, potentially. Very beneficial, training with an outsider could be."
units.italian: "Pensato, non ci ho ancora," dice. "Un po' di addestramento al combattimento tra navi, potenzialmente. Molto utile, addestrarsi con un esterno potrebbe essere."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"Alright, so should I just follow your ships now?"|1654|0
units.english: "Alright, so should I just follow your ships now?"
units.italian: "Va bene, quindi dovrei semplicemente seguire le vostre navi adesso?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"Sorry, but I'm not interested in that kind of work."|1655|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not interested in that kind of work."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono interessato a quel genere di lavoro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	"Follow you to <planet>, my ships will," she says, pointing at the Judicators. "In a rush to head back, we are not, so if immediate business elsewhere, you have, follow you for a while, we could. An extension to the refueling drills, it would be."|1658|0
units.english: "Follow you to <planet>, my ships will," she says, pointing at the Judicators. "In a rush to head back, we are not, so if immediate business elsewhere, you have, follow you for a while, we could. An extension to the refueling drills, it would be."
units.italian: "Seguirti fino a <planet>, le mie navi lo faranno," dice, indicando i Judicators. "Di fretta di tornare, noi non siamo, quindi se affari immediati altrove, tu hai, seguirti per un po', noi potremmo. Un'estensione delle esercitazioni di rifornimento, sarebbe."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|	She tells you she'll pay you <payment> when you reach <planet>, and will prepare another "drill" for you to help with too. She heads back inside one of the Judicators, and they prepare to follow your ship when you launch.|1659|0
units.english: She tells you she'll pay you <payment> when you reach <planet>, and will prepare another "drill" for you to help with too. She heads back inside one of the Judicators, and they prepare to follow your ship when you launch.
units.italian: Ti dice che ti pagherà <payment> quando raggiungerai <planet>, e preparerà anche un'altra "esercitazione" a cui farai bene a partecipare. Torna dentro uno dei Judicators, e si preparano a seguire la tua nave quando partirai.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|dialog|1676|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left some of the Heliarch escorts behind. Better depart and wait for them to get here.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro alcune delle scorte degli Heliarchs. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 1|Lotuora pays you <payment> when you land. "An idea for the next drill, I've had," she says. "Need to arrange some more ships, I do, so need some hours, I will. Meet me in the spaceport when I'm done, you should."|1684|0
units.english: Lotuora pays you <payment> when you land. "An idea for the next drill, I've had," she says. "Need to arrange some more ships, I do, so need some hours, I will. Meet me in the spaceport when I'm done, you should."
units.italian: Lotuora ti paga <payment> quando atterri. "Un'idea per la prossima esercitazione, io l'ho avuta," dice. "Organizzare altre navi, io devo, quindi servirmi qualche ora, mi servirà. Incontrarmi allo spazioporto quando ho finito, tu dovresti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|name|1687|0
units.english: Pursuit Drill
units.italian: Prova di inseguimento

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|description|1688|0
units.english: Land on <planet> while avoiding the Heliarch Hunters.
units.italian: Atterra su <planet> evitando gli Hunters degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|When you find Magister Lotuora in the spaceport, she shows you to a map of the Coalition. Pointing to two systems, she indicates one in Kimek and one in Saryd space. "Made many calls, I have, and to assemble many ships for this drill, I've managed. How fit for their job, our Hunters are, we shall see."|1698|0
units.english: When you find Magister Lotuora in the spaceport, she shows you to a map of the Coalition. Pointing to two systems, she indicates one in Kimek and one in Saryd space. "Made many calls, I have, and to assemble many ships for this drill, I've managed. How fit for their job, our Hunters are, we shall see."
units.italian: Quando trovi la magistra Lotuora nello spazioporto, ti mostra una mappa della Coalizione. Indicando due sistemi, ne segnala uno nello spazio Kimek e uno nello spazio Saryd. "Fatto molte chiamate, io ho, e radunare molte navi per questa esercitazione, io sono riuscita. Quanto adatti al loro compito, i nostri Hunters siano, lo vedremo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	"What do you mean?"|1700|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	"Will I be fighting them?"|1702|0
units.english: "Will I be fighting them?"
units.italian: "Dovrò combatterli?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	"No, no fighting," she says. "Not yet. Only simulating a pursuit, they will be."|1703|0
units.english: "No, no fighting," she says. "Not yet. Only simulating a pursuit, they will be."
units.italian: "No, niente combattimenti," dice. "Non ancora. Solo simulare un inseguimento, essi lo faranno."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	She points to the systems again. "To land on <planet> and Ashy Reach unseen by the Hunters, your task is. Attack you, they will not, but allow them to be in the system when you land, you cannot. Once cleared both planets, you have, return here for <payment>, you may."|1705|0
units.english: She points to the systems again. "To land on <planet> and Ashy Reach unseen by the Hunters, your task is. Attack you, they will not, but allow them to be in the system when you land, you cannot. Once cleared both planets, you have, return here for <payment>, you may."
units.italian: Indica di nuovo i sistemi. "Atterrare su <planet> e su Ashy Reach senza essere visti dagli Hunters, il tuo compito è. Attaccarti, essi non lo faranno, ma permettere loro di essere nel sistema quando atterri, tu non puoi. Una volta che hai completato entrambi i pianeti, tornare qui per <payment>, tu puoi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	"Okay, I'll head out to the planets then."|1707|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll head out to the planets then."
units.italian: "Va bene, allora andrò verso i pianeti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	"Can you tell me where my pursuers will be?"|1709|0
units.english: "Can you tell me where my pursuers will be?"
units.italian: "Puoi dirmi dove saranno i miei inseguitori?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	"Know of their pursuers, the pursued do not," she says, letting out a laugh as if it was a joke. "Well, usually... From many systems across the Coalition, the Hunters are. Ready to follow your ship when you launch, they will be."|1710|0
units.english: "Know of their pursuers, the pursued do not," she says, letting out a laugh as if it was a joke. "Well, usually... From many systems across the Coalition, the Hunters are. Ready to follow your ship when you launch, they will be."
units.italian: "Dei loro inseguitori, gli inseguiti non sanno nulla," dice, lasciandosi sfuggire una risata come se fosse uno scherzo. "Beh, di solito... Da molti sistemi in tutta la Coalizione, gli Hunters vengono. Pronti a seguire la tua nave quando partirai, essi saranno."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|	She points again to one of the planets. "Still preparing, some Hunters around Ashy Reach are, so head for <planet> first, you should." She wishes you luck on avoiding the Hunters and heads off to a Heliarch military building.|1712|0
units.english: She points again to one of the planets. "Still preparing, some Hunters around Ashy Reach are, so head for <planet> first, you should." She wishes you luck on avoiding the Hunters and heads off to a Heliarch military building.
units.italian: Indica di nuovo uno dei pianeti. "Ancora in preparazione, alcuni Hunters intorno ad Ashy Reach sono, quindi dirigerti verso <planet> per primo, tu dovresti." Ti augura buona fortuna nell'evitare gli Hunters e si dirige verso un edificio militare degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-A|dialog|1764|0
units.english: After you land, one of the Heliarch Hunters who was pursuing you lands beside you. You'll need to shake it off before landing here to succeed.
units.italian: Dopo che atterri, uno degli Hunters degli Heliarchs che ti inseguiva atterra accanto a te. Dovrai seminarlo prima di atterrare qui per riuscire nell'impresa.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-B|name|1772|0
units.english: Pursuit Drill
units.italian: Prova di inseguimento

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-B|description|1773|0
units.english: Land on <planet> while avoiding the Heliarch Hunters.
units.italian: Atterra su <planet> evitando gli Hunters degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-B|You land without any of the Hunters tailing you, and a Heliarch on the ground speaks into a communicator while looking at your ship. Minutes later, Magister Lotuora contacts you. "Well done, Captain! Onto the next target, <planet>, you may move." She wishes you good luck again and signs off.|1782|0
units.english: You land without any of the Hunters tailing you, and a Heliarch on the ground speaks into a communicator while looking at your ship. Minutes later, Magister Lotuora contacts you. "Well done, Captain! Onto the next target, <planet>, you may move." She wishes you good luck again and signs off.
units.italian: Atterri senza che nessuno degli Hunters ti stia alle calcagna, e un Heliarch a terra parla in un comunicatore guardando la tua nave. Minuti dopo, la magistra Lotuora ti contatta. "Ben fatto, Capitano! Verso il prossimo obiettivo, <planet>, puoi spostarti." Ti augura di nuovo buona fortuna e si disconnette.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-B|dialog|1842|0
units.english: After you land, one of the Heliarch Hunters who was pursuing you lands beside you. You'll need to shake it off before landing here to succeed.
units.italian: Dopo che atterri, uno degli Hunters degli Heliarchs che ti inseguiva atterra accanto a te. Dovrai seminarlo prima di atterrare qui per riuscire nell'impresa.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-C|name|1850|0
units.english: Pursuit Drill
units.italian: Prova di inseguimento

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-C|description|1851|0
units.english: Land on <planet> while avoiding the Heliarch Hunters.
units.italian: Atterra su <planet> evitando gli Hunters degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-C|Once again, you managed to avoid the Hunters while landing on <origin>, and a local Heliarch agent informs Magister Lotuora of your success. "Excellent work, Captain <last>," she says when she contacts you. "Now, talked with some contacts I have, and one more drill for you to help with, I have arranged. Return to <planet> at your earliest convenience, you may." She signs off... and calls back seconds after. "Ah, forgive me you must, Captain. Forgotten something, I had. Hear of the recent drills, some colleagues did, and readied their own Hunters to participate, they now have. Avoid them on your return to <planet>, as per usual, you should."|1860|0
units.english: Once again, you managed to avoid the Hunters while landing on <origin>, and a local Heliarch agent informs Magister Lotuora of your success. "Excellent work, Captain <last>," she says when she contacts you. "Now, talked with some contacts I have, and one more drill for you to help with, I have arranged. Return to <planet> at your earliest convenience, you may." She signs off... and calls back seconds after. "Ah, forgive me you must, Captain. Forgotten something, I had. Hear of the recent drills, some colleagues did, and readied their own Hunters to participate, they now have. Avoid them on your return to <planet>, as per usual, you should."
units.italian: Ancora una volta sei riuscito a evitare gli Hunters atterrando su <origin>, e un agente degli Heliarchs del posto informa la magistra Lotuora del tuo successo. "Lavoro eccellente, Capitano <last>," dice quando ti contatta. "Ora, parlato con alcuni contatti che ho, e un'altra esercitazione a cui farti partecipare, io ho organizzato. Tornare su <planet> appena ti è comodo, tu puoi." Si disconnette... e richiama pochi secondi dopo. "Ah, perdonarmi tu devi, Capitano. Dimenticato qualcosa, io avevo. Sentito parlare delle esercitazioni recenti, alcuni colleghi lo hanno, e preparato i propri Hunters per partecipare, ora lo hanno fatto. Evitarli al tuo ritorno su <planet>, come al solito, tu dovresti."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-C|	She mentions they've contributed some credits to your reward, now a total of <payment>, which will be yours when you land on <destination> without any of the Hunters on your tail.|1861|0
units.english: She mentions they've contributed some credits to your reward, now a total of <payment>, which will be yours when you land on <destination> without any of the Hunters on your tail.
units.italian: Menziona che hanno contribuito con alcuni crediti alla tua ricompensa, ora pari a <payment> in totale, che saranno tuoi quando atterrerai su <destination> senza nessuno degli Hunters alle calcagna.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-C|dialog|1993|0
units.english: After you land, one of the Heliarch Hunters who was pursuing you lands beside you. You'll need to shake it off before landing here to succeed.
units.italian: Dopo che atterri, uno degli Hunters degli Heliarchs che ti inseguiva atterra accanto a te. Dovrai seminarlo prima di atterrare qui per riuscire nell'impresa.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 2-C|Magister Lotuora meets you when you land, handing you your payment of <payment>, and congratulating you for managing to evade the pursuing ships. "Frustrated many of the Hunter pilots, I heard you have," she says with a laugh. "Good training for them, I hope this was. Finishing up the arrangements for one more drill, I am. When ready, you are, meet me in the spaceport, you must."|2001|0
units.english: Magister Lotuora meets you when you land, handing you your payment of <payment>, and congratulating you for managing to evade the pursuing ships. "Frustrated many of the Hunter pilots, I heard you have," she says with a laugh. "Good training for them, I hope this was. Finishing up the arrangements for one more drill, I am. When ready, you are, meet me in the spaceport, you must."
units.italian: La magistra Lotuora ti incontra all'atterraggio, consegnandoti il pagamento di <payment> e congratulandosi per essere riuscito a evitare le navi inseguitrici. "Frustrato molti dei piloti degli Hunters, a quanto sento, tu li hai," dice con una risata. "Un buon addestramento per loro, spero che questa sia stata. Concludere i preparativi per un'altra esercitazione, io sto. Quando pronto, tu sia, incontrarmi allo spazioporto, tu devi."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|name|2004|0
units.english: Combat Drill
units.italian: Scontro di prova

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|description|2005|0
units.english: Head to the <waypoints> system to fight the <npc>, and report back to <planet> when you succeed. You must only disable the ship. Destroying or capturing it would deem you an enemy of the Heliarchs.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema <waypoints> per combattere il <npc>, e riferisci su <planet> quando ci riesci. Devi solo neutralizzare la nave. Distruggerla o catturarla ti renderebbe un nemico degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|Lotuora is speaking with a Kimek Heliarch captain at the entrance to the spaceport. "Ah, there the Captain is," she tells the Kimek. "Captain <last>, your sparring partner, this is," she says, gesturing to the Kimek, who salutes you with a short bow of her head. "Excited to test her ship against an outsider, she is."|2014|0
units.english: Lotuora is speaking with a Kimek Heliarch captain at the entrance to the spaceport. "Ah, there the Captain is," she tells the Kimek. "Captain <last>, your sparring partner, this is," she says, gesturing to the Kimek, who salutes you with a short bow of her head. "Excited to test her ship against an outsider, she is."
units.italian: Lotuora sta parlando con una capitana Kimek degli Heliarchs all'ingresso dello spazioporto. "Ah, ecco il Capitano," dice alla Kimek. "Capitano <last>, il tuo compagno di addestramento, questi è," dice, indicando la Kimek, che ti saluta con un breve cenno del capo. "Desiderosa di mettere alla prova la sua nave contro un esterno, lei è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	The Kimek doesn't stay for long, only wishing you a "good fight" and heading to the hangars, where she boards a Punisher and flies away. You look to Lotuora, waiting for her to explain. "Tough ships, our Punishers are, but looked into your encounter records, we have, and experience in fighting, you have," she says. "To avoid any accidents, we want, so swapped out, the ship's Finisher Pods were. A mere drill, this is, so only aim to disable one another, you shall. If successful, you are, set aside <payment> for your efforts, we have."|2015|0
units.english: The Kimek doesn't stay for long, only wishing you a "good fight" and heading to the hangars, where she boards a Punisher and flies away. You look to Lotuora, waiting for her to explain. "Tough ships, our Punishers are, but looked into your encounter records, we have, and experience in fighting, you have," she says. "To avoid any accidents, we want, so swapped out, the ship's Finisher Pods were. A mere drill, this is, so only aim to disable one another, you shall. If successful, you are, set aside <payment> for your efforts, we have."
units.italian: La Kimek non si ferma a lungo: ti augura solo un "buon combattimento" e si dirige agli hangar, dove sale su un Punisher e vola via. Guardi Lotuora, aspettando che spieghi. "Navi robuste, i nostri Punishers sono, ma esaminato i tuoi registri di incontri, noi abbiamo, e esperienza nel combattere, tu hai," dice. "Per evitare incidenti, noi vogliamo, quindi sostituiti, i pod Finisher della nave sono stati. Solo un'esercitazione, questa è, quindi puntare solo a neutralizzarvi a vicenda, voi dovrete. Se vittorioso, tu sarai, messo da parte <payment> per i tuoi sforzi, noi abbiamo."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	"Great. I'm excited to test my skills against one of your warships."|2017|0
units.english: "Great. I'm excited to test my skills against one of your warships."
units.italian: "Ottimo. Sono impaziente di mettere alla prova le mie capacità contro una delle vostre navi da guerra."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	"Actually, I'm not sure I'm up for this. I don't think my ship can make it against a Punisher."|2019|0
units.english: "Actually, I'm not sure I'm up for this. I don't think my ship can make it against a Punisher."
units.italian: "In realtà, non sono sicuro di essere all'altezza. Non credo che la mia nave possa farcela contro un Punisher."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	For the first time you see Lotuora drop her smile, seemingly confused and saddened by the prospect of having to call off the match. "What? Come now, Captain, sure I am that do fine you will. If well equipped, your ship is not, free to arm yourself however you wish and return to duel the Punisher at a later time, you are." She takes on a softer tone, and continues. "If really not agreeable to you, this is, cancel the duel I can, but get an opportunity like this, we often do not. Really appreciated, your cooperation with this last drill would be."|2020|0
units.english: For the first time you see Lotuora drop her smile, seemingly confused and saddened by the prospect of having to call off the match. "What? Come now, Captain, sure I am that do fine you will. If well equipped, your ship is not, free to arm yourself however you wish and return to duel the Punisher at a later time, you are." She takes on a softer tone, and continues. "If really not agreeable to you, this is, cancel the duel I can, but get an opportunity like this, we often do not. Really appreciated, your cooperation with this last drill would be."
units.italian: Per la prima volta vedi Lotuora perdere il sorriso, apparentemente confusa e dispiaciuta all'idea di dover annullare il duello. "Come? Dai, Capitano, certa io sono che te la caverai bene. Se ben equipaggiata, la tua nave non lo è, libero di armarti come preferisci e tornare a duellare con il Punisher in un altro momento, tu sei." Assume un tono più morbido e continua. "Se davvero non accettabile per te, questo è, annullare il duello io posso, ma un'occasione come questa, spesso non ne abbiamo. Davvero apprezzata, la tua collaborazione con quest'ultima esercitazione sarebbe."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	"Well, alright, I suppose I can look for ways to prepare myself for the fight."|2022|0
units.english: "Well, alright, I suppose I can look for ways to prepare myself for the fight."
units.italian: "Beh, va bene, suppongo di poter cercare modi per prepararmi allo scontro."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	"I'm sorry, but I'm just not comfortable taking on a warship of yours like that."|2023|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm just not comfortable taking on a warship of yours like that."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma proprio non me la sento di affrontare così una delle vostre navi da guerra."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	She nearly jumps, and her jolly demeanor returns as if flipped by a switch. "Thank you Captain <last>! Truly an unique experience, this shall be."|2025|0
units.english: She nearly jumps, and her jolly demeanor returns as if flipped by a switch. "Thank you Captain <last>! Truly an unique experience, this shall be."
units.italian: Quasi salta, e il suo atteggiamento allegro torna come azionato da un interruttore. "Grazie Capitano <last>! Davvero un'esperienza unica, questa sarà."

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	She stares on for a while, then brings up a map. "Headed to the <waypoints> system, the Punisher is. Wait for you there, it will." She tells you to head to <waypoints> when you're ready to fight the Punisher, and reminds you to only disable the ship, as any harsher action would make you a criminal to the Heliarchs.|2027|0
units.english: She stares on for a while, then brings up a map. "Headed to the <waypoints> system, the Punisher is. Wait for you there, it will." She tells you to head to <waypoints> when you're ready to fight the Punisher, and reminds you to only disable the ship, as any harsher action would make you a criminal to the Heliarchs.
units.italian: Resta a guardare per un po', poi tira su una mappa. "Diretto al sistema <waypoints>, il Punisher è. Aspettarti lì, lo farà." Ti dice di dirigerti a <waypoints> quando sei pronto a combattere il Punisher, e ti ricorda di neutralizzare soltanto la nave, perché qualsiasi azione più dura ti renderebbe un criminale agli occhi degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|dialog|2038|0
units.english: The Punisher's captain tries to hail you as the ship collapses around them, but you never get to hear their final cries. You have failed to simply disable the ship, and doomed the entire crew. It seems that you will not be welcome in Coalition space any longer.
units.italian: La capitana del Punisher cerca di chiamarti mentre la nave crolla intorno a loro, ma non riesci mai a sentire le loro ultime grida. Hai fallito nel neutralizzare semplicemente la nave, e condannato l'intero equipaggio. Sembra che non sarai più il benvenuto nello spazio della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|dialog|2043|0
units.english: Although you've disabled the Punisher, you decide to move in and board the ship in order to salvage it, breaking any trust the Heliarchs had in you. They, and the rest of the Coalition, will not be pleased with this.
units.italian: Anche se hai neutralizzato il Punisher, decidi di avvicinarti e abbordare la nave per recuperarla, rompendo qualsiasi fiducia gli Heliarchs avessero in te. Loro, e il resto della Coalizione, non ne saranno contenti.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|dialog|2045|0
units.english: After a long, exhausting battle, you and your crew successfully capture the Punisher. With the captain's life on your hands, as well as most of her crew, the Coalition most certainly won't be welcoming you anymore.
units.italian: Dopo una lunga ed estenuante battaglia, tu e il tuo equipaggio riuscite a catturare il Punisher. Con la vita della capitana sulle tue mani, e quella di gran parte del suo equipaggio, la Coalizione certamente non ti accoglierà più.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|dialog|2051|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you have not disabled the <npc> yet. Disable it before returning.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora neutralizzato il <npc>. Neutralizzalo prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|Magister Lotuora greets you when you return. "Prevailed over one of our Punishers, you have! Perhaps the real threat, you are, not the Quarg," she says, looking at you for a few seconds as if expecting you to laugh. She hands you <payment>, and continues, "Sent a recording of the fight, I was. Learn much from it, I hope we can."|2058|0
units.english: Magister Lotuora greets you when you return. "Prevailed over one of our Punishers, you have! Perhaps the real threat, you are, not the Quarg," she says, looking at you for a few seconds as if expecting you to laugh. She hands you <payment>, and continues, "Sent a recording of the fight, I was. Learn much from it, I hope we can."
units.italian: La magistra Lotuora ti accoglie al ritorno. "Prevalso su uno dei nostri Punishers, tu lo hai! Forse la vera minaccia, tu sei, non i Quarg," dice, guardandoti per qualche secondo come se si aspettasse che tu ridessi. Ti consegna <payment> e continua: "Inviato una registrazione dello scontro, io l'ho. Imparare molto da essa, spero che noi potremo."
