units.id: mission:Heliarch Drills 3|	She thanks you for helping her with the drills, saying it will be a great help in training the cadets at the local academy. She concludes by wishing you safe travels, and then heads to a Heliarch building.|2059|0
units.english: She thanks you for helping her with the drills, saying it will be a great help in training the cadets at the local academy. She concludes by wishing you safe travels, and then heads to a Heliarch building.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia per averla aiutata con le esercitazioni, dicendo che sarà di grande aiuto nell'addestramento delle reclute dell'accademia locale. Conclude augurandoti buon viaggio, e poi si dirige verso un edificio degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 1|name|2064|0
units.english: Meet With The Consuls
units.italian: Incontro con i consoli

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 1|description|2065|0
units.english: Head to the <destination>, where the Heliarch consuls will make you a Heliarch agent.
units.italian: Recati a <destination>, dove i consoli degli Heliarchs ti faranno diventare un agente degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 1|When you land on <origin>, you find a Heliarch delegation waiting for you outside. When you meet them, the Saryd of the group says, "A great ally to our Coalition, you have proven to be."|2087|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, you find a Heliarch delegation waiting for you outside. When you meet them, the Saryd of the group says, "A great ally to our Coalition, you have proven to be."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, trovi una delegazione degli Heliarchs che ti aspetta fuori. Quando li incontri, il Saryd del gruppo dice: "Un grande alleato per la nostra Coalizione, tu si è dimostrato."

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 1|	"Discussed your exploits, the consuls have. Much satisfaction, your contributions brought us," the Kimek continues.|2088|0
units.english: "Discussed your exploits, the consuls have. Much satisfaction, your contributions brought us," the Kimek continues.
units.italian: "Discusso delle tue imprese, i consoli lo hanno. Molta soddisfazione, i tuoi contributi ci hanno portato," continua il Kimek.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 1|	"With you, a meeting they request. To <destination> you must go, if to join our ranks, you so wish," the Arach finishes.|2089|0
units.english: "With you, a meeting they request. To <destination> you must go, if to join our ranks, you so wish," the Arach finishes.
units.italian: "Con te, una riunione essi richiedono. A <destination> tu devi andare, se unirti ai nostri ranghi, tu lo desideri," conclude l'Arach.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 1|dialog|2092|0
units.english: You are currently assisting the Lunarium. Cancel or finish any missions you have for them if you want to join the Heliarchy.
units.italian: Stai attualmente assistendo il Lunarium. Annulla o completa le missioni che hai per loro se vuoi unirti all'Eliarchia.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|The Heliarch authorities of the <origin> have offered you a position in the ranks of the Heliarchs. Would you like to meet with them and officially join the Heliarchy? Given their history with the Quarg, and the rumors of rebellion stirring in Coalition space, this would no doubt set you on a path to conflict with the Quarg and the resistance forces.|2104|0
units.english: The Heliarch authorities of the <origin> have offered you a position in the ranks of the Heliarchs. Would you like to meet with them and officially join the Heliarchy? Given their history with the Quarg, and the rumors of rebellion stirring in Coalition space, this would no doubt set you on a path to conflict with the Quarg and the resistance forces.
units.italian: Le autorità degli Heliarchs di <origin> ti hanno offerto una posizione nei ranghi degli Heliarchs. Vuoi incontrarle e unirti ufficialmente all'Eliarchia? Data la loro storia con i Quarg, e le voci di ribellione che si agitano nello spazio della Coalizione, questo ti metterebbe senza dubbio su un cammino di conflitto con i Quarg e con le forze della resistenza.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	(Yes.)|2106|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	(Not yet.)|2107|0
units.english: (Not yet.)
units.italian: (Non ancora.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	(No. I don't want to support the Heliarchs at all.)|2109|0
units.english: (No. I don't want to support the Heliarchs at all.)
units.italian: (No. Non voglio sostenere gli Heliarchs in alcun modo.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|log|2112|0
units.english: Was given a special circlet by the Heliarchs, which grants access to some of their technology. Was also given a translation device to freely converse with the Coalition species.
units.italian: Ti è stato dato un cerchietto speciale dagli Heliarchs, che dà accesso ad alcune delle loro tecnologie. Ti è stato dato anche un dispositivo di traduzione per conversare liberamente con le specie della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	When you land, you're met with a bit of ceremony. A trio of Heliarch consuls welcomes you, each carrying a gemstone: an emerald for the Saryd, a ruby for the Kimek, and a sapphire for the Arach. They each pass the precious stones to you, starting with the Saryd, then the Kimek, and lastly the Arach. Cameras and photographers surround the scene, kept at bay by lines of Heliarch guards. It seems your joining the ranks has turned into something of an event.|2117|0
units.english: When you land, you're met with a bit of ceremony. A trio of Heliarch consuls welcomes you, each carrying a gemstone: an emerald for the Saryd, a ruby for the Kimek, and a sapphire for the Arach. They each pass the precious stones to you, starting with the Saryd, then the Kimek, and lastly the Arach. Cameras and photographers surround the scene, kept at bay by lines of Heliarch guards. It seems your joining the ranks has turned into something of an event.
units.italian: All'atterraggio ti accoglie una piccola cerimonia. Un trio di consoli degli Heliarchs ti dà il benvenuto, ciascuno con una pietra preziosa: uno smeraldo per il Saryd, un rubino per il Kimek e uno zaffiro per l'Arach. Ognuno ti passa la pietra, cominciando dal Saryd, poi il Kimek, e infine l'Arach. Telecamere e fotografi circondano la scena, tenuti a distanza da file di guardie degli Heliarchs. Sembra che il tuo ingresso nei ranghi sia diventato una specie di evento.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	When the consuls are done, they have you follow them into the restricted sections of the ring, bringing you to a very large, circular room, somewhat like a colosseum or an auditorium, with hundreds of Heliarch consuls seated. There are also many more camera workers and photographers, though all of them are Heliarch members this time. You're instructed to head to the center.|2118|0
units.english: When the consuls are done, they have you follow them into the restricted sections of the ring, bringing you to a very large, circular room, somewhat like a colosseum or an auditorium, with hundreds of Heliarch consuls seated. There are also many more camera workers and photographers, though all of them are Heliarch members this time. You're instructed to head to the center.
units.italian: Quando i consoli hanno finito, ti fanno seguire loro nelle sezioni riservate dell'anello, portandoti in una stanza circolare molto grande, simile a un colosseo o a un auditorium, con centinaia di consoli degli Heliarchs seduti. Ci sono anche molti altri operatori e fotografi, tutti membri degli Heliarchs questa volta. Ti ordinano di andare al centro.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	The consuls who brought you here speak, and once again you're reminded of your "contributions and loyalty" to the Coalition. "Truly special, this ceremony is," the Arach says. "Join our ranks, for the first time, an outsider does. Contributed much and shown devotion to our Coalition, this outsider has."|2119|0
units.english: The consuls who brought you here speak, and once again you're reminded of your "contributions and loyalty" to the Coalition. "Truly special, this ceremony is," the Arach says. "Join our ranks, for the first time, an outsider does. Contributed much and shown devotion to our Coalition, this outsider has."
units.italian: I consoli che ti hanno portato qui parlano, e ancora una volta ti viene ricordato il tuo "contributo e la tua lealtà" alla Coalizione. "Davvero speciale, questa cerimonia è," dice l'Arach. "Unirsi ai nostri ranghi, per la prima volta, un esterno lo fa. Contribuito molto e mostrato dedizione alla nostra Coalizione, questo esterno lo ha."

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	"From humanity, <first> <last> has come," the Kimek continues. "Our most recent neighbor, and a group still under the chiding eyes of the Quarg, they are. To reach them all, to free them all, we still cannot, but, our first step in that front, Captain <last>'s coronation is."|2120|0
units.english: "From humanity, <first> <last> has come," the Kimek continues. "Our most recent neighbor, and a group still under the chiding eyes of the Quarg, they are. To reach them all, to free them all, we still cannot, but, our first step in that front, Captain <last>'s coronation is."
units.italian: "Dall'umanità, <first> <last> è venuto," continua il Kimek. "Il nostro più recente vicino, e un gruppo ancora sotto lo sguardo severo dei Quarg, essi sono. Raggiungerli tutti, liberarli tutti, noi ancora non possiamo, ma, il nostro primo passo su quel fronte, l'incoronazione del Capitano <last> è."

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	The Saryd approaches you, carrying some type of chest. Opening it, she reveals a golden circlet inside, staying silent and looking at you.|2121|0
units.english: The Saryd approaches you, carrying some type of chest. Opening it, she reveals a golden circlet inside, staying silent and looking at you.
units.italian: Il Saryd ti si avvicina, portando una specie di scrigno. Aprendolo, rivela all'interno un cerchietto dorato, restando in silenzio e guardandoti.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	"Do I put it on myself?"|2123|0
units.english: "Do I put it on myself?"
units.italian: "Me lo metto da solo?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	(Take the circlet.)|2124|0
units.english: (Take the circlet.)
units.italian: (Prendi il cerchietto.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	"Allow others to crown us, we do not," she says. "Not anymore."|2126|0
units.english: "Allow others to crown us, we do not," she says. "Not anymore."
units.italian: "Permettere ad altri di incoronarci, noi non lo facciamo," dice. "Non più."

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	(Take the circlet.)|2128|0
units.english: (Take the circlet.)
units.italian: (Prendi il cerchietto.)

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	You pick up the circlet and raise it to your head, the Heliarch consuls all standing up when you do. You bring it down and adjust it so that it fits you well. Once the "crowning" is done, many of the consuls cheer in celebration, which is followed with something akin to a round of applause and more of the speeches from before.|2130|0
units.english: You pick up the circlet and raise it to your head, the Heliarch consuls all standing up when you do. You bring it down and adjust it so that it fits you well. Once the "crowning" is done, many of the consuls cheer in celebration, which is followed with something akin to a round of applause and more of the speeches from before.
units.italian: Prendi il cerchietto e lo alzi verso la testa, e i consoli degli Heliarchs si alzano tutti in piedi. Lo abbassi e lo sistemi perché ti calzi bene. Una volta che l'"incoronazione" è finita, molti dei consoli esultano in festa, seguiti da qualcosa di simile a un applauso e da altri dei discorsi di prima.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	When it's all over, you're escorted out by some of the guards, but remain in the restricted sections. Here you are now brought to a much smaller room, where a pair of Heliarchs in lab coats are working at some device reminiscent of a hospital's ultrasound machine. One of them asks you for your circlet, attaching it to various cables near the machine's controls. "Configure your circlet we now shall, so that to your will it responds," the other says, gesturing for you to take a seat. He holds a large, helmet-like piece, with a cable at the top connecting to the machine.|2131|0
units.english: When it's all over, you're escorted out by some of the guards, but remain in the restricted sections. Here you are now brought to a much smaller room, where a pair of Heliarchs in lab coats are working at some device reminiscent of a hospital's ultrasound machine. One of them asks you for your circlet, attaching it to various cables near the machine's controls. "Configure your circlet we now shall, so that to your will it responds," the other says, gesturing for you to take a seat. He holds a large, helmet-like piece, with a cable at the top connecting to the machine.
units.italian: Quando è tutto finito, vieni scortato fuori da alcune guardie, ma resti nelle sezioni riservate. Qui vieni portato in una stanza molto più piccola, dove un paio di Heliarchs in camice bianco lavorano a un dispositivo che ricorda un'ecografia da ospedale. Uno di loro ti chiede il cerchietto e lo collega a vari cavi vicino ai comandi della macchina. "Configurare il tuo cerchietto ora noi lo faremo, così che alla tua volontà risponda," dice l'altro, facendoti cenno di sederti. Tiene in mano un grosso pezzo simile a un casco, con un cavo in cima che si collega alla macchina.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	"To my will? What do you mean?"|2133|0
units.english: "To my will? What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Alla mia volontà? Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	"Is this really necessary?"|2134|0
units.english: "Is this really necessary?"
units.italian: "È davvero necessario?"

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	"Mere jewelry pieces or symbols of rank, these are not," the one tinkering with your circlet explains. "Serve they do as links, interfaces between a Heliarch's will and our Coalition's machines and programs. Allow you they will to access some of our restricted ring sections, and serve as keys to our many outfitters, they do."|2135|0
units.english: "Mere jewelry pieces or symbols of rank, these are not," the one tinkering with your circlet explains. "Serve they do as links, interfaces between a Heliarch's will and our Coalition's machines and programs. Allow you they will to access some of our restricted ring sections, and serve as keys to our many outfitters, they do."
units.italian: "Semplici gioielli o simboli di rango, questi non sono," spiega quello che sta armeggiando con il tuo cerchietto. "Servire essi lo fanno come collegamenti, interfacce tra la volontà di un Heliarch e le macchine e i programmi della nostra Coalizione. Permetterti essi lo faranno di accedere ad alcune delle nostre sezioni riservate dell'anello, e servire come chiavi per i nostri molti fornitori, essi lo fanno."

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	They gesture for you to sit and you comply, having the helmet placed over your head. It blocks out your sight completely, and it feels a lot heavier that you had imagined. "Begin now, we shall," you barely hear one of the Heliarchs say, as most of the sound is muffled. Once the process starts, you hear some wave-like humming echo inside your head, and it doesn't take long before you feel as if you're being spun around. Before you get too uncomfortable, the Heliarchs stop the machine and take the helmet off of you. "All done, we are. Here," one says, handing you your circlet back.|2136|0
units.english: They gesture for you to sit and you comply, having the helmet placed over your head. It blocks out your sight completely, and it feels a lot heavier that you had imagined. "Begin now, we shall," you barely hear one of the Heliarchs say, as most of the sound is muffled. Once the process starts, you hear some wave-like humming echo inside your head, and it doesn't take long before you feel as if you're being spun around. Before you get too uncomfortable, the Heliarchs stop the machine and take the helmet off of you. "All done, we are. Here," one says, handing you your circlet back.
units.italian: Ti fanno cenno di sederti e tu obbedisci, mentre ti mettono il casco in testa. Ti blocca completamente la vista, e pesa molto più di quanto avessi immaginato. "Cominciare ora, noi lo faremo," senti a malapena dire da uno degli Heliarchs, dato che la maggior parte del suono è attutita. Una volta iniziato il processo, senti un ronzio ondulatorio echeggiare dentro la testa, e non passa molto prima che tu ti senta come se ti stessero facendo girare. Prima che diventi troppo sgradevole, gli Heliarchs fermano la macchina e ti tolgono il casco. "Fatto tutto, noi abbiamo. Ecco," dice uno, restituendoti il cerchietto.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	Putting it on again, you don't notice any difference, but they push you to try it out on one of the doors. You get up from your seat, moving to the entrance door, and it opens up when you're a few steps away. You think to close it, and it does. You repeat a few more times, and turn back to the Heliarchs, who seem amused by seeing you play with your new ability. You look now to the helmet, and with a thought it turns around, seemingly spinning around a head it assumes it is attached to. You turn it off, and begin to test the circlet with the lights and computers in the room.|2137|0
units.english: Putting it on again, you don't notice any difference, but they push you to try it out on one of the doors. You get up from your seat, moving to the entrance door, and it opens up when you're a few steps away. You think to close it, and it does. You repeat a few more times, and turn back to the Heliarchs, who seem amused by seeing you play with your new ability. You look now to the helmet, and with a thought it turns around, seemingly spinning around a head it assumes it is attached to. You turn it off, and begin to test the circlet with the lights and computers in the room.
units.italian: Rimettendotelo, non noti alcuna differenza, ma ti spingono a provarlo su una delle porte. Ti alzi dal posto e vai verso la porta d'ingresso, e questa si apre quando sei a qualche passo di distanza. Pensi di chiuderla, e si chiude. Lo ripeti alcune volte e ti volti verso gli Heliarchs, che sembrano divertiti nel vederti giocare con la tua nuova capacità. Guardo ora il casco, e con un pensiero si gira, ruotando apparentemente su una testa che presume di avere attaccata. Lo spegni e cominci a provare il cerchietto con le luci e i computer della stanza.

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	When you're done, the two Heliarchs explain some more. "As of a lower rank you are, permit you access to everything and everywhere, your circlet will not. Not yet, at least. But, as mentioned, come to some of the restricted sections, you now many. On many of our worlds, find you will Heliarch outfitters, where now available some of our equipment will be. Permit you to take on some jobs we put up for Heliarch agents here in the restricted sections, the circlet also will."|2138|0
units.english: When you're done, the two Heliarchs explain some more. "As of a lower rank you are, permit you access to everything and everywhere, your circlet will not. Not yet, at least. But, as mentioned, come to some of the restricted sections, you now many. On many of our worlds, find you will Heliarch outfitters, where now available some of our equipment will be. Permit you to take on some jobs we put up for Heliarch agents here in the restricted sections, the circlet also will."
units.italian: Quando hai finito, i due Heliarchs spiegano qualcosa in più. "Dato che di rango inferiore tu sei, permetterti l'accesso a tutto e ovunque, il tuo cerchietto non lo farà. Non ancora, almeno. Ma, come detto, accedere ad alcune delle sezioni riservate, ora tu puoi a molte. Su molti dei nostri mondi, trovare tu potrai fornitori degli Heliarchs, dove ora disponibili alcune delle nostre attrezzature saranno. Permetterti di assumere alcuni lavori che mettiamo a disposizione per gli agenti degli Heliarchs qui nelle sezioni riservate, il cerchietto anche lo farà."

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	They commend you for having joined up, and bid you farewell, having the guards now bring you back to your ship. The three Heliarch consuls who greeted you are waiting for you when you arrive, and hand you a small box which you soon realize is a translation device. "One of us you now are, Captain," the Saryd says. "Trust you we do to uphold the Coalition's values and laws."|2139|0
units.english: They commend you for having joined up, and bid you farewell, having the guards now bring you back to your ship. The three Heliarch consuls who greeted you are waiting for you when you arrive, and hand you a small box which you soon realize is a translation device. "One of us you now are, Captain," the Saryd says. "Trust you we do to uphold the Coalition's values and laws."
units.italian: Ti lodano per esserti unito e si congedano, facendo riportare te alla nave dalle guardie. I tre consoli degli Heliarchs che ti hanno accolto ti aspettano al tuo arrivo, e ti consegnano una piccola scatola che presto capisci essere un dispositivo di traduzione. "Uno di noi ora tu sei, Capitano," dice il Saryd. "Fidarci noi ci fidiamo che tu sostenga i valori e le leggi della Coalizione."

units.id: mission:Heliarch License 2|	The trio congratulates you once again and wishes you safe travels.|2140|0
units.english: The trio congratulates you once again and wishes you safe travels.
units.italian: Il trio ti congratula ancora una volta e ti augura buon viaggio.
